title: When you feel someone's ill will
lede: Revealed as a refuge, and it names the envier by name.
translit: Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi-l-falaq…
arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
trans: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots1 And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you cannot shake a bad feeling
lede: The last sūrah of the Qur'an, a refuge from what is whispered into the chest.
translit: Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi-n-nās…
arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
trans: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer1 - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind".1

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have almost given up
lede: Yaʿqūb ﷺ said this after losing two sons and his eyesight, still refusing to despair.
translit: …wa lā tay'asū min rawḥi-llāh, innahu lā yay'asu min rawḥi-llāhi illa-l-qawmu-l-kāfirūn.
story: Yaʿqūb ﷺ had lost Yūsuf decades earlier, then lost Binyāmīn too, and had wept until his sight was gone. This is what he told his sons: go back and keep looking. Despair was the one thing he would not permit.
arabic: يَـٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
trans: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The moment you wake up
lede: Sleep is a small death. These are the first words on returning from it.
translit: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhi-n-nushūr.
trans: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
english_full: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed, he would say: "Bismika amutu wa ahya." and when he got up he would say:" Al-hamdu li l-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur

title: Leaving the washroom
lede: One word. The Prophet ﷺ said it on coming out.
translit: Ghufrānak.
trans: Your forgiveness.
note: A strange thing to say on leaving a washroom, until you notice what it does: even here, the first instinct is to ask to be forgiven.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Sahih

arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
english_full: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: When the Prophet (ﷺ) came out of the privy, he used to say: "Grant me Thy forgiveness

title: After you make wuḍū'
lede: Whoever says it, the eight gates of Paradise are opened for him.
translit: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ashhadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh.
trans: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَأَنَّ عِيسَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَابْنُ أَمَتِهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِنْهُ وَأَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ النَّارَ حَقٌّ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ أَىِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ الثَّمَانِيَةِ شَاءَ
english_full: It is narrated on the authority of Ubadah b. Samit that the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who said:" There is no god but Allah, He is One and there is no associate with Him, that Muhammad is his servant and His messenger, that Christ is servant and the son of His slave-girl and he (Christ) His word which He communicated to Mary and is His Spirit, that Paradise is a fact and Hell is a fact," Allah would make him (he who affirms these truths enter Paradise through any one of its eight doors which he would like)

title: Stepping into the masjid
lede: Said on entering, asking for the doors of mercy.
translit: Allāhumma-ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik.
trans: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
arabic: إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ . وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
english_full: Abu Usaid reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When any one of you enters the mosque, he should say:" O Allah! open for me the doors of Thy mercy" ; and when he steps out he should say: 'O Allah! I beg of Thee Thy Grace." (Imam Muslim said: I heard Yahya saying: I transcribed this hadith from the compilation of Sulaiman b. Bilal)

title: When the adhān has finished
lede: Whoever says this after hearing the call will have the Prophet's ﷺ intercession on the Day of Rising.
translit: Allāhumma rabba hādhihi-d-daʿwati-t-tāmmah, wa-ṣ-ṣalāti-l-qā'imah, āti Muḥammadan-il-wasīlata wa-l-faḍīlah…
trans: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the means and the excellence, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ النِّدَاءَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، حَلَّتْ لَهُ شَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
english_full: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever after listening to the Adhan says, 'Allahumma Rabba hadhihi-dda` watit-tammah, was-salatil qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wa b`ath-hu maqaman mahmudan-il-ladhi wa`adtahu' [O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (perfect by not ascribing partners to You) and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him (of)], then my intercession for him will be allowed on the Day of Resurrection

title: Opening the prayer
lede: The first words after the opening takbīr.
translit: Subḥānaka-llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdik, wa tabāraka-smuk, wa taʿālā jadduk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
trans: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Sahih

arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
english_full: Narrated AbuSa'id al-Khudri: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up to pray at night (for tahajjud prayer) he uttered the takbir and then said: "Glory be to Thee, O Allah," and "Praise be to Thee" and "Blessed is Thy name," and Exalted is Thy greatness." and "There is no god but Thee." He then said: "There is no god but Allah" three times; he then said: "Allah is altogether great" three times: "I seek refuge in Allah, All-Hearing and All-Knowing from the accursed devil, from his evil suggestion (hamz), from his puffing up (nafkh), and from his spitting (nafth)" He then recited (the Qur'an). Abu Dawud said: It is said that this tradition has been narrated by 'Ali b. 'Ali from al-Hasan omitting the name of the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ). The misunderstanding occurred on the part of Ja'far

title: Sitting between the two prostrations
lede: The shortest request, made twice in every unit of prayer.
translit: Rabbi-ghfir lī.
trans: My Lord, forgive me.
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي كُلِّهِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطَايَاىَ وَعَمْدِي وَجَهْلِي وَهَزْلِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
english_full: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah with the following invocation: 'Rabbi-ghfir-li Khati 'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi `Amri kullihi, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Allahumma ighfirli khatayaya wa 'amdi, wa jahli wa jiddi, wa kullu dhalika'indi. Allahumma ighrifli ma qaddamtu wa ma akhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu. Anta-l-muqaddimu wa anta-l-mu'akh-khiru, wa anta 'ala kulli shai'in qadir

title: When the prayer ends
lede: The Prophet ﷺ would say this immediately after giving salām.
translit: Allāhumma anta-s-salām, wa minka-s-salām, tabārakta yā dha-l-jalāli wa-l-ikrām.
trans: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Owner of Majesty and Honour.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
english_full: Thauban reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer. He begged forgiveness three times and said: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour. Walid reported: I said to Auza'i: How is the seeking of forgiveness? He replied: You should say: I beg forgiveness from Allah, I beg forgiveness from Allah

title: When you have eaten
lede: Thanks offered for food, and an acknowledgement of who provided it.
translit: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
trans: All praise is for Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me, with no power or strength from myself.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Hasan

arabic: مَنْ أَكَلَ طَعَامًا ثُمَّ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا الطَّعَامَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَمَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبًا فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ
english_full: Narrated Mu'adh ibn Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone eats food and then says: "Praise be to Allah Who has fed me with this food and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. If anyone puts on a garment and says: "Praise be to Allah Who has clothed me with this and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins

title: Breaking your fast
lede: Said as the fast ends and the first sip is taken.
translit: Dhahaba-ẓ-ẓama'u wa-btallati-l-ʿurūq, wa thabata-l-ajru in shā' Allāh.
trans: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Hasan

arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
english_full: Marwan ibn Salim al-Muqaffa' said: I saw Ibn Umar holding his beard with his hand and cutting what exceeded the handful of it. He (Ibn Umar) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said when he broke his fast: Thirst has gone, the arteries are moist, and the reward is sure, if Allah wills

title: When something is wearing you down
lede: What the Prophet ﷺ turned to whenever a matter distressed him.
translit: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth.
trans: O Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek relief.
arabic: يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
english_full: Anas bin Malik said:“Whenever a matter would distress him, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say: ‘O Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief (Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth).’” And with this chain, that he said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘Be constant with: “O Possessor of Majesty and Honor (Yā Dhal-Jalāli wal-Ikrām).’”

title: Standing at a grave
lede: The greeting the Prophet ﷺ gave to those who had gone ahead.
translit: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla-d-diyāri mina-l-mu'minīna wa-l-muslimīn, wa innā in shā' Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn.
trans: Peace be upon you, people of these dwellings, believers and Muslims. We will, if Allah wills, be joining you.
arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، أَنْتُمْ لَنَا فَرَطٌ وَنَحْنُ لَكُمْ تَبَعٌ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ
english_full: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Buraidah, from his father, that:when the Messenger of Allah came to the graveyard he would say: "As-salamu 'alaykum ahli ad-diyari min al-mu'minin wal-muslimin wa inna I sha' Allahu bikum lana faratun wa nahnu lakum taba'un, as'alullahal-'afiyata lana wa lakum. (Peace by upon the inhabitants of this place among the believers and Muslims. Soon we will join you, if Allah willing. You have gone on ahead of us and we will follow you. I ask Allah to keep us and you safe and sound)

title: Praying over someone who has died
lede: Asked for the one who can no longer ask for themselves.
translit: Allāhumma-ghfir lahu wa-rḥamhu wa ʿāfihi wa-ʿfu ʿanhu…
trans: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, keep him safe and pardon him.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
english_full: Jubair b. Nufair says:I heard it from 'Auf b. Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) said prayer on the dead body, and I remembered his prayer:" O Allah! forgive him, have mercy upon him, give him peace and absolve him. Receive him with honour and make his grave spacious; wash him with water, snow and hail. Cleanse him from faults as Thou wouldst cleanse a white garment from impurity. Requite him with an abode more excellent than his abode, with a family better than his family, and with a mate better than his mate. Admit him to the Garden, and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire." ('Auf bin Malik) said: I earnestly desired that I were this dead body

title: When you see someone suffering
lede: Said quietly, not aloud, so as never to wound the one you are looking at.
translit: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī ʿāfānī mimma-btalāka bihi wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā.
trans: All praise is for Allah, who kept me safe from what He tested you with, and favoured me over much of His creation.
note: The Prophet ﷺ taught that it be said inwardly. Gratitude is never meant to be performed in front of someone who is struggling.
dissent: Scholars differ on this chain. Zubair Ali Zai grades it Daif. The majority (3 of 4) authenticate it.
arabic: إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَنْ فِرَاشِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْهُ بِصَنِفَةِ إِزَارِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَهُ فَإِذَا اضْطَجَعَ فَلْيَقُلْ بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ . فَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَىَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
english_full: Abu Hurairah (ra) narrated that :the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When one of you leaves his bed then returns to it, then let him brush it off with the edge of his Izar three times, for indeed, he does not know what succeeded him upon it after him. When he lies down, let him say: ‘In Your Name, my Lord, I lay my side down, and in Your Name I raise it. And if You take my soul, then have mercy upon it, and if You release it, then protect it with that which You protect Your righteous worshipers (Bismika rabbī waḍa`tu janbī wa bika arfa`uhu, fa’in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihī `ibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn)’ And when he awakens, let him say: All praise is due to Allah, Who healed me in my body, and returned to me my soul, and permitted me to remember Him (Al-ḥamdulillāh alladhī `āfānī fī jasadī wa radda `alayya rūḥī wa adhina lī bidhikrih).’”

title: Congratulating someone on their marriage
lede: What the Prophet ﷺ said to the one who had just married.
translit: Bāraka-llāhu lak, wa bāraka ʿalayk, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr.
trans: May Allah bless you, and send blessings upon you, and join you both in good.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Sahih

arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: When the Prophet (ﷺ) congratulated a man on his marriage, he said: May Allah bless for you, and may He bless on you, and combine both of you in good (works)

title: Thanking someone who fed you
lede: The guest's prayer for the one who opened their home.
translit: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, wa-ghfir lahum wa-rḥamhum.
trans: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
english_full: Abdullah b. Busr reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to my father and we brought to him a meal and a preparation from dates, cheese and butter. He ate out of that. He was then given dates which he ate, putting the stones between his fingers and holding his forefinger and middle finger together" - Shu'bah said: "I think we learn from this that one may hold the date stones between two fingers, In shaAllah." Then a drink was brought for him and he drank it, and then gave it to one who was on his right side. He (the narrator) said: My father took hold of the rein of his riding animal and requested him to supplicate for us. Thereupon he said: O Allah. bless them in what You have provided them as a sustenance; and forgive them and have mercy upon them

title: Leaving the masjid
lede: On the way in you ask for mercy. On the way out, for provision.
translit: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik.
trans: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.
arabic: ُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
english_full: Abu Usaid reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When any one of you enters the mosque, he should say:" O Allah! open for me the doors of Thy mercy" ; and when he steps out he should say: 'O Allah! I beg of Thee Thy Grace." (Imam Muslim said: I heard Yahya saying: I transcribed this hadith from the compilation of Sulaiman b. Bilal)

title: When the wind picks up
lede: The Prophet ﷺ did not curse the wind. He asked for the good in it.
translit: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā fīhā wa khayra mā ursilat bih, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā fīhā wa sharri mā ursilat bih.
trans: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it and the good it was sent with; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it and the evil it was sent with.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
english_full: Ata' b. Rabah reported on the authority of 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), who said:Whenever the wind was stormy, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say: O Allah! I ask Thee for what is good in it, and the good which it contains, and the good of that which it was sent for. I seek refuge with Thee from what is evil in it, what evil it contains, and the evil of that what it was sent for; and when there was a thunder and lightning in the sky, his colour underwent a change, and he went out and in, backwards and forwards; and when the rain came, he felt relieved, and I noticed that (the sign of relief) on his face. 'A'isha asked him (about it) and he said: It may be as the people of 'Ad said: When they saw a cloud formation coming to their valley they said:" It is a cloud which would give us rain" (Qur'an, xlvi)

title: When there is bad feeling between people
lede: Asked for hearts to be brought together, not just for the argument to stop.
translit: Allāhumma allif bayna qulūbinā, wa aṣliḥ dhāta bayninā, wa-hdinā subula-s-salām.
trans: O Allah, join our hearts, set right what is between us, and guide us to the paths of peace.
dissent: Scholars differ on this chain. Al-Albani grades it Daif. The majority (3 of 4) authenticate it.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Sahih

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلاَمِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: We did not know what we should say when we sat during prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was taught (by Allah). He then narrated the tradition to the same effect. Sharik reported from Jami', from AbuWa'il on the authority of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud something similar. He said: He used to teach us also some other words, but he did not teach them as he taught us the tashahhud: O Allah, join our hearts, mend our social relationship, guide us to the path of peace, bring us from darkness to light, save us from obscenities, outward or inward, and bless our ears, our eyes, our hearts, our wives, our children, and relent toward us; Thou art the Relenting, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Thy blessing and make us praise it while accepting it and give it to us in full

title: Asking for a righteous child
lede: Ibrāhīm ﷺ asked in these words, and was answered.
translit: Rabbi hab lī mina-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
trans: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When there seems to be no way out
lede: A promise attached to one condition, and to provision from a direction you were not watching.
translit: …wa man yattaqi-llāha yajʿal lahu makhrajā, wa yarzuqhu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasib.
arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَـٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
trans: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out1 And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you did not get what you wanted
lede: You may hate a thing and it is better for you. The knowing is His, not yours.
translit: …wa ʿasā an takrahū shay'an wa huwa khayrun lakum, wa ʿasā an tuḥibbū shay'an wa huwa sharrun lakum.
arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
trans: Battle has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allāh knows, while you know not.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When patience is costing you something
lede: The only reward in the Qur'an given without measure.
translit: …innamā yuwaffa-ṣ-ṣābirūna ajrahum bi-ghayri ḥisāb.
arabic: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
trans: Say,1 "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When your heart will not settle
lede: Where restlessness actually ends, according to the Qur'an.
translit: …alā bi-dhikri-llāhi taṭma'innu-l-qulūb.
arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
trans: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When the one who wronged you walked away from it
lede: A warning to anyone who thinks getting away with it is the same as getting away.
translit: Wa lā taḥsabanna-llāha ghāfilan ʿammā yaʿmalu-ẓ-ẓālimūn…
arabic: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
trans: And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: For everyone under your roof
lede: Nūḥ ﷺ asked not only for himself, but for whoever entered his house believing.
translit: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minā…
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
trans: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Sending prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ
lede: The wording he ﷺ gave when the Companions asked how they should do it.
translit: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
trans: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrāhīm. Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
note: They asked him how to send prayers upon him, since they already knew how to greet him. This was his answer.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Sahih
Zubair Ali Zai: Sahih Bukhari (6357) Sahih Muslim (406)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
english_full: This has been transmitted by al-Hakam through a different chain of narrators. This version has:O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad’s family as didst bless Abraham. Thou art indeed praiseworthy and glorious. O Allah grant favours of Muhammad and Muhammad’s family as Thou didst grant favour to Abraham’s family. Thou art indeed praiseworthy and glorious. Abu Dawud said: This tradition has been narrated by al-Zubair b. ‘Adi as narrated by Mis’ar , except that his version goes: As Thou didst bless Abraham’s family. Thou art indeed praiseworthy and glorious. And grant favours to Muhammad. He then narrated the tradition in full

title: When you have been unwell a long time
lede: Ayyūb ﷺ lost his health, his wealth and his children, and said seven words.
translit: …annī massaniya-ḍ-ḍurru wa anta arḥamu-r-rāḥimīn.
story: He does not ask to be cured. He states his condition, and then states who Allah is, and stops there. *So We answered him and removed what afflicted him.* (21:84)
arabic: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
trans: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you know it was your own doing
lede: The first words spoken by a human being after the first mistake.
translit: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā, wa in lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā la-nakūnanna mina-l-khāsirīn.
story: Iblīs argued when he was told he had erred. Ādam ﷺ did not. This is the difference the Qur'an draws between the two, and it is the whole of repentance in one line.
arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
trans: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have nothing and no one
lede: Mūsā ﷺ said this alone in Madyan, having fled with nothing, sitting in the shade.
translit: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
story: He had just helped two strangers water their flock, asked nothing of them, and sat down. He does not name what he needs. He only says he is in need of whatever good Allah sends. Within the hour he had work, a home and a family.
arabic: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
trans: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: For your parents
lede: Ibrāhīm ﷺ asked for his parents even after everything between them.
translit: Rabbana-ghfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa li-l-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmu-l-ḥisāb.
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
trans: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are afraid your heart will turn
lede: Asked by those described in the Qur'an as firmly grounded in knowledge.
translit: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā min ladunka raḥmah, innaka anta-l-Wahhāb.
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
trans: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.1

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Before something you are dreading
lede: Said by a small army the moment they saw how large the other one was.
translit: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn.
story: They were outnumbered and said it out loud, together, before walking forward anyway. The word used for patience here is *poured*, as if it comes down over you from outside.
arabic: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
trans: And when they went forth to [face] Goliath and his soldiers, they said, "Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have had to walk away from everything
lede: Said by young men who left their homes rather than give up what they believed.
translit: Rabbanā ātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wa hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā.
arabic: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
trans: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When the whispering will not stop
lede: A refuge not only from the whispers, but from their presence near you at all.
translit: Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti-sh-shayāṭīn, wa aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūn.
arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
trans: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you wonder whether it even reaches Him
lede: Not a description of Allah. A command, and a promise attached to it.
translit: Wa qāla rabbukumu-dʿūnī astajib lakum…
arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
trans: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When He feels far away
lede: The only verse where Allah answers a question about Himself without the word *say*.
translit: Wa idhā sa'alaka ʿibādī ʿannī fa-innī qarīb, ujību daʿwata-d-dāʿi idhā daʿān…
note: Every other time the Companions asked about something, the reply begins *Say to them*. Here the answer comes directly, with no messenger in between.
arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
trans: And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are frightened of what might happen
lede: What the believers are told to say about anything that could come.
translit: Qul lan yuṣībanā illā mā kataba-llāhu lanā, huwa mawlānā, wa ʿala-llāhi fa-l-yatawakkali-l-mu'minūn.
arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَىٰنَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
trans: Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allāh has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A hundred words that weigh more than they look
lede: Said a hundred times in a day, and sins fall away though they were like the foam of the sea.
translit: Subḥāna-llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih. (×100)
trans: Glory be to Allah, and praise Him.
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ. فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says, 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi,' one hundred times a day, will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea

title: Entering the washroom
lede: Said before going in, seeking refuge from what is unseen there.
translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-khubuthi wa-l-khabā'ith.
trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
english_full: Narrated Anas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, he used to say, "Allah-umma inni a`udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith i.e. O Allah, I seek Refuge with You from all offensive and wicked things (evil deeds and evil spirits)

title: Asking for someone to be healed
lede: The Prophet ﷺ would wipe with his right hand while saying it.
translit: Allāhumma Rabba-n-nās, adhhibi-l-ba's, ishfi anta-sh-Shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uk, shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā.
trans: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm. Cure, for You are the Curer. There is no cure but Yours, a cure that leaves no illness behind.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
english_full: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to treat some of his wives by passing his right hand over the place of ailment and used to say, "O Allah, the Lord of the people! Remove the trouble and heal the patient, for You are the Healer. No healing is of any avail but Yours; healing that will leave behind no ailment

title: When the land is dry and you need rain
lede: Said three times over, plainly, when the people came asking.
translit: Allāhumma aghithnā. (×3)
trans: O Allah, send us relief.
note: The same word covers rain and rescue. They were asking for water, and asking to be saved, in one breath.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
english_full: Narrated Sharik:Anas bin Malik said, "A person entered the Mosque on a Friday through the gate facing the Daril- Qada' and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was standing delivering the Khutba (sermon). The man stood in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; please pray to Allah for rain.' So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Bless us with rain. O Allah! Bless us with rain. O Allah! Bless us with rain!" Anas added, "By Allah, there were no clouds in the sky and there was no house or building between us and the mountain of Sila'. Then a big cloud like a shield appeared from behind it (i.e. Sila' Mountain) and when it came in the middle of the sky, it spread and then rained. By Allah! We could not see the sun for a week. The next Friday, a person entered through the same gate and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday Khutba and the man stood in front of him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; Please pray to Allah to withhold rain.' " Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us. O Allah!' On the plateaus, on the mountains, on the hills, in the valleys and on the places where trees grow.' " Anas added, "The rain stopped and we came out, walking in the sun." Sharik asked Anas whether it was the same person who had asked for rain the previous Friday. Anas replied that he did not know

title: When you stop somewhere unfamiliar
lede: Whoever says it, nothing will harm him until he moves on from that place.
translit: Aʿūdhu bi-kalimāti-llāhi-t-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
trans: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
arabic: مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلاً ثُمَّ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ . لَمْ يَضُرُّهُ شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ ذَلِكَ
english_full: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone lands at a place, and then says:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He has created," nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place

title: At the beginning of a marriage
lede: Taught for the moment a marriage starts, asking for the good in the person themselves.
translit: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayh, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh.
trans: O Allah, I ask You for the good in her and the good of what You have made her inclined towards, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of what You have made her inclined towards.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Hasan

arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً أَوِ اشْتَرَى خَادِمًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيرًا فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
english_full: Amr b. Shu'aib on his father's authority said that his grandfather (Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As) reported the Prophet (ﷺ) said:If one of you marries a woman or buys a slave, he should say: "O Allah, I ask You for the good in her, and in the disposition You have given her; I take refuge in You from the evil in her, and in the disposition You have given her." When he buys a camel, he should take hold of the top of its hump and say the same kind of thing. Abu Dawud said: Abu Sa'id added the following words in his version: He should then tale hold of her forelock and pray for blessing in the case of a woman or a slave

title: When anger has you on your feet
lede: Not words this time, but a physical instruction.
trans: If one of you becomes angry while standing, let him sit down. If the anger leaves him, well and good; otherwise let him lie down.
note: Lower your body and the anger has less to work with. It is one of the plainest pieces of advice in the whole corpus.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Sahih

arabic: إِذَا غَضِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ فَلْيَجْلِسْ فَإِنْ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الْغَضَبُ وَإِلاَّ فَلْيَضْطَجِعْ
english_full: Narrated AbuDharr: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to us: When one of you becomes angry while standing, he should sit down. If the anger leaves him, well and good; otherwise he should lie down

title: When you could ask for them to be punished
lede: Said by the Prophet ﷺ at Ṭā'if, bleeding, after the town had driven him out with stones.
translit: Allāhumma-ghfir li-qawmī fa-innahum lā yaʿlamūn.
trans: O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.
story: The angel of the mountains was sent to him and offered to crush the town between two hills. He said no, and asked instead that their children might one day believe.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِقَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
english_full: Narrated `Abdullah:As if I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) talking about one of the prophets whose nation had beaten him and caused him to bleed, while he was cleaning the blood off his face and saying, "O Allah! Forgive my nation, for they have no knowledge

title: Asking for blessing in what you are about to eat
lede: Said over food, asking not for more of it but for good in it.
translit: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh.
trans: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.
dissent: Scholars differ on this chain. Zubair Ali Zai grades it Daif. The majority (2 of 3) authenticate it.

gradings: Muhammad Muhyi Al-Din Abdul Hamid: Hasan

arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَامًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ . وَإِذَا سُقِيَ لَبَنًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ . فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ شَىْءٌ يُجْزِئُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ إِلاَّ اللَّبَنُ
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: I was in the house of Maymunah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) accompanied by Khalid ibn al-Walid entered. Two roasted long-tailed lizards (dabb) placed on the sticks were brought to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) spat. Khalid said: I think that you abominate it, Messenger of Allah. He said: Yes. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was brought milk, and he drank (it). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: When one of you eats food, he should say: O Allah, bless us in it, and give us food (or nourishment) better than it. When he is given milk to drink he should say: O Allah! bless us in it and give us more of it, for no food or drink satisfies like milk. Abu Dawud said: This is the Musaddad's version

title: The four things worth asking for
lede: Guidance, God-consciousness, restraint, and enough. The Prophet ﷺ asked for these together.
translit: Allāhumma innī as'aluka-l-hudā wa-t-tuqā wa-l-ʿafāfa wa-l-ghinā.
trans: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, God-consciousness, restraint and contentment.
note: Al-ghinā here is not wealth. It is having enough, and not needing to look at what anyone else has.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
english_full: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words):" O Allah. I beg of Thee the right guidance, safeguard against evils, chastity and freedom from want

title: Five things at once, when you do not know where to start
lede: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to a man who could not remember longer supplications.
translit: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-rḥamnī wa-hdinī wa ʿāfinī wa-rzuqnī.
trans: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, keep me well, and provide for me.
note: The Prophet ﷺ said these five gather together your whole life, this one and the next.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
english_full: Abu Malik reported on the authority of his father that when a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to teach him how to observe prayer and then commanded him to supplicate in these words:" O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness, grant me protection and provide me sustenance

title: The supplication he ﷺ said most often
lede: Anas ibn Mālik said this was the Prophet's ﷺ most frequent supplication of all.
translit: Rabbanā ātinā fi-d-dunyā ḥasanah, wa fi-l-ākhirati ḥasanah, wa qinā ʿadhāba-n-nār.
trans: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the next, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
note: It asks for nothing specific, and so it leaves out nothing. Both worlds, in one sentence.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
english_full: Narrated Anas:The most frequent invocation of The Prophet (ﷺ) was: "O Allah! Give to us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire

title: A treasure of Paradise
lede: The Prophet ﷺ called these words exactly that.
translit: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
trans: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
arabic: يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا. كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ
english_full: Narrated Abu Musa:We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and whenever we ascended a high place, we used to say Takbir (in a loud voice). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Be kind to yourselves, for you are not calling upon a deaf or an absent one, but You are calling an All-Hearer, and an All-Seer." Then he came to me as I was reciting silently, "La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah." He said, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! Say: La haul a walaquwata illa bil-lah, for it is one of the treasures of Paradise." Or he said, "Shall I tell you a word which is one of the treasures of Paradise? It is: La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah

title: Two phrases, and a palm tree planted for you
lede: Light on the tongue, heavy on the scale.
translit: Subḥāna-llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih, subḥāna-llāhi-l-ʿAẓīm.
trans: Glory be to Allah and praise Him. Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.
arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi

title: Four phrases that outweigh a whole morning
lede: The Prophet ﷺ told Juwayriyah these outweighed everything she had said since dawn.
translit: Subḥāna-llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih, ʿadada khalqih, wa riḍā nafsih, wa zinata ʿarshih, wa midāda kalimātih.
trans: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, as many as His creation, as pleases Him, as the weight of His Throne, and as endless as His words.
story: He came out at dawn and left her sitting in worship. He returned near midday and found her still there. He told her he had said four phrases three times that would outweigh all of it.
arabic: لَقَدْ قُلْتُ بَعْدَكِ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
english_full: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from (her apartment) in the morning as she was busy in observing her dawn prayer in her place of worship. He came back in the forenoon and she was still sitting there. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her:You have been in the same seat since I left you. She said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I recited four words three times after I left you and if these are to be weighed against what you have recited since morning these would outweigh them and (these words) are:" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him according to the number of His creation and according to the pleasure of His Self and according to the weight of His Throne and according to the ink (used in recording) words (for His Praise)

title: Refuge from what you have not even done yet
lede: The Prophet ﷺ sought protection from the evil of his deeds, and of deeds not yet done.
translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ʿamiltu wa min sharri mā lam aʿmal.
trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done, and from the evil of what I have not done.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَشَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
english_full: Farwa' b. Naufal reported:I asked 'A'isha about the supplication that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made. She said that he used to say:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I have done and from the evil of what I have not done

title: As you lie down for the night
lede: Said with the hand under the cheek, entrusting the soul to the One who takes it.
translit: Bismika rabbī waḍaʿtu janbī, fa-in aḥyayta nafsī fa-rḥamhā, wa in amattahā fa-ghfir lahā.
trans: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
tags: afraid of dying in my sleep
arabic: ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي فَإِنْ أَحْيَيْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا
english_full: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ubaidullah b. Umar with the same chain of transmitters and he said:Then utter:" My Lord. with Thine name I place my side and if Thou keepest me alive have mercy upon myself

title: When the news is bad
lede: Said at the moment of distress, naming Allah three times over.
translit: Lā ilāha illa-llāhu-l-ʿAẓīmu-l-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illa-llāhu Rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm, lā ilāha illa-llāhu Rabbu-s-samāwāti wa Rabbu-l-arḍi wa Rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-karīm.
trans: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.
arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
english_full: Ibn 'Abbas reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters with a sliglit variation of wording

title: When people have banded together against you
lede: Said on the day the tribes gathered around Madīnah to finish it.
translit: Allāhumma munzila-l-kitāb, sarīʿa-l-ḥisāb, ihzimi-l-aḥzāb, Allāhumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum.
trans: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
english_full: Narrated Ibn Abi `Aufa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked for Allah's wrath upon the Ahzab (confederates), saying, "O Allah, the Revealer of the Holy Book, and the One swift at reckoning! Defeat the confederates; Defeat them and shake them

title: When you said something in anger you regret
lede: The Prophet ﷺ asked that any harshness of his be turned into mercy for the one who received it.
translit: Allāhumma fa-ayyumā mu'minin sabbabtuhu fa-jʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma-l-qiyāmah.
trans: O Allah, whichever believer I have insulted, make that a means of drawing him nearer to You on the Day of Rising.
note: He did not only ask forgiveness for himself. He asked that the person he had hurt be repaid for it.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah! If I should ever abuse a believer, please let that be a means of bringing him near to You on the Day of Resurrection

title: Do not say if You wish
lede: The Prophet ﷺ corrected the way people were asking.
trans: None of you should say: O Allah, forgive me if You wish. Let him be firm in his asking, for no one compels Him.
note: Asking tentatively is a way of protecting yourself from disappointment. He ﷺ told them not to. Ask plainly, because nothing is difficult for the One being asked.
arabic: إِذَا دَعَا أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَعْزِمِ الْمَسْأَلَةَ، وَلاَ يَقُولَنَّ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَعْطِنِي. فَإِنَّهُ لاَ مُسْتَكْرِهَ لَهُ
english_full: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you appeal to Allah for something, he should ask with determination and should not say, 'O Allah, if You wish, give me.', for nobody can force Allah to do something against His Will

title: At the end of the day, before sleep
lede: A supplication naming Allah as Lord of everything, then asking for two things.
translit: Allāhumma Rabba-s-samāwāti-s-sabʿi wa Rabba-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm…iqḍi ʿanna-d-dayna wa aghninā mina-l-faqr.
trans: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Magnificent Throne… settle our debt for us and free us from poverty.
arabic: قُولِي اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ
english_full: Abu Huraira reported that Fatima (the daughter of the Holy Prophet) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for a servant. He said to her:Say:" O Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens" ; the rest of the hadith is the same

title: Praying for someone else's life to go well
lede: The Prophet ﷺ made this for Anas ibn Mālik, who served him as a boy. Anas lived long, and it came true.
translit: Allāhumma akthir mālahu wa waladah, wa bārik lahu fīmā aʿṭaytah.
trans: O Allah, increase his wealth and his children, and bless him in what You have given him.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ
english_full: Narrated Anas:Um Sulaim said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Anas is your servant." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! increase his wealth and offspring, and bless (for him) what ever you give him

title: The place you are nearest to Him
lede: The Prophet ﷺ named the exact posture in which a servant is closest to his Lord.
trans: The closest a servant is to his Lord is while he is prostrating, so say much supplication then.
note: Face on the floor is the lowest a body can go, and it is named as the nearest a soul gets. Whatever you want to ask for, ask there.
arabic: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ
english_full: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make supplication (in this state)

title: What he ﷺ said in bowing and prostration
lede: Aisha said he would say this often after the sūrah of victory was revealed.
translit: Subḥānaka-llāhumma rabbanā wa bi-ḥamdik, Allāhumma-ghfir lī.
trans: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise. O Allah, forgive me.
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ رَبِّي وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
english_full: A'isha reported:Never did I, see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the revelation (of these verses):" When Allah's help and victory came." observin- his prayer without making (this supplication) or he said in it (supplication): Hallowed be Thee, my Lord, and with Thy praise, O Allah, forgive me

title: When there is too much rain
lede: They had asked for rain and it did not stop. So he ﷺ asked again, differently.
translit: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā wa lā ʿalaynā.
trans: O Allah, around us and not upon us.
story: A week earlier the same man had stood up asking for rain because the livestock were dying. Now he stood up asking for it to stop. Both times the Prophet ﷺ raised his hands and asked.
note: He did not ask for the rain to end, only that it fall elsewhere: on the hills, the valleys and the places where trees grow.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا، وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا
english_full: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once in the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the people were afflicted with drought (famine). While the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba on a Friday, a Bedouin stood up and said, "O, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Our possessions are being destroyed and the children are hungry; Please invoke Allah (for rain)". So the Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hands. At that time there was not a trace of cloud in the sky. By Him in Whose Hands my soul is as soon as he lowered his hands, clouds gathered like mountains, and before he got down from the pulpit, I saw the rain falling on the beard of the Prophet. It rained that day, the next day, the third day, the fourth day till the next Friday. The same Bedouin or another man stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed, our possessions and livestock have been drowned; Please invoke Allah (to protect us)". So the Prophet (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, "O Allah! Round about us and not on us". So, in whatever direction he pointed with his hands, the clouds dispersed and cleared away, and Medina's (sky) became clear as a hole in between the clouds. The valley of Qanat remained flooded, for one month, none came from outside but talked about the abundant rain

title: Two words to keep returning to
lede: The Prophet ﷺ told them to hold fast to this one phrase.
translit: Yā Dha-l-Jalāli wa-l-Ikrām.
trans: O Owner of Majesty and Honour.
arabic: أَلِظُّوا بِيَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
english_full: Anas bin Malik said:“Whenever a matter would distress him, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say: ‘O Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief (Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth).’” And with this chain, that he said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘Be constant with: “O Possessor of Majesty and Honor (Yā Dhal-Jalāli wal-Ikrām).’”

title: While you are still sitting where you prayed
lede: The angels keep asking for you as long as you stay in the place you prayed.
translit: Allāhumma-ghfir lah, Allāhumma-rḥamh.
trans: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, have mercy on him.
note: This is not a du'ā for you to say. It is what is being said about you, by others, while you remain sitting after the prayer.
arabic: الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُصَلِّي عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مَا دَامَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ، مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ، تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The angels keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for anyone of you, as long as he is at his Musalla (praying place) and he does not pass wind (Hadath). They say, 'O Allah! Forgive him, O Allah! be Merciful to him

title: When you realise how much you were given
lede: Asked by the one who has reached maturity and looks back at their parents.
translit: Rabbi awziʿnī an ashkura niʿmataka-llatī anʿamta ʿalayya wa ʿalā wālidayya wa an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāh…
arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ ثَلَـٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
trans: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me1 to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Asking for people you never met
lede: Those who came later, asking forgiveness for those who came before.
translit: Rabbana-ghfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninā-lladhīna sabaqūnā bi-l-īmān, wa lā tajʿal fī qulūbinā ghillan li-lladhīna āmanū…
arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
trans: And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Going into something new
lede: Mūsā ﷺ was told to say this. So was the Prophet ﷺ, at the hijrah.
translit: Rabbi adkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqin wa akhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqin wa-jʿal lī min ladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā.
arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَـٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
trans: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance1 and to exit a sound exit2 and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are afraid of being used against your faith
lede: Mūsā's people said this, hunted and outnumbered.
translit: …rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnatan li-l-qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn, wa najjinā bi-raḥmatika mina-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn.
arabic: فَقَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
trans: So they said, "Upon Allāh do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have handed it over
lede: The words of Ibrāhīm ﷺ and those with him, when they broke with everyone they knew.
translit: …rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilayka-l-maṣīr.
arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُا۟ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
trans: There has already been for you an excellent pattern1 in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allāh. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allāh alone" - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allāh. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you want to end up among the right people
lede: Ibrāhīm ﷺ asked for sound judgement, and then for the company that goes with it.
translit: Rabbi hab lī ḥukman wa alḥiqnī bi-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
trans: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When the thought of the Fire frightens you
lede: Among the marks of the servants of the Most Merciful, listed in the Qur'an.
translit: Rabbana-ṣrif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannam, inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāmā.
arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
trans: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When home is not safe
lede: The prayer of a woman married to Pharaoh, asking to be built a house somewhere else.
translit: Rabbi-bni lī ʿindaka baytan fi-l-jannah, wa najjinī min Firʿawna wa ʿamalih, wa najjinī mina-l-qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn.
trans: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
story: Āsiya lived inside the palace of the man the Qur'an uses as the picture of tyranny. She asked for the neighbour first and the house second: near You, and then the house. Allah holds her up as an example for every believer, man or woman.
arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Asking for enough, not for more
lede: The Prophet ﷺ asked for his family to be given food that suffices, and no more.
translit: Allāhumma-rzuq āla Muḥammadin qūtā.
trans: O Allah, provide the family of Muhammad with just enough to sustain them.
note: He could have asked for anything. What he asked for was sufficiency, and he asked for it as a blessing rather than a limitation.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ قُوتًا
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give food to the family of Muhammad

title: For someone you love who has turned away
lede: Abū Hurayrah asked the Prophet ﷺ to pray for his mother. He did, and by the time he got home she had changed.
translit: Allāhumma-hdi umma Abī Hurayrah.
trans: O Allah, guide the mother of Abū Hurayrah.
story: He had been inviting her for years and she refused, and one day said something about the Prophet ﷺ that made him weep. He went and asked for a du'ā instead of arguing again. He walked home and found the door shut, and heard water, and she came out and said the shahādah.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ أُمَّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
english_full: Abu Huraira reported:I invited my mother, who was a polytlieist, to Islam. I invited her one day and she said to me something about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I hated. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) weeping and said: Allah's Messenger, I invited my mother to Islam but she did not accept (my invitation). I invited her today but she said to me something which I did not like. (Kindly) supplicate Allah that He may set the mother of Abu Huraira right. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, set the mother of Abu Huraira on the right path. I came out quite pleased with the supplication of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and when I came near the door it was closed from within. My mother heard the noise of my footsteps and she said: Abu Huraira, just wait. And I heard the noise of falling of water. She took a bath and put on the shirt and quickly covered her head with a headdress and opened the door and then said: Abu Huraira, I bear witness to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His bondsman and His Messenger. He (Abu Huraira) said: I went back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and (this time) I was shedding the tears of joy. I said: Allah's Messenger, be happy, for Allah has responded to your supplication and He has set on the right path the mother of Abu Huraira. He (the Holy Prophet) praised Allah, and extolled Him and uttered good words. I said: Allah's Messenger, supplicate to Allah so that He may instill love of mine and that of my mother too in the believing servants and let our hearts be filled with their love, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, let there be love of these servants of yours, i.e. Abu Huraira and his mother, in the hearts of the believing servants and let their hearts be filled with the love of the believing servants. (Abu Huraira said: This prayer) was so well granted by Allah that no believer was ever born who heard of me and who saw me but did not love me

title: For people who have rejected you
lede: They asked him ﷺ to curse a tribe that had refused him. He asked for their guidance instead.
translit: Allāhumma-hdi Dawsan wa'ti bihim.
trans: O Allah, guide Daws and bring them here.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ دَوْسًا وَائْتِ بِهِمْ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:Tufail bin `Amr Ad-Dausi and his companions came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The people of the tribe of Daus disobeyed and refused to follow you; so invoke Allah against them." The people said, "The tribe of Daus is ruined." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Give guidance to the people of Daus, and let them embrace Islam

title: The last words he ﷺ said
lede: Spoken as he was dying, with his hand raised.
translit: Allāhumma fi-r-rafīqi-l-aʿlā.
trans: O Allah, with the highest Companion.
note: Aisha said she knew then that he had been given the choice, and that he had chosen.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى
english_full: Narrated Aisha:When Allah's Apostle was in good health, he used to say, "Never does a prophet die unless he is shown his place in Paradise ( before his death ), and then he is made alive or given the option." When the Prophet became ill and his last moments came while his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious, and when he came to his senses, he looked towards the roof of the house and then said, "O Allah! (Please let me be) with the highest companion." Thereupon I said, "Hence he is not going to stay with us?" Then I came to know that his state was the confirmation of the narration he used to mention to us while he was in good health

title: When everything feels like it is going wrong at once
lede: Refuge from the trials of living and of dying, sought in the prayer itself.
translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi-l-qabr, wa min ʿadhābi-n-nār, wa min fitnati-l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt, wa min fitnati-l-Masīḥi-d-Dajjāl.
trans: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of the Fire, from the trial of living and of dying, and from the trial of the False Messiah.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke (Allah): "Allahumma ini a`udhu bika min 'adhabi-l-Qabr, wa min 'adhabi-nnar, wa min fitnati-l-mahya wa-lmamat, wa min fitnati-l-masih ad-dajjal. (O Allah! I seek refuge with you from the punishment in the grave and from the punishment in the Hell fire and from the afflictions of life and death, and the afflictions of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal)

title: For someone doing good work
lede: Said for Ḥassān, who defended the Prophet ﷺ with poetry.
translit: Allāhumma ayyidhu bi-rūḥi-l-qudus.
trans: O Allah, support him with the Holy Spirit.
arabic: يَا حَسَّانُ، أَجِبْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، اللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ
english_full: Narrated Hassan bin Thabit Al-Ansari:I asked Abu Huraira "By Allah! Tell me the truth whether you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'O Hassan! Reply on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). O Allah! Help him with the Holy Spirit." Abu Huraira said, "Yes

title: After you have done something for His sake
lede: Ibrāhīm and Ismāʿīl ﷺ said this while actually building the Kaʿbah.
translit: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā, innaka anta-s-Samīʿu-l-ʿAlīm.
story: They were raising the foundations of the House itself, and still asked for it to be accepted. Doing the work and knowing it might not be accepted are held together in one verse.
arabic: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
trans: And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing,1 the Knowing.2

title: When prayer keeps slipping
lede: Ibrāhīm ﷺ asked to be made someone who establishes prayer, not merely someone who prays.
translit: Rabbi-jʿalnī muqīma-ṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī, rabbanā wa taqabbal duʿā'.
arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
trans: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have overdone it and lost ground
lede: Said by those the Qur'an describes after a battle went badly.
translit: Rabbana-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā wa thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn.
note: They ask forgiveness for their sins and for their excess, in the same breath, before asking for help. The order is not accidental.
arabic: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
trans: And their words were not but that they said, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When things have finally gone right
lede: Yūsuf ﷺ said this at the height of it, reunited with his family and in power.
translit: …fāṭira-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, anta waliyyī fi-d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah, tawaffanī musliman wa alḥiqnī bi-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
story: After the well, the slavery, the prison and the years apart, at the moment everything was restored, what he asked for was to die a Muslim. Not for more of it to last.
arabic: ۞ رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
trans: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A short one, when you cannot manage more
lede: Said by people in the Qur'an who had nothing left to argue with.
translit: Rabbanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā wa anta khayru-r-rāḥimīn.
arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
trans: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have done something you cannot undo
lede: Mūsā ﷺ said this having killed a man with one blow he never intended to be fatal.
translit: Rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa-ghfir lī…
story: He struck once, to break up a fight, and the man died. He does not explain himself or argue that he did not mean it. He says he wronged his own soul and asks to be forgiven. *So He forgave him.* In the same verse.
arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
trans: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are afraid of being left with no one
lede: Zakariyyā ﷺ, old and without a child, asking not to be left alone.
translit: Rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa anta khayru-l-wārithīn.
trans: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
note: He adds the second half himself: even if no one is left, You remain. The asking and the acceptance sit in one sentence.
tags: no one to care for me
arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have been beaten down by it
lede: Nūḥ ﷺ after centuries of being mocked, in six words.
translit: …annī maghlūbun fa-ntaṣir.
trans: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
story: Nine hundred and fifty years of calling people who would not listen. When it finally broke, this is all he said. It is one of the shortest supplications in the Qur'an.
arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
