trans: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
note: The promise is not that it will be explained to you. It is that your heart will be guided through it.
arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have started but cannot see progress
lede: The condition and the promise, in one verse.
translit: Wa-lladhīna jāhadū fīnā la-nahdiyannahum subulanā, wa inna-llāha la-maʿa-l-muḥsinīn.
trans: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.1 And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
note: The striving comes before the guidance, not after it. You are not told the road first.
arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: An exchange offered in five words
lede: One of the shortest transactions in the Qur'an.
translit: Fa-dhkurūnī adhkurkum wa-shkurū lī wa lā takfurūn.
trans: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
arabic: فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: After you have wronged someone or yourself
lede: A door left open in the middle of a warning.
translit: Wa man yaʿmal sū'an aw yaẓlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri-llāha yajidi-llāha Ghafūran Raḥīmā.
trans: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allāh will find Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Said by people once it is finally over
lede: The first words of the people of Paradise, according to the Qur'an.
translit: Wa qālu-l-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī adhhaba ʿanna-l-ḥazan…
trans: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -
note: Grief is the first thing they mention being rid of, before anything they were given.
arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When something goes right and you are tempted to take credit
lede: Shuʿayb ﷺ, in the middle of a difficult negotiation with his people.
translit: …wa mā tawfīqī illā billāh, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi unīb.
trans: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...?1 And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allāh. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.2
arabic: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَـٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Tracing back where any of it came from
lede: A single verse that accounts for everything you have.
translit: Wa mā bikum min niʿmatin fa-mina-llāh, thumma idhā massakumu-ḍ-ḍurru fa-ilayhi taj'arūn.
trans: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
note: The second half is the sharper one: you already know where to turn when it hurts. The verse is only asking you to know it when things are fine too.
tags: only pray when i need something
arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you cannot see any kindness in it
lede: One of the gentlest descriptions of Allah in the Qur'an.
translit: Allāhu laṭīfun bi-ʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashā', wa huwa-l-Qawiyyu-l-ʿAzīz.
trans: Allāh is Subtle1 with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
note: Laṭīf means acting so finely that you do not notice it happening. Much of what has been arranged for you was arranged this way.
arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When a dispute cannot be resolved by talking
lede: Shuʿayb ﷺ said this when his people would not hear him.
translit: …rabbana-ftaḥ baynanā wa bayna qawminā bi-l-ḥaqqi wa anta khayru-l-fātiḥīn.
trans: We would have invented against Allāh a lie if we returned to your religion after Allāh had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allāh, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allāh we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision."
arabic: قَدِ ٱفْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِى مِلَّتِكُم بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّعُودَ فِيهَآ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا ۚ وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا ۚ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا ٱفْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَـٰتِحِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Getting away from people who mean you harm
lede: Mūsā ﷺ said it running from Egypt with nothing.
translit: …rabbi najjinī mina-l-qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn.
trans: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
arabic: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When the wrong thing is winning
lede: Lūṭ ﷺ, alone in a town that had turned entirely.
translit: …rabbi-nṣurnī ʿala-l-qawmi-l-mufsidīn.
trans: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Arriving somewhere new
lede: Nūḥ ﷺ was told to say it as the ark came to rest.
translit: Wa qul rabbi anzilnī munzalan mubārakan wa anta khayru-l-munzilīn.
trans: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you say you will do something
lede: A correction given for speaking about the future as though it were yours.
translit: Wa lā taqūlanna li-shay'in innī fāʿilun dhālika ghadā, illā an yashā'a-llāh…
trans: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow," Except [when adding], "If Allāh wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
arabic: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟ىْءٍ إِنِّى فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you just want it to stop
lede: Said by a people under a punishment they could no longer bear.
translit: Rabbana-kshif ʿanna-l-ʿadhāba innā mu'minūn.
trans: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When something you heard has moved you
lede: The prayer of those who heard a caller to faith and did not put it off.
translit: Rabbanā innanā samiʿnā munādiyan yunādī li-l-īmāni an āminū bi-rabbikum fa-āmannā…
arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
trans: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Asking not to end up on the wrong side
lede: A short request about company, not conduct.
translit: …rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿa-l-qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn.
trans: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people."
tags: dont want to be like them
arabic: ۞ وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تِلْقَآءَ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you will not get justice in this life
lede: A statement about a day when everyone is brought together, said as a prayer.
translit: Rabbanā innaka jāmiʿu-n-nāsi li-yawmin lā rayba fīh, inna-llāha lā yukhlifu-l-mīʿād.
trans: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are trying to become someone else
lede: Two short lines naming what actually succeeds.
translit: Qad aflaḥa man tazakkā, wa dhakara-sma rabbihi fa-ṣallā.
trans: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When it has gone quiet and you think you were dropped
lede: Revealed after revelation paused, and people said he had been abandoned.
translit: Wa-ḍ-ḍuḥā, wa-l-layli idhā sajā, mā waddaʿaka rabbuka wa mā qalā…
story: The revelation stopped for a period and his enemies said his Lord had left him. The answer opens by swearing an oath by the morning and by the night, and then denies it outright: He has not left you, and He is not displeased with you.
arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
trans: By the morning brightness And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,1 Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you]. And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]. And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied. Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge? And He found you lost and guided [you], And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What actually gets wasted
lede: Three verses. Ash-Shāfiʿī said if people thought only about this sūrah it would be enough for them.
translit: Wa-l-ʿaṣr, inna-l-insāna la-fī khusr, illa-lladhīna āmanū wa ʿamilu-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa tawāṣaw bi-l-ḥaqqi wa tawāṣaw bi-ṣ-ṣabr.
arabic: وَٱلْعَصْرِ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
trans: By time,1 Indeed, mankind is in loss, Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The best day the sun rises on
lede: There is an hour in it in which nothing is asked that is not given.
trans: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it he was admitted to the Garden, and on it he was brought out of it.
arabic: خَيْرُ يَوْمٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ وَفِيهِ أُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَفِيهِ أُخْرِجَ مِنْهَا
english_full: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he. was expelled from it

title: Why people set an alarm for the middle of the night
lede: What happens in the final third, described by the Prophet ﷺ.
trans: Our Lord descends each night to the lowest heaven when the last third of the night remains, and says: who is calling on Me, that I may answer him? Who is asking of Me, that I may give him? Who is seeking My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?
note: Three questions, asked every night, whether or not anyone is awake to hear them.
arabic: يَنْزِلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ يَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ مَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ
english_full: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Our Lord, the Blessed, the Superior, comes every night down on the nearest Heaven to us when the last third of the night remains, saying: "Is there anyone to invoke Me, so that I may respond to invocation? Is there anyone to ask Me, so that I may grant him his request? Is there anyone seeking My forgiveness, so that I may forgive him?

title: Two men in a cave with an army outside
lede: Abū Bakr could see the feet of the men searching. This is what he was told.
translit: …idh yaqūlu li-ṣāḥibihi lā taḥzan inna-llāha maʿanā.
trans: If you do not aid him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] - Allāh has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two,1 when they were in the cave and he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allāh is with us." And Allāh sent down His tranquility upon him and supported him with soldiers [i.e., angels] you did not see and made the word2 of those who disbelieved the lowest,3 while the word of Allāh4 - that is the highest. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
story: Abū Bakr said that if one of them looked down at his feet he would see them. The reply was not a plan or a reassurance about the odds. It was three words about who else was in the cave.
arabic: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثَانِىَ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِى ٱلْغَارِ إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَـٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا ۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٍ لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلسُّفْلَىٰ ۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِىَ ٱلْعُلْيَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are losing and it shows
lede: Revealed after a battle that had gone badly.
translit: Wa lā tahinū wa lā taḥzanū wa antumu-l-aʿlawna in kuntum mu'minīn.
trans: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Consult, then decide, then stop deliberating
lede: The order given in the verse is deliberate.
translit: …wa shāwirhum fi-l-amr, fa-idhā ʿazamta fa-tawakkal ʿala-llāh…
trans: So by mercy from Allāh, [O Muḥammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allāh. Indeed, Allāh loves those who rely [upon Him].
note: Consultation comes before the decision. Reliance comes after it. Doing them in the wrong order is most of what indecision feels like.
arabic: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَٱنفَضُّوا۟ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ۖ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A promise with a timescale attached
lede: The verse does not say when. It says after.
translit: …sa-yajʿalu-llāhu baʿda ʿusrin yusrā.
trans: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].
arabic: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A question asked of you, not by you
lede: Four words in Arabic, phrased as a question.
translit: A-laysa-llāhu bi-kāfin ʿabdah…
trans: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When someone has been hostile to you
lede: An instruction, followed by a claim about what happens if you follow it.
translit: …idfaʿ billatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idha-lladhī baynaka wa baynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīm.
trans: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
arabic: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Being asked to forgive someone who does not deserve it
lede: Revealed when Abū Bakr swore to stop supporting a relative who had slandered his daughter.
translit: …wal-yaʿfū wal-yaṣfaḥū, a-lā tuḥibbūna an yaghfira-llāhu lakum…
trans: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
story: He had every right to cut the man off. The verse does not argue that the man deserved better. It asks Abū Bakr what he himself is hoping for.
arabic: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: After a bad day of your own making
lede: Said to a man who had just confessed to something and expected the worst.
translit: …inna-l-ḥasanāti yudhhibna-s-sayyi'āt…
trans: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
arabic: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَىِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْحَسَنَـٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When faith has turned out to be harder than expected
lede: A question put at the start of a sūrah.
translit: A-ḥasiba-n-nāsu an yutrakū an yaqūlū āmannā wa hum lā yuftanūn.
trans: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried? But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
arabic: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What is said to a soul at the end
lede: The address given to the one whose heart had settled.
translit: Yā ayyatuha-n-nafsu-l-muṭma'innah, irjiʿī ilā rabbiki rāḍiyatan marḍiyyah…
trans: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul, Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him], And enter among My [righteous] servants And enter My Paradise."
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you think small things do not count
lede: Two verses, symmetrical, at the end of a short sūrah.
translit: Fa-man yaʿmal mithqāla dharratin khayran yarah, wa man yaʿmal mithqāla dharratin sharran yarah.
trans: So whoever does an atom's weight1 of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are comparing your results to someone else's
lede: What a person is credited with, stated plainly.
translit: Wa an laysa li-l-insāni illā mā saʿā, wa anna saʿyahu sawfa yurā, thumma yujzāhu-l-jazā'a-l-awfā.
trans: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives And that his effort is going to be seen - Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have been looked down on
lede: The verse gives the only measure that counts, after listing the ones that do not.
translit: …inna akramakum ʿinda-llāhi atqākum…
trans: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous1 of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: For anyone still studying
lede: Two groups are named as being raised, and knowledge is one of them.
translit: …yarfaʿi-llāhu-lladhīna āmanū minkum wa-lladhīna ūtu-l-ʿilma darajāt…
trans: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you.1 And when you are told, "Arise,"2 then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَـٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَـٰتٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What is said to you afterwards
lede: The greeting given at the gate, and the reason given with it.
translit: Salāmun ʿalaykum bimā ṣabartum, fa-niʿma ʿuqba-d-dār.
trans: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
note: The reason given for the greeting is not what they achieved. It is what they put up with.
arabic: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: On fear and grief, and who is exempt
lede: A description, not a promise of an easy life.
translit: Alā inna awliyā'a-llāhi lā khawfun ʿalayhim wa lā hum yaḥzanūn.
trans: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allāh there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve - Those who believed and were fearing Allāh. For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words [i.e., decrees] of Allāh. That is what is the great attainment.
arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have run out of people to ask
lede: A statement about where harm and good actually come from.
translit: Wa in yamsaska-llāhu bi-ḍurrin fa-lā kāshifa lahu illā huw…
trans: And if Allāh should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
arabic: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have everything and still feel hollow
lede: A specific consequence, named in the Qur'an, for turning away from the reminder.
translit: Wa man aʿraḍa ʿan dhikrī fa-inna lahu maʿīshatan ḍankā…
trans: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
note: Not a poor life. A narrow one. The word describes a space too tight to breathe in, regardless of what is in it.
arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Balancing this life against the next
lede: Said to a man whose wealth was so great his keys were a burden to carry.
translit: Wa-btaghi fīmā ātāka-llāhu-d-dāra-l-ākhirata wa lā tansa naṣībaka mina-d-dunyā…
trans: But seek, through that which Allāh has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allāh has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allāh does not like corrupters."
note: It does not say give it all away. It says use it for the other place, and do not neglect your portion here.
arabic: وَٱبْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَأَحْسِن كَمَآ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ ٱلْفَسَادَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A description of what you are working so hard for
lede: Five words for this life, in order.
translit: Iʿlamū annama-l-ḥayātu-d-dunyā laʿibun wa lahwun wa zīnatun wa tafākhurun baynakum wa takāthurun fi-l-amwāli wa-l-awlād…
arabic: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
trans: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The first words revealed
lede: He was told to read, and said he could not.
translit: Iqra' bismi rabbika-lladhī khalaq, khalaqa-l-insāna min ʿalaq, iqra' wa rabbuka-l-akram…
story: He was alone in a cave when he was seized and told to recite. He answered that he was not a reader. It happened three times before the words came.
arabic: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
trans: Recite in the name of your Lord who created Created man from a clinging substance. Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - Who taught by the pen Taught man that which he knew not.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you have been told you amount to nothing
lede: Revealed after his son died and an enemy said his line was finished.
translit: Innā aʿṭaynāka-l-kawthar, fa-ṣalli li-rabbika wa-nḥar, inna shāni'aka huwa-l-abtar.
trans: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar. So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone]. Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.1
story: The man who said it meant that with no surviving son, the Prophet ﷺ would be forgotten. The shortest sūrah in the Qur'an answers by reversing the insult onto the one who made it.
arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you want what someone else was given
lede: An instruction about wishing, followed by what to do instead.
translit: Wa lā tatamannaw mā faḍḍala-llāhu bihi baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍ… wa-s'alu-llāha min faḍlih.
trans: And do not wish for that by which Allāh has made some of you exceed others. For men is a share of what they have earned, and for women is a share of1 what they have earned. And ask Allāh of His bounty. Indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.
note: It does not tell you to stop wanting. It tells you to take the wanting to the right place.
arabic: وَلَا تَتَمَنَّوْا۟ مَا فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ لِّلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا ٱكْتَسَبُوا۟ ۖ وَلِلنِّسَآءِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا ٱكْتَسَبْنَ ۚ وَسْـَٔلُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A father's advice to his son
lede: Prayer, then enjoining good, then patience over what comes of it.
translit: Yā bunayya aqimi-ṣ-ṣalāta wa'mur bi-l-maʿrūfi wa-nha ʿani-l-munkari wa-ṣbir ʿalā mā aṣābak…
trans: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.1
arabic: يَـٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Reading a hardship without blaming yourself for all of it
lede: A verse that names a cause, and another beside it that names pardon.
translit: Wa mā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fa-bimā kasabat aydīkum wa yaʿfū ʿan kathīr.
trans: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
note: The second clause is easy to skip. Most of it is already pardoned.
arabic: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The stated reason any of this exists
lede: One sentence answering the largest question.
translit: Wa mā khalaqtu-l-jinna wa-l-insa illā li-yaʿbudūn.
trans: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A conditional you can act on today
lede: Support is offered in exchange for support.
translit: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū in tanṣuru-llāha yanṣurkum wa yuthabbit aqdāmakum.
trans: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Who does the healing
lede: Ibrāhīm ﷺ listing what his Lord does, and changing person for one clause only.
translit: Alladhī khalaqanī fa-huwa yahdīn, wa-lladhī huwa yuṭʿimunī wa yasqīn, wa idhā mariḍtu fa-huwa yashfīn.
trans: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me. And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink. And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
note: He says He feeds me and He guides me. But he does not say He makes me ill. The illness he attributes to himself; only the cure is attributed to Allah.
arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What a marriage is actually built on
lede: Two things are named as having been placed between spouses, and neither one is attraction.
translit: …wa jaʿala baynakum mawaddatan wa raḥmah, inna fī dhālika la-āyātin li-qawmin yatafakkarūn.
trans: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
note: Mawaddah is love you feel. Raḥmah is what carries the marriage when you do not.
arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The most surprising thing said about repentance
lede: Not that the record is wiped, but that the entries are changed.
translit: …fa-ulā'ika yubaddilu-llāhu sayyi'ātihim ḥasanāt, wa kāna-llāhu Ghafūran Raḥīmā.
trans: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you feel disliked
lede: A promise about how other people will come to feel about you.
translit: Inna-lladhīna āmanū wa ʿamilu-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti sa-yajʿalu lahumu-r-Raḥmānu wuddā.
trans: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.1
note: It is placed by Him, into other people, without you doing anything to win it.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What is promised in this world, not the next
lede: A specific guarantee, made about the life you are living now.
translit: Man ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wa huwa mu'minun fa-la-nuḥyiyannahu ḥayātan ṭayyibah…
trans: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Patience without complaint to people
lede: Yaʿqūb ﷺ, shown a shirt and told a lie, chose two words.
translit: …fa-ṣabrun jamīl, wa-llāhu-l-mustaʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūn.
trans: And they brought upon his shirt false blood.1 [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allāh is the one sought for help against that which you describe."
note: Ṣabr jamīl was explained by the scholars as patience with no complaint made to created beings. He knew they were lying and still did not turn on them.
arabic: وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you try to be grateful and do not know where to start
lede: A statement about arithmetic.
translit: …wa in taʿuddū niʿmata-llāhi lā tuḥṣūhā…
trans: And He gave you from all you asked of Him.1 And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.2
arabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are frightened about money
lede: A statement covering every living creature, without exception.
translit: Wa mā min dābbatin fi-l-arḍi illā ʿala-llāhi rizquhā…
trans: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allāh is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage.1 All is in a clear register.
arabic: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you thought life was supposed to be easier
lede: A single verse about the design.
translit: Laqad khalaqna-l-insāna fī kabad.
trans: We have certainly created man into hardship.
note: Not as a punishment. As a description. The struggle is not evidence that something has gone wrong.
arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What has been keeping you busy
lede: Two verses naming the distraction, and when it ends.
translit: Alhākumu-t-takāthur, ḥattā zurtumu-l-maqābir.
trans: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you Until you visit the graveyards.1
arabic: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Two conditions, and what comes down afterwards
lede: Say it, then hold to it. The angels do the rest.
translit: Inna-lladhīna qālū rabbuna-llāhu thumma-staqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu-l-malā'ikatu allā takhāfū wa lā taḥzanū…
trans: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The calm that is sent down
lede: Named as something placed into hearts, not produced by them.
translit: Huwa-lladhī anzala-s-sakīnata fī qulūbi-l-mu'minīna li-yazdādū īmānan maʿa īmānihim…
trans: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.
arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Before you pass on what you heard
lede: Revealed about a report that nearly caused a war between two groups.
translit: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū in jā'akum fāsiqun bi-naba'in fa-tabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bi-jahālatin fa-tuṣbiḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīn.
trans: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When two people you know have fallen out
lede: A statement, then an instruction that follows from it.
translit: Innama-l-mu'minūna ikhwatun fa-aṣliḥū bayna akhawaykum…
trans: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Being fair to someone you dislike
lede: The verse names the temptation before forbidding it.
translit: …wa lā yajrimannakum shana'ānu qawmin ʿalā allā taʿdilū, iʿdilū huwa aqrabu li-t-taqwā…
trans: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm for Allāh, witnesses in justice, and do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what you do.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَآءَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا۟ ۚ ٱعْدِلُوا۟ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Among the qualities of those promised the Garden
lede: Three things listed in order, each harder than the last.
translit: …wa-l-kāẓimīna-l-ghayẓa wa-l-ʿāfīna ʿani-n-nās, wa-llāhu yuḥibbu-l-muḥsinīn.
trans: Who spend [in the cause of Allāh] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allāh loves the doers of good;
note: Restraining it, then pardoning, then doing good to them. The verse walks up the difficulty.
arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِى ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلْكَـٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Three instructions for dealing with people
lede: Said to be among the most comprehensive verses about character.
translit: Khudhi-l-ʿafwa wa'mur bi-l-ʿurfi wa aʿriḍ ʿani-l-jāhilīn.
trans: Take what is given freely,1 enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
arabic: خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are afraid giving will leave you short
lede: Two promises are contrasted, and the sources of each are named.
translit: Ash-shayṭānu yaʿidukumu-l-faqra wa ya'murukum bi-l-faḥshā', wa-llāhu yaʿidukum maghfiratan minhu wa faḍlan…
trans: Satan threatens you with poverty and orders you to immorality, while Allāh promises you forgiveness from Him and bounty. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
arabic: ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱلْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعِدُكُم مَّغْفِرَةً مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلًا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The threshold for real giving
lede: A condition placed on attaining righteousness.
translit: Lan tanālu-l-birra ḥattā tunfiqū mimmā tuḥibbūn…
trans: Never will you attain the good [reward]1 until you spend [in the way of Allāh] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allāh is Knowing of it.
arabic: لَن تَنَالُوا۟ ٱلْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Straight after the prayer ends
lede: What the Qur'an tells you to do the moment Friday prayer is over.
translit: Fa-idhā quḍiyati-ṣ-ṣalātu fa-ntashirū fi-l-arḍi wa-btaghū min faḍli-llāhi wa-dhkuru-llāha kathīran laʿallakum tufliḥūn.
trans: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.
note: Worship and work are not set against each other. One verse sends you from the first into the second.
arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you cannot manage everything you are meant to
lede: A qualification attached to the command itself.
translit: Fa-ttaqu-llāha ma-staṭaʿtum wa-smaʿū wa aṭīʿū wa anfiqū khayran li-anfusikum…
trans: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: On seeing something and not taking it in
lede: A correction about where blindness actually occurs.
translit: …fa-innahā lā taʿma-l-abṣāru wa lākin taʿma-l-qulūbu-llatī fi-ṣ-ṣudūr.
trans: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A consequence with a shape to it
lede: What happens to a person who leaves off remembering.
translit: Wa lā takūnū ka-lladhīna nasu-llāha fa-ansāhum anfusahum…
trans: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.
note: Losing hold of who you are is described as the second thing that happens, not the first.
arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are advising others and not doing it
lede: Described as greatly hated in the sight of Allah.
translit: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūn, kabura maqtan ʿinda-llāhi an taqūlū mā lā tafʿalūn.
trans: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do? Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The verse that describes light with light
lede: One of the most quoted verses in the Qur'an, and one of the least literal.
translit: Allāhu nūru-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ…
arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ ٱلْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ ۗ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
trans: Allāh is the Light1 of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light2 is like a niche within which is a lamp;3 the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When what you are asking for looks impossible
lede: How anything happens, according to the Qur'an.
translit: Innamā amruhu idhā arāda shay'an an yaqūla lahu kun fa-yakūn.
trans: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When someone else got what you were qualified for
lede: A statement about who is doing the distributing.
translit: …naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fi-l-ḥayāti-d-dunyā…
trans: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Who answers when you are at the end of it
lede: A question the Qur'an asks rather than answers, because the answer is obvious.
translit: Am man yujību-l-muḍṭarra idhā daʿāhu wa yakshifu-s-sū'a…
trans: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth?1 Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
note: The word muḍṭarr means someone with no options left. The verse describes the state before it describes the answering.
arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When someone you love will not listen
lede: Revealed about the Prophet's ﷺ own uncle, who died refusing.
translit: Innaka lā tahdī man aḥbabta wa lākinna-llāha yahdī man yashā'…
trans: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
note: Said to the one person best able to convince anybody. It is not a criticism of your effort. It is a limit on what effort can do.
arabic: إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What prayer is supposed to be doing
lede: A claim about the effect of ṣalāh, stated as a fact.
translit: …inna-ṣ-ṣalāta tanhā ʿani-l-faḥshā'i wa-l-munkar, wa la-dhikru-llāhi akbar…
trans: Recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allāh is greater. And Allāh knows that which you do.
arabic: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Every creature that does not keep a savings account
lede: An argument made from the animals.
translit: Wa ka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu rizqahā, Allāhu yarzuquhā wa iyyākum…
trans: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Five things nobody else has been given
lede: A short list, and everything on it is something people try to predict.
translit: Inna-llāha ʿindahu ʿilmu-s-sāʿah, wa yunazzilu-l-ghayth, wa yaʿlamu mā fi-l-arḥām…
trans: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs.1 And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۢ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۢ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Which way the need actually runs
lede: A correction addressed to all people at once.
translit: Yā ayyuha-n-nāsu antumu-l-fuqarā'u ila-llāh, wa-llāhu huwa-l-Ghaniyyu-l-Ḥamīd.
trans: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
arabic: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A question about knowing and not knowing
lede: Asked in the middle of a description of someone praying through the night.
translit: …qul hal yastawi-lladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-lladhīna lā yaʿlamūn…
trans: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
arabic: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Two things that take real resolve
lede: A short verse about what following an injury.
translit: Wa la-man ṣabara wa ghafara inna dhālika la-min ʿazmi-l-umūr.
trans: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.1
note: It is called a matter of resolve, not of temperament. Nobody is expected to find it easy.
arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you keep doing what you know you should not
lede: A description of a specific kind of worship.
translit: A-fa-ra'ayta mani-ttakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu…
trans: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge1 and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَـٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: On the part of your money that is not yours
lede: Described not as generosity but as an existing claim.
translit: Wa fī amwālihim ḥaqqun li-s-sā'ili wa-l-maḥrūm.
trans: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
note: It is called a right belonging to them, not a favour from you.
arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are waiting on a decision that is not yours
lede: Said to the Prophet ﷺ when things were at their most hostile.
translit: Wa-ṣbir li-ḥukmi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā…
trans: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
note: Not merely seen. Kept within sight, the way you watch something you are responsible for.
arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you think you could never learn it
lede: Repeated four times in one sūrah, unchanged.
translit: Wa laqad yassarna-l-qur'āna li-dh-dhikr, fa-hal min muddakir.
trans: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The one moment nothing can be done in
lede: A scene described in the present tense, with everyone watching.
translit: Fa-lawlā idhā balaghati-l-ḥulqūm, wa antum ḥīna'idhin tanẓurūn, wa naḥnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum wa lākin lā tubṣirūn.
trans: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat And you are at that time looking on - And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A question asked gently, and it stings
lede: Revealed to believers, not to disbelievers.
translit: A-lam ya'ni li-lladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum li-dhikri-llāh…
trans: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
story: Ibn Masʿūd said that only four years passed between their becoming Muslim and this verse being revealed to correct them.
arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Nothing said in private is actually private
lede: A verse about arithmetic and company.
translit: …mā yakūnu min najwā thalāthatin illā huwa rābiʿuhum wa lā khamsatin illā huwa sādisuhum…
trans: Have you not considered that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them,1 nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Giving when you have little yourself
lede: Said of people who gave away what they themselves needed.
translit: …wa yu'thirūna ʿalā anfusihim wa law kāna bihim khaṣāṣah, wa man yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ulā'ika humu-l-mufliḥūn.
trans: And [also for] those who were settled in the Home [i.e.,al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them.1 They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو ٱلدَّارَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِّمَّآ أُوتُوا۟ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ ۚ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: About someone you are at odds with now
lede: A possibility left open in the middle of a verse about enemies.
translit: ʿAsa-llāhu an yajʿala baynakum wa bayna-lladhīna ʿādaytum minhum mawaddah, wa-llāhu Qadīr…
trans: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent,1 and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
arabic: ۞ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A command about the people in your house
lede: Yourself first, then them.
translit: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa ahlīkum nārā…
trans: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.
arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Why any of this was set up
lede: The stated purpose of creating death and life, in that order.
translit: Alladhī khalaqa-l-mawta wa-l-ḥayāta li-yabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalā…
trans: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
note: Not most in deed. Best. The measure is quality, not quantity.
arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The single thing he was praised for by name
lede: Of everything that could have been said about him ﷺ, this was said.
translit: Wa innaka la-ʿalā khuluqin ʿaẓīm.
trans: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: A description of how people are made
lede: Named as a default, with one stated exception.
translit: Inna-l-insāna khuliqa halūʿā, idhā massahu-sh-sharru jazūʿā, wa idhā massahu-l-khayru manūʿā, illa-l-muṣallīn.
trans: Indeed, mankind was created anxious: When evil touches him, impatient, And when good touches him, withholding [of it], Except the observers of prayer - Those who are constant in their prayer
note: Anxiety is treated as the standard human setting, and prayer as the thing that interrupts it.
arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: What actually arrives with you
lede: A statement about the only kind of sending that reaches.
translit: …wa mā tuqaddimū li-anfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda-llāh…
trans: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it1 and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.2 And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: When you are making excuses to yourself
lede: A verse about knowing perfectly well.
translit: Bali-l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīrah, wa law alqā maʿādhīrah.
trans: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,1 Even if he presents his excuses.
arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Two paths, described in parallel
lede: Six short verses setting out the difference in what happens next.
translit: Fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ttaqā wa ṣaddaqa bi-l-ḥusnā fa-sa-nuyassiruhu li-l-yusrā…
trans: As for he who gives and fears Allāh And believes in the best [reward], We will ease him toward ease. But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need And denies the best [reward], We will ease him toward difficulty.
note: Ease is described as being made easier still. Difficulty likewise compounds. Both directions accelerate.
arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: An honest description you may recognise
lede: Three verses about the human being, stated flatly.
translit: Inna-l-insāna li-rabbihi la-kanūd, wa innahu ʿalā dhālika la-shahīd, wa innahu li-ḥubbi-l-khayri la-shadīd.
trans: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful. And indeed, he is to that a witness.1 And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: Prayer that does not reach the person next to you
lede: A sūrah that begins with religion and ends with a bowl not lent.
translit: A-ra'ayta-lladhī yukadhdhibu bi-d-dīn, fa-dhālika-lladhī yaduʿʿu-l-yatīm…
note: The people criticised here are praying. What is held against them is that it changed nothing about how they treat an orphan or a neighbour.
arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
trans: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense? For that is the one who drives away the orphan And does not encourage the feeding of the poor. So woe to those who pray [But] who are heedless of their prayer1 - Those who make show [of their deeds] And withhold [simple] assistance.

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The answer to who He is
lede: They asked him ﷺ to describe his Lord's lineage. Four verses came down.
translit: Qul huwa-llāhu aḥad, Allāhu-ṣ-ṣamad, lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.
note: He said it equals a third of the Qur'an. It contains no command and no story, only an answer.
arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
trans: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,1 Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.1 He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

gradings: Qur'anic text in the Uthmani script via Quran.com; translation: Saheeh International

title: The man who had never done a single good thing
lede: He told his sons to burn him and scatter him so that Allah would never find him.
trans: A man who had never done any good said to his family: when I die, burn me, then grind me, then scatter me into the sea, for by Allah, if my Lord takes hold of me He will punish me as He has punished no one. They did it. Allah commanded the earth and the sea to give back what they had taken, and He said: why did you do this? He said: out of fear of You, my Lord, and You know best. So Allah forgave him.
note: He had the theology wrong in every particular. He was forgiven for the fear behind it.
arabic: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ حَسَنَةً قَطُّ لأَهْلِهِ إِذَا مَاتَ فَحَرِّقُوهُ ثُمَّ اذْرُوا نِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَنِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ لَيُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا لاَ يُعَذِّبُهُ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ فَعَلُوا مَا أَمَرَهُمْ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَرَّ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ وَأَمَرَ الْبَحْرَ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا قَالَ مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ . فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
english_full: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a person who had never done any good deed asked the members of his family to burn his dead body when he would die and to scatter half of its ashes over the land and half in the ocean. By Allah, if Allah finds him in His grip, He would torment him with a torment with which He did not afflict anyone amongst the people of the world; and when the person died, it was done to him as he had commanded (his family) to do. Allah commanded the land to collect (the ashes scattered on it) and He commanded the ocean and that collected (ashes) contained in it. Allah questioned him why he had done. that He said:My Lord, it is out of Thine fear that I have done it and Thou art well aware of it, and Allah granted him pardon:

title: The last person admitted
lede: He is shown his small sins, admits them, and then is shown what they became.
trans: A man is brought and his minor sins are shown to him while the great ones are hidden. He is asked: did you do this on such a day? He says yes, unable to deny any of it, and is afraid of the great sins still to come. Then he is told: for every bad deed you have a good deed. He says: my Lord, I did things I do not see here. The Prophet ﷺ laughed until his back teeth showed.
arabic: إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ آخِرَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ دُخُولاً الْجَنَّةَ وَآخِرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ خُرُوجًا مِنْهَا رَجُلٌ يُؤْتَى بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُقَالُ اعْرِضُوا عَلَيْهِ صِغَارَ ذُنُوبِهِ وَارْفَعُوا عَنْهُ كِبَارَهَا . فَتُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهِ صِغَارُ ذُنُوبِهِ فَيُقَالُ عَمِلْتَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا وَعَمِلْتَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا . فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ . لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يُنْكِرَ وَهُوَ مُشْفِقٌ مِنْ كِبَارِ ذُنُوبِهِ أَنْ تُعْرَضَ عَلَيْهِ . فَيُقَالُ لَهُ فَإِنَّ لَكَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ سَيِّئَةٍ حَسَنَةً . فَيَقُولُ رَبِّ قَدْ عَمِلْتُ أَشْيَاءَ لاَ أَرَاهَا هَا هُنَا
english_full: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I know the last of the inhabitants of Paradise to enter it and the last of the inhabitants of Hell to come out of it. He is a man who would be brought on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said: Present his minor sins to him, and withhold from him his serious sins. Then the minor sins would be placed before him, and it would be said: On such and such a day you did so and so and on such and such a day you did so and so. He would say: Yes. It will not be possible for him to deny, while he would be afraid lest serious sins should be presented before him. It would be said to him: In place of every evil deed you will have a good deed. He will say: My Lord! I have done things I do not see here. I indeed saw the Messenger of Allah laugh till his front teeth were exposed

title: Praise for there being more than one right way
lede: Aisha was asked about his ﷺ witr and gave several different answers.
translit: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī jaʿala fi-l-amri saʿah.
trans: All praise is for Allah, who has placed room in the matter.
note: Said on discovering that a practice had more than one valid form. It is a useful thing to remember before arguing about one.
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي الأَمْرِ سَعَةً
english_full: Abdullah b. Abu'l-Qais reported:I asked 'A'isha about the Witr (prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and made mention of a hadith, then I said: What did he do after having sexual intercourse? Did he take a bath before going to sleep or did he sleep before taking a bath? She said: He did all these. Some- times he took a bath and then slept, and sometimes he performed ablution only and went to sleep. I (the narrator) said: Praise be to Allah Who has made things easy (for human beings)

title: For someone taking on something they may not be ready for
lede: Said for a man who admitted he could not stay steady on a horse.
translit: Allāhumma thabbithu wa-jʿalhu hādiyan mahdiyyā.
trans: O Allah, make him firm, and make him a guide who is guided.
note: He asked to be excused because he could not hold his seat. He was not excused. He was prayed for instead, and afterwards he never fell.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ، وَاجْعَلْهُ هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا
english_full: Narrated Qais:Jarir said to me, The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Won't you relieve me from Dhu-l-Khalasa?" And that was a house (in Yemen belonging to the tribe of) Khatham called Al-Ka`ba Al Yamaniya. I proceeded with one-hundred and-fifty cavalry from Ahmas (tribe) who were horse riders. I used not to sit firm on horses, so the Prophet (ﷺ) stroke me over my chest till I saw the mark of his fingers over my chest, and then he said, 'O Allah! Make him (i.e. Jarir) firm and one who guides others and is guided on the right path." So Jarir proceeded to it dismantled and burnt it, and then sent a messenger to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The messenger of Jarir said (to the Prophet), "By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I did not leave that place till it was like a scabby camel." The Prophet (ﷺ) blessed the horses of Ahmas and their men five times

title: What he ﷺ said while dying
lede: Aisha watched him dipping his hand in water and wiping his face.
translit: Lā ilāha illa-llāh, inna li-l-mawti sakarāt.
trans: There is no god but Allah. Indeed, death has its agonies.
note: He did not describe it as gentle. The one person who could have been spared it was not, and said so.
arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ
english_full: Narrated Aisha:It was one of the favors of Allah towards me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) expired in my house on the day of my turn while he was leaning against my chest and Allah made my saliva mix with his saliva at his death. `Abdur-Rahman entered upon me with a Siwak in his hand and I was supporting (the back of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (against my chest ). I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) looking at it (i.e. Siwak) and I knew that he loved the Siwak, so I said ( to him ), "Shall I take it for you ? " He nodded in agreement.
