translit: lā taghlibannakumu al-aʿrābu ʿalā āsmi ṣalātikum alā wa-innahā al-ʿishāʾu walakinnahum yuʿtimūna bi-l-ibili
english_full: Ibn ‘Umar reported the prophet (May peace be upon him) as saying:The desert Arabs may not dominate you in respect of the name of your prayer. Beware! It is al-`Isha, but they milk their camels when it is fairly dark

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 4989
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْكَذِبَ فَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكْذِبُ وَيَتَحَرَّى الْكَذِبَ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّابًا وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ وَيَتَحَرَّى الصِّدْقَ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ صِدِّيقًا
translit: iyyākum wa-l-kadhiba fa-inna al-kadhiba yahdī ilā al-fujūri wa-inna al-fujūra yahdī ilā an-nāri wa-inna ar-rajula layakdhibu wayataḥarrā al-kadhiba ḥattā yuktaba ʿinda-Llāh kadhāban waʿalaykum bi-aṣ-ṣidqi fa-inna aṣ-ṣidqa yahdī ilā al-birri wa-inna al-birra yahdī ilā al-jannah wa-inna ar-rajula layaṣduqu wayataḥarrā aṣ-ṣidqa ḥattā yuktaba ʿinda-Llāh ṣiddīqan
english_full: ‘Abd Allah (b. Mas’ud) reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying :Avoid falsehood, for falsehood leads to wickedness, and wickedness to hell; and if a man continues to speak falsehood and makes falsehood his object, he will be recorded in Allah’s presence as a great liar. And adhere to truth, for truth leads to good deeds, and good deeds lead to paradise. If a man continues to speak the truth and makes truth his object, he will be recorded in Allah’s presence as eminently truthful

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5005
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُبْغِضُ الْبَلِيغَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ الَّذِي يَتَخَلَّلُ بِلِسَانِهِ تَخَلُّلَ الْبَاقِرَةِ بِلِسَانِهَا
translit: inna-Llāh ʿazza wajalla yubghiḍu al-balīgha mina ar-rijāli adh-dhī yatakhallalu bilisānihi takhallula al-bāqirah bilisānihā
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah , the Exalted, hates the eloquent one among men who moves his tongue round (among his teeth), as cattle do

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5008
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَوْ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَتَجَوَّزَ فِي الْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّ الْجَوَازَ هُوَ خَيْرٌ
translit: laqad raʾaytu aw umirtu an atajawwaza fī al-qawli fa-inna al-jawāza huwa khayrun
english_full: One day when a man got up and spoke at length Amr ibn al-'As said If he had been moderate in what he said:It would have been better for him. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: I think (or, I have been commanded) that I should be brief in what I say, for brevity is better

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5015
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّ رُوحَ الْقُدُسِ مَعَ حَسَّانَ مَا نَافَحَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
translit: inna rūḥa al-qudusi maʿa ḥassāna mā nāfaḥa ʿan rasūli-Llāh ṣlā-Llāh ʿlyh wslm
english_full: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to setup a pulpit in the mosque for Hassan who would stand on it and satirise those who spoke against the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say: The spirit of holiness (i.e. Gabriel) is with Hassan so long as he speaks in defence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5019
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِذَا اقْتَرَبَ الزَّمَانُ لَمْ تَكَدْ رُؤْيَا الْمُؤْمِنِ أَنْ تَكْذِبَ وَأَصْدَقُهُمْ رُؤْيَا أَصْدَقُهُمْ حَدِيثًا وَالرُّؤْيَا ثَلاَثٌ فَالرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ بُشْرَى مِنَ اللَّهِ وَالرُّؤْيَا تَحْزِينٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَرُؤْيَا مِمَّا يُحَدِّثُ بِهِ الْمَرْءُ نَفْسَهُ فَإِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مَا يَكْرَهُ فَلْيَقُمْ فَلْيُصَلِّ وَلاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا النَّاسَ
translit: idhā āqtaraba az-zamānu lam takad ruʾyā al-muʾmini an takdhiba wa-aṣdaquhum ruʾyā aṣdaquhum ḥadīthan wa-ar-ruʾyā thalāthun fa-ar-ruʾyā aṣ-ṣāliḥah bushrā mina-Llāh wa-ar-ruʾyā taḥzīnun mina ash-shayṭāni waruʾyā mimmā yuḥaddithu bihi al-marʾu nafsah fa-idhā raā aḥadukum mā yakrah falyaqum falyuṣalli walā yuḥaddith bihā an-nāsa
english_full: Abu Hurairah reported the Prophet (May peace be upon him) as saying:When the time draws near, a believer’s vision can hardly be false. The truer one of them is in his speech, the truer he is in his vision. Visions are of three types: Good visions are glad tidings from Allah, a terrifying vision caused by the devil, and the ideas which come from within a man. So when one sees anything he dislikes, he should get up and pray, and should not tell it to the people. He said : I like a fetter and dislike a shackle on the neck; a fetter indicates being firmly established in religion. Abu Dawud said : “when the time draws near” means that when the day and night are equal

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5021
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: الرُّؤْيَا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَالْحُلْمُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ شَيْئًا يَكْرَهُهُ فَلْيَنْفُثْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ لْيَتَعَوَّذْ مِنْ شَرِّهَا فَإِنَّهَا لاَ تَضُرُّهُ
translit: ar-ruʾyā mina-Llāh wa-l-ḥulmu mina ash-shayṭāni fa-idhā raā aḥadukum shayʾan yakrahuhu falyanfuth ʿan yasārihi thalātha marrātin thumma lyataʿawwadh min sharrihā fa-innahā lā taḍurruhu
english_full: Abu Qatadah said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) say: A good vision comes from Allah and a dream (hulm) from the devil, so when one of you sees what he dislikes, he must spit on his left (three times), and seek refuge in Allah from its evil. It will then not harm him

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5024
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ صَوَّرَ صُورَةً عَذَّبَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يَنْفُخَ فِيهَا وَلَيْسَ بِنَافِخٍ وَمَنْ تَحَلَّمَ كُلِّفَ أَنْ يَعْقِدَ شَعِيرَةً وَمَنِ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى حَدِيثِ قَوْمٍ يَفِرُّونَ بِهِ مِنْهُ صُبَّ فِي أُذُنِهِ الآنُكُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
translit: man ṣawwara ṣūratan ʿadhabah Allāh bihā yawma al-qiyāmah ḥattā yanfukha fīhā walaysa bināfikhin waman taḥallama kullifa an yaʿqida shaʿīratan wamani āstamaʿa ilā ḥadīthi qawmin yafirrūna bihi minhu ṣubba fī udhunihi al-ānuku yawma al-qiyāmah
english_full: Ibn ‘Abbas reported the Prophet (ﷺ) as saying :If anyone makes a representation of anything, Allah will punish him on the Day of Resurrection for it until he breathes into it, but he will be unable to do so. If anyone pretends to have had a dream which he did not see, he will be ordered to tie a knot in a grain of barley. If anyone listens to other people’s talk when they try to avoid him, lead will be poured into his ears on the Day of Resurrection

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5025
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: رَأَيْتُ اللَّيْلَةَ كَأَنَّا فِي دَارِ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ وَأُتِينَا بِرُطَبٍ مِنْ رُطَبِ ابْنِ طَابٍ فَأَوَّلْتُ أَنَّ الرِّفْعَةَ لَنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْعَاقِبَةَ فِي الآخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ دِينَنَا قَدْ طَابَ
translit: raʾaytu al-laylaha kaʾannā fī dāri ʿuqbaha bni rāfiʿin wa-utīnā biruṭabin min ruṭabi ābni ṭābin fa-awwaltu anna ar-rifʿaha lanā fī ad-dunyā wa-l-ʿāqibaha fī al-ākhirah wa-anna dīnanā qad ṭāba
english_full: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: One night it seemed to me in a dream that we were in the house of Uqbah ibn Rafi' and were brought some of the fresh dates of Ibn tab. I interpreted it as meaning that to us is granted eminence (rif'ah) in this world, a blessed hereafter ('aqibah), and that our religion has been good (tabah)

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5030
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: خَمْسٌ تَجِبُ لِلْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى أَخِيهِ رَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَتَشْمِيتُ الْعَاطِسِ وَإِجَابَةُ الدَّعْوَةِ وَعِيَادَةُ الْمَرِيضِ وَاتِّبَاعُ الْجَنَازَةِ
translit: khamsun tajibu lilmuslimi ʿalā akhīhi raddu as-salāmi watashmītu al-ʿāṭisi wa-ijābah ad-daʿwah waʿiyādah al-marīḍi wāttibāʿu al-janāzah
english_full: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying:There are five qualities which a Muslim should display to his brother : return of salutation, response to the one who sneezes, acceptance of the invitation, paying sick visit to a patient, and accompanying the funeral

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5042
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَبِيتُ عَلَى ذِكْرٍ طَاهِرًا فَيَتَعَارُّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَيَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ
translit: mā min muslimin yabītu ʿalā dhikrin ṭāhiran fayataʿārru mina al-layli fayasʾalu-Llāh khayran mina ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah illā aʿṭāhu iyyāhu
english_full: Narrated Mu'adh ibn Jabal: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If a Muslim sleeps while remembering Allah, in the state of purification, is alarmed while asleep at night, and asks Allah for good in this world and in the Hereafter. He surely gives it to him. Thabit al-Bunani said: AbuZabyah came to visit us and he transmitted this tradition to us from Mu'adh ibn Jabal from the Prophet (ﷺ). Thabit said: So and so said: I tried my best to utter these (prayers) when I got up, but I could not do

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5055
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: اقْرَأْ { قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ } ثُمَّ نَمْ عَلَى خَاتِمَتِهَا فَإِنَّهَا بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ
translit: āqraʾ { qul yā ayyuhā al-kāfirūna } thumma nam ʿalā khātimatihā fa-innahā barāʾatun mina ash-shirki
english_full: Farwah b. Nawfal quoted his father as saying that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Nawfal (his father):Recite (the Surah) 'Say, O you disbelievers!' and then go to sleep at its end, for it is a declaration of freedom from polytheism

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5058
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَفَانِي وَآوَانِي وَأَطْعَمَنِي وَسَقَانِي وَالَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَىَّ فَأَفْضَلَ وَالَّذِي أَعْطَانِي فَأَجْزَلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ وَإِلَهَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
translit: al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhī kafānī wawānī wa-aṭʿamanī wasaqānī wa-adh-dhī manna ʿalāa fa-afḍala wa-adh-dhī aʿṭānī fa-ajzala al-ḥamdu lillāh ʿalā kulli ḥālin Allāhumma rabba kulli shayʾin wamalīkah wa-ilaha kulli shayʾin aʿūdhu bika mina an-nāri
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to his bed, he would say: Praise be to Allah Who has given me sufficiency, has guarded me, given me food and drink, been most gracious to me, and given to me most lavishly. Praise be to Allah in every circumstance. O Allah! Lord and King of everything, God of everything, I seek refuge in Thee from Hell

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5059
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنِ اضْطَجَعَ مَضْجَعًا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فِيهِ إِلاَّ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ تِرَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ قَعَدَ مَقْعَدًا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِيهِ إِلاَّ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ تِرَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
translit: mani āḍṭajaʿa maḍjaʿan lam yadhkuri-Llāh taʿālā fīhi illā kāna ʿalayhi tiratan yawma al-qiyāmah waman qaʿada maqʿadan lam yadhkuri-Llāh ʿazza wajalla fīhi illā kāna ʿalayhi tiratan yawma al-qiyāmah
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone lies on his side where he does not remember Allah, deprivation will descend on him on the Day of Resurrection; and if anyone sits in a place where he does not remember Allah, deprivation will descend on him on the Day of Resurrection

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5060
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ حِينَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
translit: man taʿārra mina al-layli faqāla ḥīna yastayqiẓu lā ilaha illā-Llāh waḥdah lā sharīka lah lah al-mulku walah al-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun subḥāna-Llāh wa-l-ḥamdu lillāh walā ilaha illā-Llāh wallāh akbaru walā ḥawla walā quwwaha illā billāh thumma daʿā rabbi āghfir lī
english_full: ‘Ubadah b. al-Samit reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying; If anyone is alarmed while asleep and he says when awakes :there is no god but Allah alone Who has no partner, to whom dominion belongs, to whom praise is due, and who has power over everything (omnipotent). Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and then he prays: O my Lord, forgive me. Abu Dawud said : Al-Walid’s version has; and he prays, his prayer will be answered. If he gets up, performs ablution, and prays, his prayer will be accepted

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5062
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمَا عَلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَا إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا فَسَبِّحَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَاحْمَدَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَكَبِّرَا أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ
translit: alā adullukumā ʿalā khayrin mimmā saʾaltumā idhā akhadhtumā maḍājiʿakumā fasabbiḥā thalāthan wathalāthīna wāḥmadā thalāthan wathalāthīna wakabbirā arbaʿan wathalāthīna fahuwa khayrun lakumā min khādimin
english_full: Ali said :Fatimah complained to the Prophet (May peace be upon him) of the effect of the grinding stone on her hand. Then some slaves (prisoners of war) were brought to him. So she went to him to ask for (one of) them, but she did not find him. She mentioned the matter to ‘A’ishah. When the prophet (May peace be upon him) came, she informed him. He (the prophet) visited us (Ali) when we had gone to bed, and when we were about to get up, he said: stay where you are. He then came and sat down between us (her and me), and I felt the coldness of his feet on my chest. He then said; “Let me guide to something better than what you have asked. When you go bed, say: Glory be to Allah” thirty-three times.”Praise be to Allah” thirty-three times, and “ Allah is most Great” thirty-four times. That will be better for you than a servant

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5065
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: يَأْتِي أَحَدَكُمْ - يَعْنِي الشَّيْطَانَ - فِي مَنَامِهِ فَيُنَوِّمُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَهُ وَيَأْتِيهِ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيُذَكِّرُهُ حَاجَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَهَا
translit: yaʾtī aḥadakum-yaʿnī ash-shayṭāna-fī manāmihi fayunawwimuhu qabla an yaqūlah wayaʾtīhi fī ṣalātihi fayudhakkiruhu ḥājatan qabla an yaqūlahā
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There are two qualities or characteristics which will not be returned by any Muslim without his entering Paradise. While they are easy, those who act upon them are few. One should say: "Glory be to Allah" ten times after every prayer, "Praise be to Allah" ten times and "Allah is Most Great" ten times. That is a hundred and fifty on the tongue, but one thousand and five hundred on the scale. When he goes to bed, he should say: "Allah is Most Great" thirty-four times, "Praise be to Allah" thirty-three times, and Glory be to Allah thirty-three times, for that is a hundred on the tongue and a thousand on the scale. (He said:) I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) counting them on his hand. The people asked: Messenger of Allah! How is it that while they are easy, those who act upon them are few? He replied: The Devil comes to one of you when he goes to bed and he makes him sleep, before he utters them, and he comes to him while he is engaged in prayer and calls a need to his mind before he utters them

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5077
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَانَ لَهُ عِدْلُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَكُتِبَ لَهُ عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ عَشْرُ سَيِّئَاتٍ وَرُفِعَ لَهُ عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ وَكَانَ فِي حِرْزٍ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَإِنْ قَالَهَا إِذَا أَمْسَى كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ
translit: man qāla idhā aṣbaḥa lā ilaha illā-Llāh waḥdah lā sharīka lah lah al-mulku walah al-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun kāna lah ʿidlu raqabatin min waladi ismāʿīla wakutiba lah ʿashru ḥasanātin waḥuṭṭa ʿanhu ʿashru sayyiātin warufiʿa lah ʿashru darajātin wakāna fī ḥirzin mina ash-shayṭāni ḥattā yumsiya wa-in qālahā idhā amsā kāna lah mithlu dhalika ḥattā yuṣbiḥa
english_full: Narrated AbuAyyash: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone says in the morning: "There is no god but Allah alone Who has no partner; to Him belong the dominions, to Him praise is due, and He is Omnipotent," he will have a reward equivalent to that for setting free a slave from among the descendants of Isma'il. He will have ten good deeds recorded for him, ten evil deeds deducted from him, he will be advanced ten degrees, and will be guarded from the Devil till the evening. If he says them in the evening, he will have a similar recompense till the morning. The version of Hammad says: A man saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a dream and said: Messenger of Allah! AbuAyyash is relating such and such on your authority. He said: AbuAyyash has spoken the truth. Abu Dawud said: Isma'il b. Ja'far, Musa al-Zim'i and 'Adb Allah b. Ja'far transmitted it from Suhail, from his father on the authority of Ibn 'A'ish

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5082
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: { قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ } وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ حِينَ تُمْسِي وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ تَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ
translit: { qul huwa-Llāh aḥadun } wa-l-muʿawwidhatayni ḥīna tumsī waḥīna tuṣbiḥu thalātha marrātin takfīka min kulli shayʾin
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Khubayb: We went out one rainy and intensely dark night to look for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to lead us in prayer, and when we found him, he asked: Have you prayed?, but I did not say anything. So he said: Say, but I did not say anything. He again said: Say, but I did not say anything. He then said: Say. So I said: What am I to say? He said: Say: "Say, He is Allah, One," and al-Mu'awwadhatan three times in the morning and evening; they will serve you for every purpose

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5088
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَىْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فَجْأَةُ بَلاَءٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُصْبِحُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فَجْأَةُ بَلاَءٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ
translit: man qāla bismi-Llāh adh-dhī lā yaḍurru maʿa āsmihi shayʾun fī al-arḍi walā fī as-samāʾi wahuwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu thalātha marrātin lam tuṣibhu fajʾah balāʾin ḥattā yuṣbiḥa waman qālahā ḥīna yuṣbiḥu thalātha marrātin lam tuṣibhu fajʾah balāʾin ḥattā yumsiya
english_full: Narrated Uthman ibn Affan: Aban ibn Uthman said: I heard Uthman ibn Affan (his father) say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: If anyone says three times: "In the name of Allah, when Whose name is mentioned nothing on Earth or in Heaven can cause harm, and He is the Hearer, the Knower" he will not suffer sudden affliction till the morning, and if anyone says this in the morning, he will not suffer sudden affliction till the evening. Aban was afflicted by some paralysis and when a man who heard the tradition began to look at him, he said to him: Why are you looking at me? I swear by Allah, I did not tell a lie about Uthman, nor did Uthman tell a lie about the Prophet (ﷺ), but that day when I was afflicted by it, I became angry and forgot to say them

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5090
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: دَعَوَاتُ الْمَكْرُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
translit: daʿawātu al-makrūbi-Llāhumma raḥmataka arjū falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfaha ʿaynin wa-aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullah lā ilaha illā anta
english_full: Narrated AbuBakrah: AbdurRahman ibn AbuBakrah said that he told his father: O my father! I hear you supplicating every morning: "O Allah! Grant me health in my body. O Allah! Grant me good hearing. O Allah! Grant me good eyesight. There is no god but Thou." You repeat them three times in the morning and three times in the evening. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) using these words as a supplication and I like to follow his practice. The transmitter, Abbas, said in this version: And you say: "O Allah! I seek refuge in Thee from infidelity and poverty. O Allah! I seek refuge in Thee from punishment in the grave. There is no god but Thee". You repeat them three times in the morning and three times in the evening, and use them as a supplication. I like to follow his practice. He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The supplications to be used by one who is distressed are: "O Allah! Thy mercy is what I hope for. Do not abandon me to myself for an instant, but put all my affairs in good order for me. There is no god but Thou." Some transmitters added more than others

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5091
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِذَا أَمْسَى كَذَلِكَ لَمْ يُوَافِ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْخَلاَئِقِ بِمِثْلِ مَا وَافَى
translit: man qāla ḥīna yuṣbiḥu subḥāna-Llāh al-ʿaẓīmi wabiḥamdihi māʾaha marratin wa-idhā amsā kadhalika lam yuwāfi aḥadun mina al-khalāʾiqi bimithli mā wāfā
english_full: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying:if anyone says a hundred times in the morning: “Glory be to Allah, the Sublime, and I begin with praise of him”, and says likewise in the evening, no one from the creatures will bring anything like the one which he will bring

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5098
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: يَا عَائِشَةُ مَا يُؤَمِّنُنِي أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ قَدْ عُذِّبَ قَوْمٌ بِالرِّيحِ وَقَدْ رَأَى قَوْمٌ الْعَذَابَ فَقَالُوا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا
translit: yā ʿāʾishah mā yuʾamminunī an yakūna fīhi ʿadhābun qad ʿudhiba qawmun bi-ar-rīḥi waqad raā qawmun al-ʿadhāba faqālūā hadhā ʿāriḍun mumṭirunā
english_full: ‘A’ishah, wife of the prophet (May peace be upon him), said :I never saw the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) laugh fully to such an extent that I could see his uvula. He would only smile, and when he saw clouds or wind, his face showed signs (of fear). I asked him: Messenger of Allah! When the people see the cloud, they rejoice, hoping for that it may contain rain, and I notice that when you see it, (the signs of) abomination on your face. He replied: ‘A’ishah! What gives me safety from the fact that it might contain punishment? A people were punished by the wind. When those people saw the punishment, they said: this is a cloud which would give us rain

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5103
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحُمُرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ
translit: idhā samiʿtum nubāḥa al-kilābi wanahīqa al-ḥumuri bi-l-layli fataʿawwadhūā billāh fa-innahunna yarayna mā lā tarawna
english_full: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When you hear the barking of dogs and the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah, for they see which you do not see

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5104
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: أَقِلُّوا الْخُرُوجَ بَعْدَ هَدْأَةِ الرِّجْلِ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى دَوَابَّ يَبُثُّهُنَّ فِي الأَرْضِ
translit: aqillūā al-khurūja baʿda hadʾah ar-rijli fa-inna lillāh taʿālā dawābba yabuthuhunna fī al-arḍi
english_full: Narrated Ali ibn Umar ibn Husayn ibn Ali: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Do not go out much when there are few people about , for Allah the Exalted scatters abroad of His beasts in that hour (according to Ibn Marwan's version). Ibn Marwan's version has: For Allah has creatures. He then mentioned the barking of dogs and braying of asses in a similar manner. He added in his version: Ibn al-Had said: Shurahbil ibn al-Hajib told me on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) similar to it

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5108
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنِ اسْتَعَاذَ بِاللَّهِ فَأَعِيذُوهُ وَمَنْ سَأَلَكُمْ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ فَأَعْطُوهُ
translit: mani āstaʿādha billāh fa-aʿīdhūhu waman saʾalakum biwajhi-Llāh fa-aʿṭūhu
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone asks (you) for refuge for the sake of Allah, give him refuge; and if anyone asks you (for something) for the pleasure of Allah, give him. Ubaydullah said: If anyone asks you for the sake of Allah

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5109
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنِ اسْتَعَاذَكُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَأَعِيذُوهُ وَمَنْ سَأَلَكُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَأَعْطُوهُ
translit: mani āstaʿādhakum billāh fa-aʿīdhūhu waman saʾalakum billāh fa-aʿṭūhu
english_full: Ibn ‘Abbas reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying:If anyone asks you refuge for Allah’s sake give him refuge; and if anyone asks you (for something) for Allah’s sake, give him. Sahl and Sulaiman said: if anyone calls you, respond to him. The Agreed version goes; if you do not afford to compensate him, pray Allah for him until you know that you have compensated him

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5113
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ
translit: mani āddaʿā ilā ghayri abīhi wahuwa yaʿlamu annah ghayru abīhi fa-l-jannah ʿalayhi ḥarāmun
english_full: Sa’id b. Malik said:My ears heard it end my heart remembered it from Muhammad (May peace be upon him) who said: if a man claims to be the son of a man who is not his father, paradise will be forbidden for him. He said: I then met Abu Bakrah and mentioned it to him. He said: my ears heard it and my heart remembered it from Muhammad (peace be upon him). ‘Asim said : I said : Abu ‘Uthman! Two men testified before you. Who are they? He said : One of them is the one who is first to shoot arrow in the path of Allah or in the path of Islam, that is to say : Sa’d b. Malik. The other is the one came from al-Taif with ten and some men on foot. He then mentioned his excellence. Abu Dawud said : When al-Nufaili mentioned this tradition, he said : I swear by Allah, this is sweater with me than honey, that is no say, his way transmission. Abu ‘Ali said : I heard Abu Dawud say : I heard Ahmad say : The people of Kufah have no light in their traditions. I did not see them like the people of Basrah. They learnt it from Shu’bah

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5114
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَوْمًا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَدْلٌ وَلاَ صَرْفٌ
translit: man tawallā qawman bighayri idhni mawālīhi faʿalayhi laʿnah Allāh wa-l-malāʾikah wa-an-nāsi ajmaʿīna lā yuqbalu minhu yawma al-qiyāmah ʿadlun walā ṣarfun
english_full: Abu Hurairah reported the Prophet (May peace be upon him) as saying :if a man becomes the client of any people without the permission of his patrons (i.e. those who have freed him), on him will be the curse of Allah, of angels and of all people; no obligatory or supererogatory worship will be accepted from him

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5116
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ أَذْهَبَ عَنْكُمْ عُبِّيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَفَخْرَهَا بِالآبَاءِ مُؤْمِنٌ تَقِيٌّ وَفَاجِرٌ شَقِيٌّ أَنْتُمْ بَنُو آدَمَ وَآدَمُ مِنْ تُرَابٍ لَيَدَعَنَّ رِجَالٌ فَخْرَهُمْ بِأَقْوَامٍ إِنَّمَا هُمْ فَحْمٌ مِنْ فَحْمِ جَهَنَّمَ أَوْ لَيَكُونُنَّ أَهْوَنَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْجِعْلاَنِ الَّتِي تَدْفَعُ بِأَنْفِهَا النَّتْنَ
translit: inna-Llāh ʿazza wajalla qad adhhaba ʿankum ʿubbiyyaha al-jāhiliyyah wafakhrahā bi-l-ābāʾi muʾminun taqiyyun wafājirun shaqiyyun antum banū ādama wadamu min turābin layadaʿanna rijālun fakhrahum biʾaqwāmin innamā hum faḥmun min faḥmi jahannama aw layakūnunna ahwana ʿalā-Llāh mina al-jiʿlāni at-tī tadfaʿu biʾanfihā an-natna
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Allah, Most High, has removed from you the pride of the pre-Islamic period and its boasting in ancestors. One is only a pious believer or a miserable sinner. You are sons of Adam, and Adam came from dust. Let the people cease to boast about their ancestors. They are merely fuel in Jahannam; or they will certainly be of less account with Allah than the beetle which rolls dung with its nose

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5131
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: اشْفَعُوا إِلَىَّ لِتُؤْجَرُوا وَلْيَقْضِ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ مَا شَاءَ
translit: āshfaʿūā ilāa lituʾjarūā walyaqḍi-Llāh ʿalā lisāni nabiyyihi mā shāʾa
english_full: Abu Musa reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying:Make intercession to me, you will be rewarded, for Allah decrees what he wishes by the tongue of his prophet

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5136
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ إِلَى هِرَقْلَ عَظِيمِ الرُّومِ سَلاَمٌ عَلَى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَى
translit: min muḥammadin rasūli-Llāh ilā hiraqla ʿaẓīmi ar-rūmi salāmun ʿalā mani āttabaʿa al-hudā
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) wrote a letter to Heraclius: "From Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, to Hiraql (Heraclius), Chief of the Byzantines. Peace be to those who follow the guidance." Ibn Yahya reported on the authority of Ibn Abbas that AbuSufyan said to him: We then came to see Hiraql (Heraclius) who seated us before him. He then called for the letter from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Its contents were: "In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful, from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah, to Hiraql, chief of Byzantines. Peace be to those who follow the guidance. To proceed

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5137
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: لاَ يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ
translit: lā yajzī waladun wa-ad-dah illā an yajidah mamlūkan fayashtariyah fayuʿtiqah
english_full: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying:A son does not repay what he owes to his father unless he buys him and emancipates him if he finds him in slavery

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5139
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: لاَ يَسْأَلُ رَجُلٌ مَوْلاَهُ مِنْ فَضْلٍ هُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَيَمْنَعُهُ إِيَّاهُ إِلاَّ دُعِيَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَضْلُهُ الَّذِي مَنَعَهُ شُجَاعًا أَقْرَعَ
translit: lā yasʾalu rajulun mawlāhu min faḍlin huwa ʿindah fayamnaʿuhu iyyāhu illā duʿiya lah yawma al-qiyāmah faḍluhu adh-dhī manaʿah shujāʿan aqraʿa
english_full: Bahz b. Hakim on his father's authority said that his grandfather said:I said: Messenger of Allah! to whom should I show kindness? He replied: Your mother, next your mother, next your mother, and then comes your father, and then your relatives in order of relationship. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If a man asks his slave whom he freed for giving him property which is surplus with him and he refuses to give it to him, the surplus property which he refused to give will be called on the Day of resurrection as a large bald snake. Abu Dawud said: Aqra' means a snake whose hair of the head were removed on account of poison

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5157
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّهُمْ إِخْوَانُكُمْ فَضَّلَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَمَنْ لَمْ يُلاَئِمْكُمْ فَبِيعُوهُ وَلاَ تُعَذِّبُوا خَلْقَ اللَّهِ
translit: innahum ikhwānukum faḍḍalakumu-Llāh ʿalayhim faman lam yulāʾimkum fabīʿūhu walā tuʿadhibūā khalqa-Llāh
english_full: Ma’rur b. Suwaid said :I saw Abu Dharr at Rabadhah. He was wearing a thick cloak, and his slave also wore a similar one. He said : the people said: Abu Dharr! (it would be better) if you could take the cloak which your slave wore, and you combined that with, and it would be a pair of garments (hullah) and you would clothe him with another garment. He said: Abu Dharr said : I abused a man whose mother was a non-Arab and I reviled him for his mother. He complained against me to the apostle of allah (May peace be upon him). He said: Abu Dharr! You are a man who has a characteristic of pre-Islamic days. He said: they are your brethren; Allah has given you superiority over them; sell those who do not please you and do not punish Allah’s creatures

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5161
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ لاَءَمَكُمْ مِنْ مَمْلُوكِيكُمْ فَأَطْعِمُوهُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ وَاكْسُوهُ مِمَّا تَكْتَسُونَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُلاَئِمْكُمْ مِنْهُمْ فَبِيعُوهُ وَلاَ تُعَذِّبُوا خَلْقَ اللَّهِ
translit: man lāʾamakum min mamlūkīkum fa-aṭʿimūhu mimmā taʾkulūna wāksūhu mimmā taktasūna waman lam yulāʾimkum minhum fabīʿūhu walā tuʿadhibūā khalqa-Llāh
english_full: Narrated AbuDharr: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Feed those of your slaves who please you from what you eat and clothe them with what you clothe yourselves, but sell those who do not please you and do not punish Allah's creatures

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5165
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ قَذَفَ مَمْلُوكَهُ وَهُوَ بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا قَالَ جُلِدَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَدًّا
translit: man qadhafa mamlūkah wahuwa barīʾun mimmā qāla julida lah yawma al-qiyāmah ḥaddan
english_full: Abu Hurairah said:Abu al-Qasim, the Prophet of Atonement (ﷺ) said to me: If anyone reviles his slave when he is innocent of what he said, he will be beaten on the Day of Resurrection. The transmitter Mu'ammal said: 'Isa narrated it to us from al-Fudial, that is, Ibn Ghazwan

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5169
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا نَصَحَ لِسَيِّدِهِ وَأَحْسَنَ عِبَادَةَ اللَّهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ
translit: inna al-ʿabda idhā naṣaḥa lisayyidihi wa-aḥsana ʿibādaha-Llāh falah ajruhu marratayni
english_full: ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying:when a slave acts sincerely towards his master and worship Allah well, he will have a double reward

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5172
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنِ اطَّلَعَ فِي دَارِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ فَفَقَأُوا عَيْنَهُ فَقَدْ هَدَرَتْ عَيْنُهُ
translit: mani āṭṭalaʿa fī dāri qawmin bighayri idhnihim fafaqaʾūā ʿaynah faqad hadarat ʿaynuhu
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone peeps into the house of a people without their permission and he knocks out his eye, no responsibility is incurred for his eye

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5177
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: اخْرُجْ إِلَى هَذَا فَعَلِّمْهُ الاِسْتِئْذَانَ فَقُلْ لَهُ قُلِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَأَدْخُلُ
translit: ākhruj ilā hadhā faʿallimhu al-istiʾdhāna faqul lah quli as-salāmu ʿalaykum aʾadkhulu
english_full: Narrated Rib'i: A man of Banu Amir told that he asked the Prophet (ﷺ) for permission (to enter the house) when he was in the house, saying: May I enter ? The Prophet (ﷺ) said to his servant: Go out to this (man) and teach him how to ask permission to enter the house, and say to him: "Say : Peace be upon you. May I enter?" The man heard it and said: Peace be upon you! May I enter ? The Prophet (ﷺ) permitted him and he entered

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5205
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: لاَ تَبْدَءُوهُمْ بِالسَّلاَمِ وَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فِي الطَّرِيقِ فَاضْطَرُّوهُمْ إِلَى أَضْيَقِ الطَّرِيقِ
translit: lā tabdaʾūhum bi-as-salāmi wa-idhā laqītumūhum fī aṭ-ṭarīqi fāḍṭarrūhum ilā aḍyaqi aṭ-ṭarīqi
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: Suhayl ibn AbuSalih said: I went out with my father to Syria. The people passed by the cloisters in which there were Christians and began to salute them. My father said: Do not give them salutation first, for AbuHurayrah reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Do not salute them (Jews and Christians) first, and when you meet them on the road, force them to go to the narrowest part of it

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5208
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِذَا انْتَهَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْمَجْلِسِ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقُومَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ فَلَيْسَتِ الأُولَى بِأَحَقَّ مِنَ الآخِرَةِ
translit: idhā āntahā aḥadukum ilā al-majlisi falyusallim fa-idhā arāda an yaqūma falyusallim falaysati al-ūlā biʾaḥaqqa mina al-ākhirah
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When one of you comes to an assembly, he should give a salutation and if he feels inclined to get up, he should give a salutation, for the former is not more of a duty than the latter

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5210
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: يُجْزِئُ عَنِ الْجَمَاعَةِ، إِذَا مَرُّوا أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ، أَحَدُهُمْ وَيُجْزِئُ عَنِ الْجُلُوسِ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَحَدُهُمْ
translit: yujziʾu ʿani al-jamāʿah, idhā marrūā an yusallima, aḥaduhum wayujziʾu ʿani al-julūsi an yarudda aḥaduhum
english_full: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: AbuDawud said: Al-Hasan ibn Ali traced this tradition back to the Prophet (ﷺ): When people are passing by, it is enough if one of them gives a salutation on their behalf, and that it is enough for those who are sitting if one of them replies

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5212
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيَتَصَافَحَانِ إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْتَرِقَا
translit: mā min muslimayni yaltaqiyāni fayataṣāfaḥāni illā ghufira lahumā qabla an yaftariqā
english_full: Narrated Al-Bara' ibn Azib: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Two Muslims will not meet and shake hands having their sins forgiven them before they separate

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5229
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَمْثُلَ لَهُ الرِّجَالُ قِيَامًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ
translit: man aḥabba an yamthula lah ar-rijālu qiyāman falyatabawwaʾ maqʿadah mina an-nāri
english_full: Narrated Mu'awiyah: AbuMijlaz said: Mu'awiyah went out to Ibn az-Zubayr and Ibn Amir. Ibn Amir got up and Ibn az-Zubayr remained sitting. Mu'awiyah said to Ibn Amir: Sit down, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Let him who likes people to stand up before him prepare his place in Hell

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5242
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: فِي الإِنْسَانِ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ وَسِتُّونَ مَفْصِلاً فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ عَنْ كُلِّ مَفْصِلٍ مِنْهُ بِصَدَقَةٍ
translit: fī al-insāni thalāthumāʾatin wasittūna mafṣilan faʿalayhi an yataṣaddaqa ʿan kulli mafṣilin minhu biṣadaqatin
english_full: Narrated Abu Buraydah: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A human being has three hundred and sixty joints for each of which he must give alms. The people asked him: Who is capable of doing this ? He replied: It may be mucus in the mosque which you bury, and something which you remove from the road; but if you do not find such, two rak'ahs in the forenoon will be sufficient for you

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5243
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: يُصْبِحُ عَلَى كُلِّ سُلاَمَى مِنِ ابْنِ آدَمَ صَدَقَةٌ تَسْلِيمُهُ عَلَى مَنْ لَقِيَ صَدَقَةٌ وَأَمْرُهُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ صَدَقَةٌ وَنَهْيُهُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِمَاطَتُهُ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةٌ وَبُضْعَتُهُ أَهْلَهُ صَدَقَةٌ
translit: yuṣbiḥu ʿalā kulli sulāmā mini ābni ādama ṣadaqatun taslīmuhu ʿalā man laqiya ṣadaqatun wa-amruhu bi-l-maʿrūfi ṣadaqatun wanahyuhu ʿani al-munkari ṣadaqatun wa-imāṭatuhu al-adhā ʿani aṭ-ṭarīqi ṣadaqatun wabuḍʿatuhu ahlah ṣadaqatun
english_full: Narrated AbuDharr: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: In the morning alms are due from every bone in man's fingers and toes. Salutation to everyone he meets is alms; enjoining good is alms; forbidding what is disreputable is alms; removing what is harmful from the road is alms; having sexual intercourse with his wife is alms. The people asked: He fulfils his desire, Messenger of Allah; is it alms? He replied: Tell me if he fulfilled his desire where he had no right, would he commit a sin ? He then said: Two rak'ahs which one prays in the forenoon serve instead of all that. Abu Dawud said: Hammad did not mention enjoining good and forbidding what is disreputable

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5245
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: نَزَعَ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ إِمَّا كَانَ فِي شَجَرَةٍ فَقَطَعَهُ وَأَلْقَاهُ وَإِمَّا كَانَ مَوْضُوعًا فَأَمَاطَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهَا فَأَدْخَلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ
translit: nazaʿa rajulun lam yaʿmal khayran qaṭṭu ghuṣna shawkin ʿani aṭ-ṭarīqi immā kāna fī shajaratin faqaṭaʿah wa-āhu wa-immā kāna mawḍūʿan fa-amāṭah fashakara-Llāh lah bihā fa-adkhalah al-jannaha
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A man never did a good deed but removed a thorny branch from the road; it was either in the tree and someone cut it and threw it on the road, or it was lying in it, he removed it. Allah accepted this good deed of his and brought him into Paradise

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5247
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِذَا نِمْتُمْ فَأَطْفِئُوا سُرُجَكُمْ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَدُلُّ مِثْلَ هَذِهِ عَلَى هَذَا فَتَحْرِقَكُمْ
translit: idhā nimtum fa-aṭfiʾūā surujakum fa-inna ash-shayṭāna yadullu mithla hadhihi ʿalā hadhā fataḥriqakum
english_full: Ibn ‘Abbas said:A mouse came dragging a wick and dropped before the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) on the mat on which he was sitting with the result that it burned a hole in it about the size of dirham. He (the prophet) said: When you go to sleep, extinguish your lamps, for the devil guides a creature like this to do thus and sets you on fire

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5248
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَا سَالَمْنَاهُنَّ مُنْذُ حَارَبْنَاهُنَّ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ شَيْئًا مِنْهُنَّ خِيفَةً فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا
translit: mā sālamnāhunna mundhu ḥārabnāhunna waman taraka shayʾan minhunna khīfatan falaysa minnā
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: We have not made peace with them since we fought with them, so he who leaves any of them alone through fear does not belong to us

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5250
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْحَيَّاتِ مَخَافَةَ طَلَبِهِنَّ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا مَا سَالَمْنَاهُنَّ مُنْذُ حَارَبْنَاهُنَّ
translit: man taraka al-ḥayyāti makhāfaha ṭalabihinna falaysa minnā mā sālamnāhunna mundhu ḥārabnāhunna
english_full: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: He who leaves the snakes along through fear of their pursuit, does not belong to us. We have not made peace with them since we have fought with them

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5252
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: اقْتُلُوا الْحَيَّاتِ وَذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ وَالأَبْتَرَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَلْتَمِسَانِ الْبَصَرَ وَيُسْقِطَانِ الْحَبَلَ
translit: āqtulūā al-ḥayyāti wadhā aṭ-ṭufyatayni wa-l-abtara fa-innahumā yaltamisāni al-baṣara wayusqiṭāni al-ḥabala
english_full: Ibn ‘Umar reported the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) as saying:Kill snakes, kill those which have two streaks and those with small tails, for they obliterate the eyesight and cause miscarriage. Salim said: ‘Abd Allah(b. ‘Umar) used to kill every snake which he found. Abu Lubabah or Zaid b. al-Khattab saw him chasing a snake. He said: He(the Prophet) prohibited house-snakes

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5257
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَسْلَمُوا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ أَحَدًا مِنْهُمْ فَحَذِّرُوهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ إِنْ بَدَا لَكُمْ بَعْدُ أَنْ تَقْتُلُوهُ فَاقْتُلُوهُ بَعْدَ الثَّلاَثِ
translit: inna nafaran mina al-jinni aslamūā bi-l-madīnah fa-idhā raʾaytum aḥadan minhum faḥadhirūhu thalātha marrātin thumma in badā lakum baʿdu an taqtulūhu fāqtulūhu baʿda ath-thalāthi
english_full: Abu al-Sa’ib said I went to visit Abu Sa’ld al-Khudri, and while I was sitting I heard a movement under under his couch. When I looked and found a snake there, I got up. Abu Sa’ld said:what is with you? I said : Here is a snake. He said : what do you want ? I said : I shall kill it. He then pointed to a room in his house in front of his room and said : My cousin (son of my uncle) was in this room. He asked his permission to go to his wife on the occasion of the battle of Troops (Ahzab), as he was recently married. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) gave him permission and ordered him to take his weapon with him. He came to his house and found his wife standing at the door of the house. When he pointed to her with the lance, she said; do not make haste till you see what has brought me out. He entered the house and found an ugly snake there. He pierced in the lance while it was quivering. He said : I do not know which of them died first, the man or the snake. His people then came to the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) and said: supplicate Allah to restore our companion to life for us. He said : Ask forgiveness for your Companion. Then he said : In Medina a group of Jinn have embraced Islam, so when you see one of them, pronounce a waring to it three times and if it appears to you after that, kill it after three days

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5259
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: فَآذِنُوهُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ بَدَا لَكُمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَاقْتُلُوهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ
translit: fadhinūhu thalāthaha ayyāmin fa-in badā lakum baʿda dhalika fāqtulūhu fa-innamā huwa shayṭānun
english_full: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri in a similar manner through a different chain of narrators. This version is more perfect. In this version he said :give it a warning for three days; if it appears to you after that, then kill it, for it is only a devil

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5263
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: مَنْ قَتَلَ وَزَغَةً فِي أَوَّلِ ضَرْبَةٍ فَلَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا حَسَنَةً وَمَنْ قَتَلَهَا فِي الضَّرْبَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَلَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا حَسَنَةً أَدْنَى مِنَ الأَوَّلِ وَمَنْ قَتَلَهَا فِي الضَّرْبَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ فَلَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا حَسَنَةً أَدْنَى مِنَ الثَّانِيَةِ
translit: man qatala wazaghatan fī awwali ḍarbatin falah kadhā wakadhā ḥasanatan waman qatalahā fī aḍ-ḍarbah ath-thāniyah falah kadhā wakadhā ḥasanatan adnā mina al-awwali waman qatalahā fī aḍ-ḍarbah ath-thālithah falah kadhā wakadhā ḥasanatan adnā mina ath-thāniyah
english_full: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone kills a gecko with the first blow, such and such number of good deeds will be recorded for him, if he kills it with the second blow, such and such number of good deeds will be recorded for him less than the former; and if he kills it with the third blow, such and such number of good deeds will be recorded for him, less than the former

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5265
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: نَزَلَ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ فَلَدَغَتْهُ نَمْلَةٌ فَأَمَرَ بِجَهَازِهِ فَأُخْرِجَ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَأُحْرِقَتْ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ فَهَلاَّ نَمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً
translit: nazala nabiyyun mina al-anbiyāʾi taḥta shajaratin faladaghathu namlatun fa-amara bijahāzihi fa-ukhrija min taḥtihā thumma amara bihā fa-uḥriqat fa-awḥā-Llāh ilayhi fahallā namlatan wāḥidatan
english_full: Abu hurairah reported the prophet (peace be upon him) as saying :A prophet got down beneath a tree and he was stung by an ant. He ordered regarding the baggage and it was removed from beneath it. He then ordered regarding it and it was burnt. Allah then revealed to him : why not (just) one ant?

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5266
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّ نَمْلَةً قَرَصَتْ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ فَأَمَرَ بِقَرْيَةِ النَّمْلِ فَأُحْرِقَتْ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ فِي أَنْ قَرَصَتْكَ نَمْلَةٌ أَهْلَكْتَ أُمَّةً مِنَ الأُمَمِ تُسَبِّحُ
translit: inna namlatan qaraṣat nabiyyan mina al-anbiyāʾi fa-amara biqaryah an-namli fa-uḥriqat fa-awḥā-Llāh ilayhi fī an qaraṣatka namlatun ahlakta ummatan mina al-umami tusabbiḥu
english_full: Abu Hurairah reported Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying :An ant stung a prophet. He ordered a colony of ants to be burned. Allah revealed to him : because an ant stung you, you have perished a community which glorifies Me

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5270
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: إِنَّهُ لاَ يَصِيدُ صَيْدًا وَلاَ يَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا وَإِنَّمَا يَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ وَيَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ
translit: innah lā yaṣīdu ṣaydan walā yankaʾu ʿaduwwan wa-innamā yafqaʾu al-ʿayna wayaksiru as-sinna
english_full: ‘Abd b. Mughaffal said :The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited throwing pebbles (in sport) saying : game is not caught by such means. Neither is an enemy injured, but it may sometimes put out an eye or break a tooth

title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5272
lede: General Behavior (Kitab Al-Adab)
arabic: اسْتَأْخِرْنَ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَكُنَّ أَنْ تَحْقُقْنَ الطَّرِيقَ عَلَيْكُنَّ بِحَافَاتِ الطَّرِيقِ
translit: āstaʾkhirna fa-innah laysa lakunna an taḥquqna aṭ-ṭarīqa ʿalaykunna biḥāfāti aṭ-ṭarīqi
english_full: Narrated AbuUsayd al-Ansari: AbuUsayd heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say when he was coming out of the mosque, and men and women were mingled in the road: Draw back, for you must not walk in the middle of the road; keep to the sides of the road. Then women were keeping so close to the wall that their garments were rubbing against it

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1081
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْبَاءَةِ فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنْكُمُ الْبَاءَةَ فَعَلَيْهِ بِالصَّوْمِ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْمَ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ
translit: yā maʿshara ash-shabābi ʿalaykum bi-l-bāʾah fa-innah aghaḍḍu lilbaṣari wa-aḥṣanu lilfarji faman lam yastaṭiʿ minkumu al-bāʾaha faʿalayhi bi-aṣ-ṣawmi fa-inna aṣ-ṣawma lah wijāʾun
english_full: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"We went with Allah's Messenger, while we were young men who had nothing. He said: 'O young men! You should marry, for indeed it helps in lowering the gaze and protecting the private parts. Whoever among you is not able to marry, then let him fast, for indeed fasting will diminish his sexual desire

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1084
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: إِذَا خَطَبَ إِلَيْكُمْ مَنْ تَرْضَوْنَ دِينَهُ وَخُلُقَهُ فَزَوِّجُوهُ إِلاَّ تَفْعَلُوا تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ عَرِيضٌ
translit: idhā khaṭaba ilaykum man tarḍawna dīnah wakhuluqah fazawwijūhu illā tafʿalūā takun fitnatun fī al-arḍi wafasādun ʿarīḍun
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with proposes to (someone under the care) of one of you, then marry to him. If you do not do so, then there will be turmoil (Fitnah) in the land and abounding discord (Fasad)

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1085
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: إِذَا جَاءَكُمْ مَنْ تَرْضَوْنَ دِينَهُ وَخُلُقَهُ فَأَنْكِحُوهُ إِلاَّ تَفْعَلُوا تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ
translit: idhā jāʾakum man tarḍawna dīnah wakhuluqah fa-ankiḥūhu illā tafʿalūā takun fitnatun fī al-arḍi wafasādun
english_full: Abu Hatim Al-Muzani narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with comes to you then marry (her to) him. If you do not do so, then there will be turmoil (Fitnah) in the land and discord (Fasad). If you do not do so, then there will be turmoil (Fitnah) in the land and discord (Fasad)." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! What if there was something about him?" He said: "When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with comes to you then marry him." (And he (pbuh) said this) three times

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1086
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تُنْكَحُ عَلَى دِينِهَا وَمَالِهَا وَجَمَالِهَا فَعَلَيْكَ بِذَاتِ الدِّينِ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكَ
translit: inna al-marʾaha tunkaḥu ʿalā dīnihā wamālihā wajamālihā faʿalayka bidhāti ad-dīni taribat yadāka
english_full: Jabir narrated that:The Prophet said: "Indeed the woman is married for her religion, her wealth, and her beauty, so take the one with religion, and may your hands be dusty

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1099
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: إِنَّهُ اتَّبَعَنَا رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَنَا حِينَ دَعَوْتَنَا فَإِنْ أَذِنْتَ لَهُ دَخَلَ
translit: innah āttabaʿanā rajulun lam yakun maʿanā ḥīna daʿawtanā fa-in adhinta lah dakhala
english_full: Abu Mas'ud narrated:"A man named Abu Shu'aib came to a slave of his, who was a butcher, and said: 'Prepare some food for me that will be sufficient for five, for I have seen hunger in the face of the Messenger of Allah.' So he prepared some food. Then he sent a message to the Prophet inviting him and those who were sitting with him. When the Prophet stood, he was followed by a man who was not with them when they were invited. When the Messenger of Allah arrive at the door he said to the owner of the house: 'A man who was not with us when you invited us followed us, if you permit him, he will enter.'" He said: We have permitted him, let him enter

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1102
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ نُكِحَتْ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ وَلِيِّهَا فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَإِنْ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا فَإِنِ اشْتَجَرُوا فَالسُّلْطَانُ وَلِيُّ مَنْ لاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ
translit: ayyumā āmraʾatin nukiḥat bighayri idhni waliyyihā fanikāḥuhā bāṭilun fanikāḥuhā bāṭilun fanikāḥuhā bāṭilun fa-in dakhala bihā falahā al-mahru bimā āstaḥalla min farjihā fa-ini āshtajarūā fa-as-sulṭānu waliyyu man lā waliyya lah
english_full: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whichever woman married without the permission of her Wali her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid. If he entered into her, then the Mahr is for her in lieu of what he enjoyed from her private part. If they disagree, then the Sultan is the Wali for one who has no Wali

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1105
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: التَّشَهُّدُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
translit: at-tashahhudu fī aṣ-ṣalāhi at-taḥiyyātu lillāh wa-aṣ-ṣalawātu wa-aṭ-ṭayyibātu as-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuhā an-nabiyyu waraḥmah Allāh wabarakātuhu as-salāmu ʿalaynā waʿalā ʿibādi-Llāh aṣ-ṣāliḥīna ashhadu an lā ilaha illā-Llāh wa-ashhadu anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu warasūluhu
english_full: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"The Messenger of Allah taught us the Tashah-hud for Salat and the Tashah-hud for Al-Hajjah." He said: "The Tashah-hud for Salat is: (At-Tahiyyatulilah, was-walawtu wat-tayyibatu. As-Salamu alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullilahi wa barakatuhu, As-Salamu alina wa ala ibadillahis-salihin. Ashahadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduha wa Raduluh.) 'All greetings, prayers, and pure words are for Allah. Peace be upon you O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and all of the righteous worshippers of Allah. I testify that none has the right to be worshiped but Allah. and I testify that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger."And the Tashah-hud for Al-Hajjah is: 'Indeed all praise is due to Allah, we seek His aid, and we seek His forgiveness, and we seek refuge with Allah from the evils of our souls and the mischief of our deeds. (Innal-Hamdlillahi nasta'inuhu, wa nastaghfirhu, wa na'udhu billahi min sharuri anfusina, wa sayy'ita a'malina, man yahdihi, sala mudilla lahu, wa manyudlil, fala Hadiya lahu, wa ashadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa Rasuluh) 'Whoever He guides - meaning Allah - then here is none to lead him astray, and whomever He misleads, then there is no guide for him. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His worshipper and Messenger.'" He said: "And he recited three Ayat

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1107
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: لاَ تُنْكَحُ الثَّيِّبُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْمَرَ وَلاَ تُنْكَحُ الْبِكْرُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْذَنَ وَإِذْنُهَا الصُّمُوتُ
translit: lā tunkaḥu ath-thayyibu ḥattā tustaʾmara walā tunkaḥu al-bikru ḥattā tustaʾdhana wa-idhnuhā aṣ-ṣumūtu
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "A matron should not be given in marriage until she is consulted, and a virgin should not be given in marriage until her permission is sought, and her silence is her permission

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1109
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: الْيَتِيمَةُ تُسْتَأْمَرُ فِي نَفْسِهَا فَإِنْ صَمَتَتْ فَهُوَ إِذْنُهَا وَإِنْ أَبَتْ فَلاَ جَوَازَ عَلَيْهَا
translit: al-yatīmah tustaʾmaru fī nafsihā fa-in ṣamatat fahuwa idhnuhā wa-in abat falā jawāza ʿalayhā
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "An orphan is to be consulted about herself, then if she is silent that is her permission, and if she refuses, then do not authorize it (the marriage) for her" (meaning: when she attains the age of puberty and refuses it)

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1123
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: لاَ جَلَبَ وَلاَ جَنَبَ وَلاَ شِغَارَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ وَمَنِ انْتَهَبَ نُهْبَةً فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا
translit: lā jalaba walā janaba walā shighāra fī al-islāmi wamani āntahaba nuhbatan falaysa minnā
english_full: Imran bin Husain narrated that :The Prophet said: "There is no Jalab, no Janab, and no Shighar in Islam. And whoever takes some property by force, then he is not from us

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1134
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: أَمَّا أَبُو جَهْمٍ فَرَجُلٌ لاَ يَرْفَعُ عَصَاهُ عَنِ النِّسَاءِ وَأَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ فَصُعْلُوكٌ لاَ مَالَ لَهُ وَلَكِنِ انْكِحِي أُسَامَةَ
translit: ammā abū jahmin farajulun lā yarfaʿu ʿaṣāhu ʿani an-nisāʾi wa-ammā muʿāwiyah faṣuʿlūkun lā māla lah walakini ānkiḥī usāmaha
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "A man is not to sell over his brother's sale, nor is he to propose to whom his brother has proposed

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1135
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: إِنَّ بَيْتَ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ بَيْتٌ يَغْشَاهُ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَلَكِنِ اعْتَدِّي فِي بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَعَسَى أَنْ تُلْقِي ثِيَابَكِ فَلاَ يَرَاكِ فَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُكِ فَجَاءَ أَحَدٌ يَخْطُبُكِ فَآذِنِينِي
translit: inna bayta ummi sharīkin baytun yaghshāhu al-muhājirūna walakini āʿtaddī fī bayti ābni ummi maktūmin faʿasā an tulqī thiyābaki falā yarāki fa-idhā ānqaḍat ʿiddatuki fajāʾa aḥadun yakhṭubuki fadhinīnī
english_full: Abu Bakr bin Al-Jahm narrated:"Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman and I visited Fatimah bint Qais. She narrated to us that her husband had divorced her three times, and he did not leave her with anywhere to live nor any wealth. She said: 'He left ten Aqfizah for me with the son of his uncle: five were of barley, five of wheat.' She said: 'I went to the Messenger of Allah and mentioned that to him.' She said: 'He said: 'He is correct.'" (She said: ) 'So he ordered me to complete my Iddah in the home of Umm Sharik. But then the Messenger of Allah said to me: "Umm Sharik's home is visited by Muhajirun, so spend your Iddah in the home of Ibn Umm Maktum, for there you can remove your garments and he will not see you. Then when your Iddah is completed and someone proposed to you come to me." 'So when my Iddah completed. Abu Jahm and Mu'awiyah proposed to me.' She said: 'I went to the Messenger of Allah and mentioned that to him, and he said: "As for Mu'awiyah, he is a man with no wealth, and as for Abu Jahm he is a man who is harsh with women." She said: 'Then Usamah bin Zaid proposed to me, and he married me. So Allah blessed me with Usamah

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1141
lede: The Book on Marriage
arabic: إِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ امْرَأَتَانِ فَلَمْ يَعْدِلْ بَيْنَهُمَا جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَشِقُّهُ سَاقِطٌ
translit: idhā kāna ʿinda ar-rajuli āmraʾatāni falam yaʿdil baynahumā jāʾa yawma al-qiyāmah washiqquhu sāqiṭun
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When a man has two wives and he is not just between them, he will come on the Day of Judgment with one side drooping

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1181
lede: The Book on Divorce and Li'an
arabic: لاَ نَذْرَ لاِبْنِ آدَمَ فِيمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ وَلاَ عِتْقَ لَهُ فِيمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ وَلاَ طَلاَقَ لَهُ فِيمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ
translit: lā nadhra libni ādama fīmā lā yamliku walā ʿitqa lah fīmā lā yamliku walā ṭalāqa lah fīmā lā yamliku
english_full: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his grandfather, from his father, that:The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no vow for the son of Adam over what he has no control, and there is no emancipating he can do for one whom he does not own, and there is no divorce for him regarding that which he has no control over

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1183
lede: The Book on Divorce and Li'an
arabic: تَجَاوَزَ اللَّهُ لأُمَّتِي مَا حَدَّثَتْ بِهِ أَنْفُسَهَا مَا لَمْ تَكَلَّمْ بِهِ أَوْ تَعْمَلْ بِهِ
translit: tajāwaza-Llāh lʾummatī mā ḥaddathat bihi anfusahā mā lam takallam bihi aw taʿmal bihi
english_full: Abu Hurairah narraed that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Allah has permitted my Ummah what occurs in their mines, as long as it is not spoken or acted upon

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1186
lede: The Book on Divorce and Li'an
arabic: أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ اخْتَلَعَتْ مِنْ زَوْجِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ بَأْسٍ لَمْ تَرِحْ رَائِحَةَ الْجَنَّةِ
translit: ayyumā āmraʾatin ākhtalaʿat min zawjihā min ghayri baʾsin lam tariḥ rāʾiḥaha al-jannah
english_full: Thawban narrated that:The Prophet said: "The women who seek a Khul are hypocrites

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1188
lede: The Book on Divorce and Li'an
arabic: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ كَالضِّلَعِ إِنْ ذَهَبْتَ تُقِيمُهَا كَسَرْتَهَا وَإِنْ تَرَكْتَهَا اسْتَمْتَعْتَ بِهَا عَلَى عِوَجٍ
translit: inna al-marʾaha ka-aḍ-ḍilaʿi in dhahabta tuqīmuhā kasartahā wa-in taraktahā āstamtaʿta bihā ʿalā ʿiwajin
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed the woman is like a rib, if you try to straighten her you will break her, and if you leave her, what you enjoy from her will be with the crookedness

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1900
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: الْوَالِدُ أَوْسَطُ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَضِعْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابَ أَوِ احْفَظْهُ
translit: al-wālidu awsaṭu abwābi al-jannah fa-in shiʾta fa-aḍiʿ dhalika al-bāba awi āḥfaẓhu
english_full: Abu 'Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami narrated from Abu Ad Darda'.:He said that a man came and said : "I have a wife whom my mother has ordered me to divorce." So Abu Ad-Darda said: " I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'The father is the middle gate to Paradise. So if you wish, then neglect that door, or protect it

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1905
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: ثَلاَثُ دَعَوَاتٍ مُسْتَجَابَاتٌ لاَ شَكَّ فِيهِنَّ دَعْوَةُ الْمَظْلُومِ وَدَعْوَةُ الْمُسَافِرِ وَدَعْوَةُ الْوَالِدِ عَلَى وَلَدِهِ
translit: thalāthu daʿawātin mustajābātun lā shakka fīhinna daʿwah al-maẓlūmi wadaʿwah al-musāfiri wadaʿwah al-wālidi ʿalā waladihi
english_full: Abu Harairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Three supplications are accepted , there is no doubt in them (about them being accepted): The supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveler, and the supplication of his father against his son

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1906
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: لاَ يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدًا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ
translit: lā yajzī waladun wa-ad-dan illā an yajidah mamlūkan fayashtariyah fayuʿtiqah
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: "A son could not do enough for his father, unless he found him as a slave and purchased him to set him free

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1907
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ وَأَنَا الرَّحْمَنُ خَلَقْتُ الرَّحِمَ وَشَقَقْتُ لَهَا مِنَ اسْمِي فَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلْتُهُ وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا بَتَتُّهُ
translit: qāla-Llāh anā-Llāh wa-anā ar-raḥmanu khalaqtu ar-raḥima washaqaqtu lahā mina āsmī faman waṣalahā waṣaltuhu waman qaṭaʿahā batattuhu
english_full: Abu Salamah said:" Abu[Ar-Raddad] Al-Laithi complained(of an illness). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf visited him. He said: 'The best of you, and the most apt to maintain good relations, as far as I know, is Abu Muhammad('Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf' said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying : "Allah, Most Blessed and Most High, said: 'I am Allah, and I am Ar-Rahman. I created the Rahim(womb), and named it after My Name. So whoever keeps good relations with it, I keep good relation with him, and whoever severs it, I am finished with him

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1913
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْبَنَاتِ فَصَبَرَ عَلَيْهِنَّ كُنَّ لَهُ حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ
translit: mani ābtuliya bishayʾin mina al-banāti faṣabara ʿalayhinna kunna lah ḥijāban mina an-nāri
english_full: Aishah narrated that the:Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever is tried with something from daughters, and he is patient with them, they will be a barrier from the Fire for him

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1937
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ يَئِسَ أَنْ يَعْبُدَهُ الْمُصَلُّونَ وَلَكِنْ فِي التَّحْرِيشِ بَيْنَهُمْ
translit: inna ash-shayṭāna qad yaʾisa an yaʿbudah al-muṣallūna walakin fī at-taḥrīshi baynahum
english_full: Jabir narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Indeed Ash-Shaitan has despaired of getting those who perform Salat to worship him.But he is engaged in sowing hatred among them

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1939
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: لاَ يَحِلُّ الْكَذِبُ إِلاَّ فِي ثَلاَثٍ يُحَدِّثُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ لِيُرْضِيَهَا وَالْكَذِبُ فِي الْحَرْبِ وَالْكَذِبُ لِيُصْلِحَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ
translit: lā yaḥillu al-kadhibu illā fī thalāthin yuḥaddithu ar-rajulu āmraʾatah liyurḍiyahā wa-l-kadhibu fī al-ḥarbi wa-l-kadhibu liyuṣliḥa bayna an-nāsi
english_full: Asma bint Yazid narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"it is not lawful to lie except in three cases: Something the man tells his wife to please her, to lie during war, and to lie in order to bring peace between the people

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1944
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: خَيْرُ الأَصْحَابِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرُهُمْ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَخَيْرُ الْجِيرَانِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرُهُمْ لِجَارِهِ
translit: khayru al-aṣḥābi ʿinda-Llāh khayruhum liṣāḥibihi wakhayru al-jīrāni ʿinda-Llāh khayruhum lijārihi
english_full: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1947
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَنْ قَذَفَ مَمْلُوكَهُ بَرِيئًا مِمَّا قَالَ لَهُ أَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ كَمَا قَالَ
translit: man qadhafa mamlūkah barīʾan mimmā qāla lah aqāma ʿalayhi al-ḥadda yawma al-qiyāmah illā an yakūna kamā qāla
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul-Qasim, the Prophet of Repentance, said :"If somebody slanders his slave (by accusing him of committing illegal sexual intercourse) and the slave is innocent from what he says, Allah will impose the punishment upon him on the Day of Resurrection, unless it is as he said about him

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1957
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَنْ مَنَحَ مَنِيحَةَ لَبَنٍ أَوْ وَرِقٍ أَوْ هَدَى زُقَاقًا كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ عِتْقِ رَقَبَةٍ
translit: man manaḥa manīḥaha labanin aw wariqin aw hadā zuqāqan kāna lah mithlu ʿitqi raqabatin
english_full: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"Whoever gives someone some milk or silver, or guides him through a strait, then he will have the reward similar to freeing a slave

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1958
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي فِي طَرِيقٍ إِذْ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ فَأَخَّرَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ
translit: baynamā rajulun yamshī fī ṭarīqin idh wajada ghuṣna shawkin fa-akharah fashakara-Llāh lah faghafara lah
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"When a man was walking on the road, he found a thorny branch and removed it. Allah appreciated his action by forgiving him

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1966
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: أَفْضَلُ الدِّينَارِ دِينَارٌ يُنْفِقُهُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى عِيَالِهِ وَدِينَارٌ يُنْفِقُهُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَدِينَارٌ يُنْفِقُهُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
translit: afḍalu ad-dīnāri dīnārun yunfiquhu ar-rajulu ʿalā ʿiyālihi wadīnārun yunfiquhu ar-rajulu ʿalā dābbatihi fī sabīli-Llāh wadīnārun yunfiquhu ar-rajulu ʿalā aṣḥābihi fī sabīli-Llāh
english_full: Thawban narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The most virtuous of the Dinar is the Dinar spent by a man on his dependants, and the Dinar spent by a man on his beast in the Cause of Allah, and the Dinar spent by a man on his companions in the Cause of Allah." Abu Qilabah (one of the narrators) said: " He began with the dependants." Then he said: "And which man is greater in reward than a man who spends upon his depandants, having little ones by which Allah causes him to abstain (from the unlawful) and by which Allah enriches him

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1967
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ وَالضِّيَافَةُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ
translit: yawmun walaylatun wa-aḍ-ḍiyāfah thalāthah ayyāmin wamā kāna baʿda dhalika fahuwa ṣadaqatun waman kāna yuʾminu billāh wa-l-yawmi al-ākhiri falyaqul khayran aw liyaskut
english_full: Abu Shuraih Al-'Adawf said:"My eyes saw the Messenger of Allah, and my ears heard him speaking when he was speaking and he said: 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then let him honor his guest with his reward.' They said: 'What is the reward?' He said: ' A day and a night.' He said: 'And hospitality is for three days, whatever is beyond that is charity. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then let him say what is good or keep silent

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1968
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: الضِّيَافَةُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَجَائِزَتُهُ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ وَمَا أُنْفِقَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَثْوِيَ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى يُحْرِجَهُ
translit: aḍ-ḍiyāfah thalāthah ayyāmin wajāʾizatuhu yawmun walaylatun wamā unfiqa ʿalayhi baʿda dhalika fahuwa ṣadaqatun walā yaḥillu lah an yathwiya ʿindah ḥattā yuḥrijah
english_full: Abu Shuraih Al-Kabi narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: "Hospitality is for three days, and his reward is a day and a night, and whatever is spent on him after that is charity. And it is not lawful for him (the guest) to stay so long as to cause him harm

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1970
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَإِنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ وَأَنْ تُفْرِغَ مِنْ دَلْوِكَ فِي إِنَاءِ أَخِيكَ
translit: kullu maʿrūfin ṣadaqatun wa-inna mina al-maʿrūfi an talqā akhāka biwajhin ṭalqin wa-an tufrigha min dalwika fī ināʾi akhīka
english_full: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Every good is charity. Indeed among the good is to meet your brother with a smiling face, and to pour what is left in your bucket into the vessel of your brother

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1974
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَا كَانَ الْفُحْشُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ شَانَهُ وَمَا كَانَ الْحَيَاءُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ زَانَهُ
translit: mā kāna al-fuḥshu fī shayʾin illā shānah wamā kāna al-ḥayāʾu fī shayʾin illā zānah
english_full: Anas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Al-Fuhsh is not present in anything but it mars it, and Al-Haya' is not present in anything but it beautifies it

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1977
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: لَيْسَ الْمُؤْمِنُ بِالطَّعَّانِ وَلاَ اللَّعَّانِ وَلاَ الْفَاحِشِ وَلاَ الْبَذِيءِ
translit: laysa al-muʾminu bi-aṭ-ṭaʿʿāni walā al-laʿʿāni walā al-fāḥishi walā al-badhīʾi
english_full: Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The believer does not insult the honor of others, nor curse, nor commit Fahishah, nor is he foul

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1978
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: لاَ تَلْعَنِ الرِّيحَ فَإِنَّهَا مَأْمُورَةٌ وَإِنَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ شَيْئًا لَيْسَ لَهُ بِأَهْلٍ رَجَعَتِ اللَّعْنَةُ عَلَيْهِ
translit: lā talʿani ar-rīḥa fa-innahā maʾmūratun wa-innah man laʿana shayʾan laysa lah biʾahlin rajaʿati al-laʿnah ʿalayhi
english_full: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that a man cursed the wind in the presence of the Prophet, so he said:"Do not curse the wind, for it is merely doing as ordered , and whoever curses something undeservingly, then the curse returns upon him

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1979
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: تَعَلَّمُوا مِنْ أَنْسَابِكُمْ مَا تَصِلُونَ بِهِ أَرْحَامَكُمْ فَإِنَّ صِلَةَ الرَّحِمِ مَحَبَّةٌ فِي الأَهْلِ مَثْرَاةٌ فِي الْمَالِ مَنْسَأَةٌ فِي الأَثَرِ
translit: taʿallamūā min ansābikum mā taṣilūna bihi arḥāmakum fa-inna ṣilaha ar-raḥimi maḥabbatun fī al-ahli mathrātun fī al-māli mansaʾatun fī al-athari
english_full: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Learn enough about your lineage to facilitate keeping your ties of kinship. For indeed keeping the ties of kinship encourages affection among the relatives, increases the wealth, and increases the lifespan

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1984
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تُرَى ظُهُورُهَا مِنْ بُطُونِهَا وَبُطُونُهَا مِنْ ظُهُورِهَا
translit: inna fī al-jannah ghurafan turā ẓuhūruhā min buṭūnihā wabuṭūnuhā min ẓuhūrihā
english_full: Ali narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Indeed in Paradise there are chambers, whose outside can be seen from their inside, and their inside can be seen from their outside." A Bedouin stood and said : 'Who are they for, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "For those who speak well, feed others, fast regularly, and perform salat [for Allah] during the night while the people sleep

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1996
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ مَنْ تَرَكَهُ النَّاسُ أَوْ وَدَعَهُ النَّاسُ اتِّقَاءَ فُحْشِهِ
translit: yā ʿāʾishah inna min sharri an-nāsi man tarakah an-nāsu aw wadaʿah an-nāsu āttiqāʾa fuḥshihi
english_full: Aisha narrated:"A man sought permission to enter upon the Messenger of Allah while I was with him, so he said: 'What an evil son of his tribe, or brother of his tribe.' Then he admitted him and spoke with him. When he left, I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! You said what you said about him. Then you talked politely with him?' He said: 'O 'Aishah! Indeed among the evilest of people are those whom the people avoid, or who the people leave, fearing his filthy speech

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1997
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: أَحْبِبْ حَبِيبَكَ هَوْنًا مَا عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ بَغِيضَكَ يَوْمًا مَا وَأَبْغِضْ بَغِيضَكَ هَوْنًا مَا عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ حَبِيبَكَ يَوْمًا مَا
translit: aḥbib ḥabībaka hawnan mā ʿasā an yakūna baghīḍaka yawman mā wa-abghiḍ baghīḍaka hawnan mā ʿasā an yakūna ḥabībaka yawman mā
english_full: Muhammad bin Sirin narrated from Abu Hurairah - and I think he (narrated it from the Prophet) who said:"Love your beloved moderately, perhaps he becomes hated to you someday. And hate whom you hate moderately, perhaps he becomes your beloved someday

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1998
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ وَلاَ يَدْخُلُ النَّارَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ
translit: lā yadkhulu al-jannaha man kāna fī qalbihi mithqālu ḥabbatin min khardalin min kibrin walā yadkhulu an-nāra man kāna fī qalbihi mithqālu ḥabbatin min īmānin
english_full: Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever has a mustard seed's weight of pride (arrogance) in his heart, shall not be admitted into Paradise. And whoever has a mustard seed's weight of faith in his heart, shall not be admitted into the Fire

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 1999
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ وَلَكِنَّ الْكِبْرَ مَنْ بَطَرَ الْحَقَّ وَغَمَصَ النَّاسَ
translit: inna-Llāh yuḥibbu al-jamāla walakinna al-kibra man baṭara al-ḥaqqa waghamaṣa an-nāsa
english_full: Abdullah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever has a speck of pride (arrogance) in his heart, shall not be admitted into Paradise. And whoever has a speck of faith in his heart, shall not be admitted in to the Fire.'" He said: "So a man said to him: 'I like for my clothes to be nice, and my sandals to be nice?' So he said: 'Indeed Allah loves beauty. But pride is refusing the truth and belittling the people

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 2002
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَا شَيْءٌ أَثْقَلُ فِي مِيزَانِ الْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ خُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَبْغَضُ الْفَاحِشَ الْبَذِيءَ
translit: mā shayʾun athqalu fī mīzāni al-muʾmini yawma al-qiyāmah min khuluqin ḥasanin wa-inna-Llāh layabghaḍu al-fāḥisha al-badhīʾa
english_full: Abu Ad-Dardh narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Nothing is heavier on the believer's Scale on the Day of Judgment than good character. For indeed Allah, Most High, is angered by the shameless obscene person

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 2003
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ يُوضَعُ فِي الْمِيزَانِ أَثْقَلُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ وَإِنَّ صَاحِبَ حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ لَيَبْلُغُ بِهِ دَرَجَةَ صَاحِبِ الصَّوْمِ وَالصَّلاَةِ
translit: mā min shayʾin yūḍaʿu fī al-mīzāni athqalu min ḥusni al-khuluqi wa-inna ṣāḥiba ḥusni al-khuluqi layablughu bihi darajaha ṣāḥibi aṣ-ṣawmi wa-aṣ-ṣalāhi
english_full: Abu Ad-Dardh narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Nothing is placed on the Scale that is heavier than good character. Indeed the person with good character will have attained the rank of the person of fasting and prayer

title: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī 2008
lede: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives
arabic: مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ زَارَ أَخًا لَهُ فِي اللَّهِ نَادَاهُ مُنَادٍ أَنْ طِبْتَ وَطَابَ مَمْشَاكَ وَتَبَوَّأْتَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلاً
