translit: liyattakhidh aḥadukum qalban shākiran walisānan dhākiran wazawjatan muʾminatan tuʿīnu aḥadakum ʿalā amri al-ākhirah
english_full: It was narrated that:Thawban said: “When the Verse concerning silver and gold was revealed, they said: 'What kind of wealth should we acquire?' Umar said: 'I will tell you about that.' So he rode on his camel and caught up with the Prophet, and I followed him. He said: 'O Messenger of Allah what kind of wealth should we acquire?' He said: 'Let one of you acquire a thankful heart, a tongue that remembers Allah and a believing wife who will help him with regard to the Hereafter.' ”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1864
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: إِذَا أَلْقَى اللَّهُ فِي قَلْبِ امْرِئٍ خِطْبَةَ امْرَأَةٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَيْهَا
translit: idhā alqā-Llāh fī qalbi āmriʾin khiṭbaha āmraʾatin falā baʾsa an yanẓura ilayhā
english_full: It was narrated that:Muhammad bin Salamah said: “I proposed marriage to a woman, then I hid and waited to see her until I saw her among some date palm trees that belonged to her.” It was said to him: “Do you do such a thing when you are a companion of the Messenger of Allah?” He said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'When Allah causes a man to propose to a woman, there is nothing wrong with him looking at her.' ”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1870
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: الأَيِّمُ أَوْلَى بِنَفْسِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْمَرُ فِي نَفْسِهَا
translit: al-ayyimu awlā binafsihā min waliyyihā wa-l-bikru tustaʾmaru fī nafsihā
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that:the Messenger of Allah said: “A widow has more right (to decide) concerning herself than her guardian, and a virgin should be consulted”. It was said: “O Messenger of Allah, a virgin may be too shy to speak.” He said: “Her consent is her silence.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1879
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ لَمْ يُنْكِحْهَا الْوَلِيُّ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهَا فَلَهَا مَهْرُهَا بِمَا أَصَابَ مِنْهَا فَإِنِ اشْتَجَرُوا فَالسُّلْطَانُ وَلِيُّ مَنْ لاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ
translit: ayyumā āmraʾatin lam yunkiḥhā al-waliyyu fanikāḥuhā bāṭilun fanikāḥuhā bāṭilun fanikāḥuhā bāṭilun fa-in aṣābahā falahā mahruhā bimā aṣāba minhā fa-ini āshtajarūā fa-as-sulṭānu waliyyu man lā waliyya lah
english_full: It was narrated from Aishah that :the Messenger of Allah said: “Any woman whose marriage is not arranged by her guardian, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid. If (the man) has had intercourse with her, then the Mahr belongs to her in return for his intimacy with her. And if there is any dispute then the ruler is the guardian of the one who does not have a guardian.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1882
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: لاَ تُزَوِّجُ الْمَرْأَةُ الْمَرْأَةَ وَلاَ تُزَوِّجُ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَإِنَّ الزَّانِيَةَ هِيَ الَّتِي تُزَوِّجُ نَفْسَهَا
translit: lā tuzawwiju al-marʾah al-marʾaha walā tuzawwiju al-marʾah nafsahā fa-inna az-zāniyaha hiya at-tī tuzawwiju nafsahā
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:the Messenger of Allah said: “No woman should arrange the marriage of another woman, and no woman should arrange her own marriage. The adulteress is the one who arranges her own marriage.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1893
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلاَ مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلاَ هَادِيَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ . أَمَّا بَعْدُ
translit: al-ḥamdu lillāh naḥmaduhu wanastaʿīnuhu wanaʿūdhu billāh min shurūri anfusinā wamin sayyiāti aʿmālinā man yahdihi-Llāh falā muḍilla lah waman yuḍlil falā hādiya lah wa-ashhadu an lā ilaha illā-Llāh waḥdah lā sharīka lah wa-anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu warasūluhu . ammā baʿdu
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn `Abbas that:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Al-hamdu lillahi nahmadhu wa nasta`inuhu wa na`udhu billahi min shururi anfusina wa min sayi'ati a`malina, man yahdihillahu fala mudilla lahu, wa man yudlil fala hadiya lahu. Wa ashadu an la ilaha illallahu wahduhu la sharika lahu, wa anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu. Amma ba`d. (Praise is to Allah, we praise Him and we seek His help. We seek refuge with Allah from the evil of our own souls and from our bad deeds, Whomsoever Allah guides will never be led astray; and whomsoever is led astray, no one can guide. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshiped but Allah, alone with no partner or associate, and that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger. To proceed).”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1926
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: أَوَتَفْعَلُونَ لاَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ نَسَمَةٍ قَضَى اللَّهُ لَهَا أَنْ تَكُونَ إِلاَّ هِيَ كَائِنَةٌ
translit: awatafʿalūna lā ʿalaykum an lā tafʿalūā fa-innah laysa min nasamatin qaḍā-Llāh lahā an takūna illā hiya kāʾinatun
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Kudri said:“A man asked the Messenger of about coitus interruptus. He said: 'Do you do that? If you do not do so, it will not harm; for there is no soul that (SWT) has decreed will exist but it will come into being.' “

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1939
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: فَإِنَّهَا لَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ رَبِيبَتِي فِي حِجْرِي مَا حَلَّتْ لِي إِنَّهَا ابْنَةُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ أَرْضَعَتْنِي وَأَبَاهَا ثُوَيْبَةُ فَلاَ تَعْرِضْنَ عَلَىَّ أَخَوَاتِكُنَّ وَلاَ بَنَاتِكُنَّ
translit: fa-innahā law lam takun rabībatī fī ḥijrī mā ḥallat lī innahā ābnah akhī mina ar-raḍāʿah arḍaʿatnī wa-abāhā thuwaybah falā taʿriḍna ʿalāa akhawātikunna walā banātikunna
english_full: It was narrated from 'Urwah bin Zubair that Zainab bint Abi Salmah told him that Umm Habibah told her that she said to Messenger of Allah:“Marry my sister 'Azzah.” The Messenger of Allah said: 'Would you like that? “She said: “Yes, O Messenger of Allah. I am not the only one living with you and the one who most deserves to share good thingswith me is my sister.” The Messenger of Allah said: “But that is not permissible for me.” She said: “But we throught that you wanted to marry Durrah bint Abi Salmah.” The Messenger of Allah said: The daughter of Umm Salamah?” She said: “Yes” The Messenger of Allah said: “Even if she were not my step-daughter who is under my care, she would not be permissible for me, because she is the daughter of my brother through breastfeeding. Tuwaibah breastfed both her father and I. So do not offer your sisters and daughters to me for marriage.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1956
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ جَارِيَةٌ فَأَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ أَدَبَهَا وَعَلَّمَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمَهَا ثُمَّ أَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَآمَنَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ مَمْلُوكٍ أَدَّى حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ
translit: man kānat lah jāriyatun fa-addabahā fa-aḥsana adabahā waʿallamahā fa-aḥsana taʿlīmahā thumma aʿtaqahā watazawwajahā falah ajrāni wa-ayyumā rajulin min ahli al-kitābi āmana binabiyyihi wamana bimuḥammadin falah ajrāni wa-ayyumā ʿabdin mamlūkin addā ḥaqqa-Llāh ʿalayhi waḥaqqa mawālīhi falah ajrāni
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Messenger of Allah said:'Whoever has a slave woman and teaches her good manners and educates her, then sets her free and marries her, will have two rewards. Any man from among the People of the Book who believed in his Prophet and believed in Muhammad will have two rewards. Any slave who does his duty towards Allah and towards his masters will have two rewards.” (Sahih)(one of the narrators) Salih said: “Sha'bi said: 'I have given this (Hadith) to you for little effort on your part. A rider would travel to Al-Madinah for less than this.' ”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1962
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي قَدْ كُنْتُ أَذِنْتُ لَكُمْ فِي الاِسْتِمْتَاعِ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مِنْهُنَّ شَىْءٌ فَلْيُخَلِّ سَبِيلَهَا وَلاَ تَأْخُذُوا مِمَّا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا
translit: ayyuhā an-nāsu innī qad kuntu adhintu lakum fī al-istimtāʿi alā wa-inna-Llāh qad ḥarramahā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah faman kāna ʿindah minhunna shayʾun falyukhalli sabīlahā walā taʾkhudhūā mimmā ātaytumūhunna shayʾan
english_full: It was narrated from Rabi'bin Sabrah that his father said :"We went out with the Messenger of Allah on the Farewell pilgrimage, and they said : 'O Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) celibacy has become too difficult for us'. He said : 'Then make temporary marriages with these women'. So we went to them, but they insisted on setting a fixed time between us and them. They mentioned that to the Prophet and he said : 'Set a fixed time between you and them.' So I went out with a cousin of mine. He had a cloak and I had a cloak, but his cloak was finer than mine, and I was younger than him. We came to a women and she said: 'One cloak is like another.' So I married her and stayed with her that night. Then the next day I saw the Messenger of Allah standing between the Rukn (corner) and the door (of the Ka'bah), saying : 'O people, I had permitted temporary marriage for you, but Allah has forbidden it until the Day of Resurrection. however had any temporary wives, he should let them go, and do not take back anything that you had given to them

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1967
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: إِذَا أَتَاكُمْ مَنْ تَرْضَوْنَ خُلُقَهُ وَدِينَهُ فَزَوِّجُوهُ إِلاَّ تَفْعَلُوا تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ عَرِيضٌ
translit: idhā atākum man tarḍawna khuluqah wadīnah fazawwijūhu illā tafʿalūā takun fitnatun fī al-arḍi wafasādun ʿarīḍun
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah:that the Messenger of Allah said: "If there comes to you one with whose character and religious commitment you are pleased, then marry (your daughter or female relative under your care) to him, for if you do not do that there will be Fitnah in the land and widespread corruption

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1983
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: إِلاَمَ يَجْلِدُ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَتَهُ جَلْدَ الأَمَةِ وَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُضَاجِعَهَا مِنْ آخِرِ يَوْمِهِ
translit: ilāma yajlidu aḥadukumu āmraʾatah jalda al-amah walaʿallah an yuḍājiʿahā min ākhiri yawmihi
english_full: It was narrated that 'Abduleh bin Zam'ah said:'The Prophet delivered a sermon then he made mention of women, and exhorted (the men) concerning them. Then he said: 'How long will one of you whip his wife like a slave, then lie with her at the end of the day?

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1985
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: لَقَدْ طَافَ اللَّيْلَةَ بِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ سَبْعُونَ امْرَأَةً كُلُّ امْرَأَةٍ تَشْتَكِي زَوْجَهَا فَلاَ تَجِدُونَ أُولَئِكَ خِيَارَكُمْ
translit: laqad ṭāfa al-laylaha bili muḥammadin sabʿūna āmraʾatan kullu āmraʾatin tashtakī zawjahā falā tajidūna ūlaʾika khiyārakum
english_full: It was narrated that Iyas bin 'Abdullah bin Abu Dhubab said:"The Prophet said: 'Do not beat the female slaves of Allah.' Then 'Umar came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, the woman have become bold towards their husbands? So order the beatin g of them,' and they were beaten. Then many women went around to the family of Muhammad,. The next day he said: 'Last night seventy women came to the family of Muhammad, each woman complaining about her husband. You will not find that those are the best of you

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1993
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: لاَ شُؤْمَ وَقَدْ يَكُونُ الْيُمْنُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ وَالدَّارِ
translit: lā shuʾma waqad yakūnu al-yumnu fī thalāthatin fī al-marʾah wa-l-farasi wa-ad-dāri
english_full: It was narrated from Hakim bin Mu'awiyah that his paternal uncle Mikhmar bin Mu'awiyah said:"I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Do not believe in omens, and good fortune is only to be found in three things: A woman, a horse and a house

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1996
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: مِنَ الْغَيْرَةِ مَا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ وَمِنْهَا مَا يَكْرَهُ اللَّهُ فَأَمَّا مَا يُحِبُّ فَالْغَيْرَةُ فِي الرِّيبَةِ وَأَمَّا مَا يَكْرَهُ فَالْغَيْرَةُ فِي غَيْرِ رِيبَةٍ
translit: mina al-ghayrah mā yuḥibbu-Llāh waminhā mā yakrah Allāh fa-ammā mā yuḥibbu fa-l-ghayrah fī ar-rībah wa-ammā mā yakrah fa-l-ghayrah fī ghayri rībatin
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:the Messenger of Allah said: "There is a kind of protective jealousy that Allah loves and a kind that Allah hates. As for that which Allah loves, it is protective jealousy when there are grounds for suspicion. And as for that which He hates, it is protective jealousy when there are no grounds for suspicion

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 1999
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَنْكَحْتُ أَبَا الْعَاصِ بْنَ الرَّبِيعِ فَحَدَّثَنِي فَصَدَقَنِي وَإِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي وَأَنَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَفْتِنُوهَا وَإِنَّهَا وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَجْتَمِعُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَبِنْتُ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ أَبَدًا
translit: ammā baʿdu fa-innī qad ankaḥtu abā al-ʿāṣi bna ar-rabīʿi faḥaddathanī faṣadaqanī wa-inna fāṭimaha binta muḥammadin baḍʿatun minnī wa-anā akrah an taftinūhā wa-innahā wallāh lā tajtamiʿu bintu rasūli-Llāh wabintu ʿaduwwi-Llāh ʿinda rajulin wāḥidin abadan
english_full: Ali bin Husain said that Miswar bin Makhramah told him that:'Ali bin Abu Talib proposed to the daughter of Abu Jahl, when he was married to Fatimah the daughter of the Prophet. When Fatimah heard of that she went to the Prophet, and said: "Your people are saying that you do not feel angry for your daughters. This 'Ali is going to marry the daughter of Abu Jahl." Miswar said: "The Prophet stood up, and I heard him when he bore witness (i.e., said the Shahadah), then he said: 'I married my daughter (Zainab) to Abul-As bin Rabi', and he spoke to me and was speaking the truth. Fatimah bint Muhammad is a part of me, and I hate to see her faced with troubles. By Allah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah and the daughter of the enemy of Allah will never be joined together in marriage to one man." He said: So, 'Ali abandoned the marriage proposal

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2004
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ . الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ وَاحْتَجِبِي عَنْهُ يَا سَوْدَةُ
translit: huwa laka yā ʿabdu bnu zamʿaha . al-waladu lilfirāshi wāḥtajibī ʿanhu yā sawdah
english_full: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:Ibn Zam'ah and Sa'd (Ibn Abu Waqqas) referred a dispute to the Prophet concerning the son of Zam'ah's slave woman. Sa'd said : " O Messenger of Allah my brother (Utbah bin Abu Waqqas) left instructions in his will that when I come to Makkah, I should look for the son of the slave woman of Zam'ah and take him into my care." 'Abd bin Zam’ah said: "He is my brother and the son of the slave woman of my father; he was born on my father's bed." The Prophet ffi saw that he resembled 'Utbah, and said: "He belongs to you, O 'Abd bin Zam'ah. The child is for the bed. Observe Hijab before him, O Saudah." (sahih)

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2011
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: قَدْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَنْهَى عَنِ الْغِيَالِ فَإِذَا فَارِسُ وَالرُّومُ يُغِيلُونَ فَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ أَوْلاَدَهُمْ
translit: qad aradtu an anhā ʿani al-ghiyāli fa-idhā fārisu wa-ar-rūmu yughīlūna falā yaqtulūna awlādahum
english_full: It was narrated that Judamah bint Wahb Al-Asadiyyah said:"I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'I wanted to forbid intercourse with a nursing mother, but then (I saw that) the Persians and the Romans do this, and it does not kill their children.' And I heard him say/when he was asked about coitus interruptus: 'It is the disguised form of b.rryirg children alive

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2014
lede: The Chapters on Marriage
arabic: لاَ تُؤْذِي امْرَأَةٌ زَوْجَهَا إِلاَّ قَالَتْ زَوْجَتُهُ مِنَ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ لاَ تُؤْذِيهِ قَاتَلَكِ اللَّهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ عِنْدَكِ دَخِيلٌ أَوْشَكَ أَنْ يُفَارِقَكِ إِلَيْنَا
translit: lā tuʾdhī āmraʾatun zawjahā illā qālat zawjatuhu mina al-ḥūri al-ʿīni lā tuʾdhīhi qātalaki-Llāh fa-innamā huwa ʿindaki dakhīlun awshaka an yufāriqaki ilaynā
english_full: It was narrated from Mu'adh bin Jabal that:the Messenger of Allah said: "No woman annoys her husband but his wife among houris (of Paradise) safs: 'Do not annoy him, may Allah destroy you, for he is just a temporary guest with you and soon he will leave you and join us

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2031
lede: The Chapters on Divorce
arabic: امْكُثِي فِي بَيْتِكِ الَّذِي جَاءَ فِيهِ نَعْىُ زَوْجِكِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ
translit: āmkuthī fī baytiki adh-dhī jāʾa fīhi naʿāu zawjiki ḥattā yablugha al-kitābu ajalah
english_full: It was narrated from Zainab bint Ka'b bin 'Ujrah, who was married to Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri,:that his sister Furai'ah bint Malik said: "My husband went out to pursue some slaves of his. He caught up with them at the edge of Qadumttl and they killed him. News of his death reached me when I was in one of the houses of the Ansar, far away from the house of my family and my brothers. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), there has come to me news of my husband's death and I am in a house far away from the house of my people and the house of my brothers. He did not leave any money that could be spent on me, or any inheritance, or any house I may take possession of. If you think that you could give me permission to join my family and my brothers, then that is what I prefer and is better for me in some ways.' He said: 'Do that if you wish.' Then I went out, feeling happy with the ruling of Allah given upon the lips of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), until, when I was in the mosque, or, in one of the apartments, he called me and said: 'What did you say?' I told him the story, and he said: 'Stay in the house in which the news of your husband's death came to you, until your waiting period is ever."' She said: "So I observed the waiting period there for four months and ten (days)

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2045
lede: The Chapters on Divorce
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَضَعَ عَنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَطَأَ وَالنِّسْيَانَ وَمَا اسْتُكْرِهُوا عَلَيْهِ
translit: inna-Llāh waḍaʿa ʿan ummatī al-khaṭaʾa wa-an-nisyāna wamā āstukrihūā ʿalayhi
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ) said :"Allah has forgiven my nation for mistakes and forgetfulness, and what they are forced to do

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2081
lede: The Chapters on Divorce
arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ مَا بَالُ أَحَدِكُمْ يُزَوِّجَ عَبْدَهُ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا إِنَّمَا الطَّلاَقُ لِمَنْ أَخَذَ بِالسَّاقِ
translit: yā ayyuhā an-nāsu mā bālu aḥadikum yuzawwija ʿabdah amatah thumma yurīdu an yufarriqa baynahumā innamā aṭ-ṭalāqu liman akhadha bi-as-sāqi
english_full: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:"A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, my master married me to his slave woman, and now he wants to separate me and her.' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ascended the pulpit and said: 'O people, what is the matter with one of you who marries his slave to his slave woman, then wants to separate them? Divorce belongs to the one who takes hold of the calf (i.e., her husband).’ “

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2087
lede: The Chapters on Divorce
arabic: لاَ تُحِدُّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ الْمَرْأَةُ تُحِدُّ عَلَى زَوْجِهَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا وَلاَ تَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا إِلاَّ ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ وَلاَ تَكْتَحِلُ وَلاَ تَطَيَّبُ إِلاَّ عِنْدَ أَدْنَى طُهْرِهَا بِنُبْذَةٍ مِنْ قُسْطٍ وَأَظْفَارٍ
translit: lā tuḥiddu ʿalā mayyitin fawqa thalāthin illā al-marʾah tuḥiddu ʿalā zawjihā arbaʿaha ashhurin waʿashran walā talbasu thawban maṣbūghan illā thawba ʿaṣbin walā taktaḥilu walā taṭayyabu illā ʿinda adnā ṭuhrihā binubdhatin min qusṭin wa-aẓfārin
english_full: It was narrated from Umm 'Atiyyah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:'No deceased person should be mourned for more than three days, except a woman should mourn for her husband for four months and ten days, and she should not wear dyed clothes, except for a garment of 'Asb, and she should not wear kohl or perfume, except at the beginning of her purity, when she may apply a little Qust and Azfar.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2383
lede: The Chapters on Gifts
arabic: الْعُمْرَى جَائِزَةٌ لِمَنْ أُعْمِرَهَا وَالرُّقْبَى جَائِزَةٌ لِمَنْ أُرْقِبَهَا
translit: al-ʿumrā jāʾizatun liman uʿmirahā wa-ar-ruqbā jāʾizatun liman urqibahā
english_full: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Umra belongs to the one to whom it is given, and Ruqba belongs to the one to whom it is given.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2384
lede: The Chapters on Gifts
arabic: إِنَّ مَثَلَ الَّذِي يَعُودُ فِي عَطِيَّتِهِ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ أَكَلَ حَتَّى إِذَا شَبِعَ قَاءَ ثُمَّ عَادَ فِي قَيْئِهِ فَأَكَلَهُ
translit: inna mathala adh-dhī yaʿūdu fī ʿaṭiyyatihi kamathali al-kalbi akala ḥattā idhā shabiʿa qāʾa thumma ʿāda fī qayʾihi fa-akalah
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The likeness of one who takes back his gift is that of a dog that eats until it is full and vomits; then it goes back to its vomit and eats it again.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2388
lede: The Chapters on Gifts
arabic: لاَ يَجُوزُ لاِمْرَأَةٍ فِي مَالِهَا إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا إِذَا هُوَ مَلَكَ عِصْمَتَهَا
translit: lā yajūzu limraʾatin fī mālihā illā biʾidhni zawjihā idhā huwa malaka ʿiṣmatahā
english_full: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father that he delivered:“It is not permissible for a woman to dispose of her wealth except with her husband's permission, once he has married her.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2464
lede: The Chapters on Divorce
arabic: لأَنْ يَمْنَحَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ الأَرْضَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ لَهَا خَرَاجًا مَعْلُومًا
translit: lʾan yamnaḥa aḥadukum akhāhu al-arḍa khayrun lah min an yaʾkhudha lahā kharājan maʿlūman
english_full: It was narrated from Tawus that Ibn`Abbas told that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) merely said:“For one of you to give (land) to his brother is better for him than if he were to take a set amount in rent for it.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2699
lede: The Chapters on Wills
arabic: مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَبِيتَ لَيْلَتَيْنِ وَلَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ إِلاَّ وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ
translit: mā ḥaqqu āmriʾin muslimin an yabīta laylatayni walah shayʾun yūṣī fīhi illā wawaṣiyyatuhu maktūbatun ʿindah
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The Muslim man has no right to spend two nights, if he has something for which a will should be made, without having a written will with him.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2706
lede: The Chapters on Wills
arabic: نَعَمْ وَاللَّهِ لَتُنَبَّأَنَّ أَنْ تَصَدَّقَ وَأَنْتَ صَحِيحٌ شَحِيحٌ تَأْمُلُ الْعَيْشَ وَتَخَافُ الْفَقْرَ وَلاَ تُمْهِلْ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَتْ نَفْسُكَ هَاهُنَا قُلْتَ مَالِي لِفُلاَنٍ وَمَالِي لِفُلاَنٍ وَهُوَ لَهُمْ وَإِنْ كَرِهْتَ
translit: naʿam wallāh latunabbaʾanna an taṣaddaqa wa-anta ṣaḥīḥun shaḥīḥun taʾmulu al-ʿaysha watakhāfu al-faqra walā tumhil ḥattā idhā balaghat nafsuka hāhunā qulta mālī lifulānin wamālī lifulānin wahuwa lahum wa-in karihta
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:“A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: “O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), tell me, which of the people has most right to my good companionship?' He said: 'Yes, by your father, you will certainly be told.' He said: 'Your mother,' He said: 'Then who?' He said: Then your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: Then your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: Then your father.' He said: 'Tell me, O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about my wealth- how should I give in charity?' He said: 'Yes, by Allah (SWT) you will certainly be told. You should give in charity when you are still healthy and greedy for wealth, hoping for a long life and fearing poverty. Do not tarry until your soul reaches here and you say: “My wealth of for so-and-so,” and “My wealth of for so-and-so,” and it will be for them even though you dislike that.'”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 2712
lede: The Chapters on Wills
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَسَمَ لِكُلِّ وَارِثٍ نَصِيبَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ فَلاَ يَجُوزُ لِوَارِثٍ وَصِيَّةٌ الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ وَمَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلاَ عَدْلٌ
translit: inna-Llāh qasama likulli wārithin naṣībah mina al-mīrāthi falā yajūzu liwārithin waṣiyyatun al-waladu lilfirāshi walilʿāhiri al-ḥajaru wamani āddaʿā ilā ghayri abīhi aw tawallā ghayra mawālīhi faʿalayhi laʿnah Allāh wa-l-malāʾikah wa-an-nāsi ajmaʿīna lā yuqbalu minhu ṣarfun walā ʿadlun
english_full: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Kharijah:“The Prophet (ﷺ) addressed them when he was on his camel. His camel was chewing its cud and its saliva was dripping between my shoulders. He said: 'Allah (SWT) has allocated for each heir his share of the inheritance, so it is not permissible (to make) a bequest for an heir. The child belong to the bed and the adulterer gets the stone. Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father, or (a freed slave) who claims that his Wala is for other than his Mavali, upon him will be the curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and no charge nor equitable exchange will be accepted from him.” Or he said: “No equitable exchange nor change.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3857
lede: Supplication
arabic: لَقَدْ سَأَلَ اللَّهَ بِاسْمِهِ الأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي إِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى وَإِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ
translit: laqad saʾala-Llāh bāsmihi al-aʿẓami adh-dhī idhā suʾila bihi aʿṭā wa-idhā duʿiya bihi ajāba
english_full: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah that his father said:"The Prophet (saas) heard a man say: 'Allahumma! Inni as'aluka bi-annaka Antallahul-Ahadus-Samad, alladhi lam yalid wa lam yuwlud, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad (O Allah! I ask You by virtue of Your being Allah, the One, the Self-Sufficient Master, Who begets not nor was begotten, and there is none co-equal or comparable to Him).' The Messenger of Allah (saas) said: 'He has asked Allah by His Greatest Name, which if He is asked thereby He gives, and if He is called upon thereby He answers

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3862
lede: Supplication
arabic: ثَلاَثُ دَعَوَاتٍ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهُنَّ لاَ شَكَّ فِيهِنَّ دَعْوَةُ الْمَظْلُومِ وَدَعْوَةُ الْمُسَافِرِ وَدَعْوَةُ الْوَالِدِ لِوَلَدِهِ
translit: thalāthu daʿawātin yustajābu lahunna lā shakka fīhinna daʿwah al-maẓlūmi wadaʿwah al-musāfiri wadaʿwah al-wālidi liwaladihi
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah that :the Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "There are three supplications that will undoubtedly be answered: the supplication of one who has been wronged; the supplication of the traveler; and the supplication of a father for his child

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3865
lede: Supplication
arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ حَيِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنْ عَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْهِ يَدَيْهِ فَيَرُدَّهُمَا صِفْرًا - أَوْ قَالَ خَائِبَتَيْنِ
translit: inna rabbakum ḥayiyyun karīmun yastaḥyī min ʿabdihi an yarfaʿa ilayhi yadayhi fayaruddahumā ṣifran-aw qāla khāʾibatayni
english_full: It was narrated from Salman that the :Prophet (saas) said: "Your Lord is Kind and Most Generous, and is too kind to let His slave, if he raises his hands to Him, bring them back empty," or he said "frustrated

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3867
lede: Supplication
arabic: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ - كَانَ لَهُ عَدْلَ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ عَشْرُ خَطِيئَاتٍ وَرُفِعَ لَهُ عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ وَكَانَ فِي حِرْزٍ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَى فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ
translit: man qāla ḥīna yuṣbiḥu lā ilaha illā-Llāh waḥdah lā sharīka lah lah al-mulku walah al-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun-kāna lah ʿadla raqabatin min waladi ismāʿīla waḥuṭṭa ʿanhu ʿashru khaṭīātin warufiʿa lah ʿashru darajātin wakāna fī ḥirzin mina ash-shayṭāni ḥattā yumsiya wa-idhā amsā famithlu dhalika ḥattā yuṣbiḥa
english_full: It was narrated from Abu 'Ayyash Az-Zuraqi that :the Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "Whoever says in the morning: 'La illaha illalahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, with no partner or associate. His is the dominion and all praise is to Him, and He is Able to all things)' - he will have (a reward) equal to freeing a slave among the sons of Isma'il, ten bad deeds will be erased from (his record), he will be raised (in status) ten degrees, and he will have protection against Satan until evening comes. When evening comes, (if he says likewise) he will have the same until morning comes.'" (Sahih)He (one of the narrators) said: "A man saw the Messenger of Allah (saas) in a dream and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, Abu 'Ayyash narrated such and such from you.' He said: 'Abu 'Ayyash spoke the truth

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3868
lede: Supplication
arabic: إِذَا أَصْبَحْتُمْ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَى وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتُمْ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَى وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
translit: idhā aṣbaḥtum faqūlūā-Llāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wabika amsaynā wabika naḥyā wabika namūtu wa-idhā amsaytum faqūlūā-Llāhumma bika amsaynā wabika aṣbaḥnā wabika naḥyā wabika namūtu wa-ilayka al-maṣīru
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that :the Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "In the morning say: 'Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut (O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we reach the evening, and by Your leave we live and by Your leave we die). And when evening comes, say: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut, wa ilaykal-masir (O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we reach the morning, and by Your leave we live and by Your leave we die, and unto You is our return)

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3872
lede: Supplication
arabic: مَنْ قَالَهَا فِي يَوْمِهِ وَلَيْلَتِهِ فَمَاتَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ أَوْ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
translit: man qālahā fī yawmihi walaylatihi famāta fī dhalika al-yawmi aw tilka al-laylah dakhala al-jannaha in shāʾa-Llāh taʿālā
english_full: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah that :his father said: "The Messenger of Allah (saas) said: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu. A'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u bi ni'matika wa abu'u bi dhanbi faghfirli, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta (O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship except You. You have created me and I am Your slave, and I am adhering to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I do. I acknowledge Your blessing and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for there is none who can forgive sin except You)."He said: "The Messenger of Allah (saas) said: 'Whoever says this by day and by night, if he dies that day or that night, he will enter Paradise if Allah wills

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3874
lede: Supplication
arabic: إِذَا أَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَضْطَجِعَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْزِعْ دَاخِلَةَ إِزَارِهِ ثُمَّ لْيَنْفُضْ بِهَا فِرَاشَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ لْيَضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ رَبِّ بِكَ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا حَفِظْتَ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
translit: idhā arāda aḥadukum an yaḍṭajiʿa ʿalā firāshihi falyanziʿ dākhilaha izārihi thumma lyanfuḍ bihā firāshah fa-innah lā yadrī mā khalafah ʿalayhi thumma lyaḍṭajiʿ ʿalā shiqqihi al-aymani thumma lyaqul rabbi bika waḍaʿtu janbī wabika arfaʿuhu fa-in amsakta nafsī fārḥamhā wa-in arsaltahā fāḥfaẓhā bimā ḥafiẓta bihi ʿibādaka aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:the Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "When anyone of you wants to go to bed, let him undo the edge of his Izar (waist wrap) and dust of his bed with it, for he does not know what came to it after him. Then let him lie down on his right side and say: 'Rabbi bika wada'tu janbi wa bika arfa'uhu, fa in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima hafizta bihi 'ibadikaas-salihin (O Lord, by Your leave I lie down and by Your leave I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy on it, and if You should return my soul then protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves)

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3876
lede: Supplication
arabic: إِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ أَوْ أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ فَإِنْ مِتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ مِتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ وَإِنْ أَصْبَحْتَ أَصْبَحْتَ وَقَدْ أَصَبْتَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا
translit: idhā akhadhta maḍjaʿaka aw awayta ilā firāshika faquli-Llāhumma aslamtu wajhī ilayka wa-aljaʾtu ẓahrī ilayka wafawwaḍtu amrī ilayka raghbatan warahbatan ilayka lā maljaʾa walā manjā minka illā ilayka āmantu bikitābika adh-dhī anzalta wanabiyyika adh-dhī arsalta fa-in mitta min laylatika mitta ʿalā al-fiṭrah wa-in aṣbaḥta aṣbaḥta waqad aṣabta khayran kathīran
english_full: It was narrated from Bara' bin 'Azib that :the Prophet (saas) said to a man: "When you go to lay down, or go to your bed, say: Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilayka, wa al-ja'tu zahri ilayka, wa fawwadtu amri ilayka, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka, la malja'a wa la manja'a minka illa ilayka, amantu bi kitabikal-ladhi anzalta, wa nabiyyikal arsalta [O Allah, I have submitted my face (i.e., myself) to You, and I am under Your command (i.e., I depend upon You in all my affairs), and I put my trust in You, hoping for Your reward and fearing Your punishment. There is no fleeing from You and no refuge from You except with You. I believe in Your Book that You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent).' Then if you die that night, you will die in a state of the Fitrah (nature), and if you wake in the morning you will wake with a great deal of good

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3881
lede: Supplication
arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ بَاتَ عَلَى طُهُورٍ ثُمَّ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَأَلَ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا أَوْ مِنْ أَمْرِ الآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ
translit: mā min ʿabdin bāta ʿalā ṭuhūrin thumma taʿārra mina al-layli fasaʾala-Llāh shayʾan min amri ad-dunyā aw min amri al-ākhirah illā aʿṭāhu
english_full: It was narrated from Mu’adh bin Jabal that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“There is no person who goes to bed in a state of purity, then wakes up at night, and asks Allah for something in this world or the Hereafter, but it will be given to him.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3887
lede: Supplication
arabic: إِذَا دَخَلَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْتَهُ فَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ وَعِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لاَ مَبِيتَ لَكُمْ وَلاَ عَشَاءَ . وَإِذَا دَخَلَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ أَدْرَكْتُمُ الْمَبِيتَ . فَإِذَا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ قَالَ أَدْرَكْتُمُ الْمَبِيتَ وَالْعَشَاءَ
translit: idhā dakhala ar-rajulu baytah fadhakara-Llāh ʿinda dukhūlihi waʿinda ṭaʿāmihi qāla ash-shayṭānu lā mabīta lakum walā ʿashāʾa . wa-idhā dakhala walam yadhkuri-Llāh ʿinda dukhūlihi qāla ash-shayṭānu adraktumu al-mabīta . fa-idhā lam yadhkuri-Llāh ʿinda ṭaʿāmihi qāla adraktumu al-mabīta wa-l-ʿashāʾa
english_full: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say:“When a man enters his house, and remembers Allah when he enters and when he eats, Satan says: ‘You have no place to stay and no supper.’ If he enters his house and does not remember Allah upon entering, Satan says: ‘You have found a place to stay.’ And if he does not remember Allah when he eats, (Satan) says: ‘You have found a place to stay and supper.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 3891
lede: Supplication
arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكِ لَعَلَّهُ كَمَا قَالَ قَوْمُ هُودٍ {فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ }
translit: wamā yudrīki laʿallah kamā qāla qawmu hūdin falammā raʾawhu ʿāriḍan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qālūā hadhā ʿāriḍun mumṭirunā bal huwa mā āstaʿjaltum bihi }
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:“If the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a cloud that looked as if it was bringing rain, the color of his face would change, and he would go in and out and walk to and fro. Then, if it rained, he would feel relieved.” ‘Aishah mentioned to him what she had seen him do, and he said: “How do you know? Perhaps it would be as the people of Hud said: ‘Then, when they saw it as a dense cloud coming towards their valleys, they said: “This is a cloud bringing us rain!” Nay, but it is that (torment) which you were asking to be hastened.” [46:]

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4105
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَنْ كَانَتِ الدُّنْيَا هَمَّهُ فَرَّقَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرَهُ وَجَعَلَ فَقْرَهُ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَأْتِهِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا إِلاَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَتِ الآخِرَةُ نِيَّتَهُ جَمَعَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَمْرَهُ وَجَعَلَ غِنَاهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ وَأَتَتْهُ الدُّنْيَا وَهِيَ رَاغِمَةٌ
translit: man kānati ad-dunyā hammah farraqa-Llāh ʿalayhi amrah wajaʿala faqrah bayna ʿaynayhi walam yaʾtihi mina ad-dunyā illā mā kutiba lah waman kānati al-ākhirah niyyatah jamaʿa-Llāh lah amrah wajaʿala ghināhu fī qalbihi wa-atathu ad-dunyā wahiya rāghimatun
english_full: ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Aban bin ‘Uthman bin ‘Affan narrated that his father said:“Zaid bin Thabit departed from Marwan at mid-day. I said: ‘He has not sent him out at this time of the day except for something he asked.’ So I asked him, and he said: ‘He asked me about some things we heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “Whoever is focused only on this world, Allah will confound his affairs and make him fear poverty constantly, and he will not get anything of this world except that which has been decreed for him. Whoever is focused on the Hereafter, Allah will settle his affairs for him and make him feel content with his lot, and his provision and worldly gains will undoubtedly come to him.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4106
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَنْ جَعَلَ الْهُمُومَ هَمًّا وَاحِدًا هَمَّ الْمَعَادِ كَفَاهُ اللَّهُ هَمَّ دُنْيَاهُ وَمَنْ تَشَعَّبَتْ بِهِ الْهُمُومُ فِي أَحْوَالِ الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يُبَالِ اللَّهُ فِي أَىِّ أَوْدِيَتِهِ هَلَكَ
translit: man jaʿala al-humūma hamman wāḥidan hamma al-maʿādi kafāhu-Llāh hamma dunyāhu waman tashaʿʿabat bihi al-humūmu fī aḥwāli ad-dunyā lam yubāli-Llāh fī āi awdiyatihi halaka
english_full: ‘Abdullah said:“I heard your Prophet (ﷺ) say: ‘Whoever focuses all his concerns on one thing, the Hereafter, Allah will relieve him of worldly concerns, but whoever has disparate concerns scattered among a number of worldly issues, Allah will not care in which of its valleys he died.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4108
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَا مَثَلُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ مَثَلُ مَا يَجْعَلُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِصْبَعَهُ فِي الْيَمِّ فَلْيَنْظُرْ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ
translit: mā mathalu ad-dunyā fī al-ākhirah illā mathalu mā yajʿalu aḥadukum iṣbaʿah fī al-yammi falyanẓur bima yarjiʿu
english_full: Mustawrid, a brother of Banu Fihr, said:“I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: ‘The likeness of this world in comparison to the Hereafter is that of anyone of you dipping his finger into the sea: let him see what he brings forth.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4109
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَا أَنَا وَالدُّنْيَا إِنَّمَا أَنَا وَالدُّنْيَا كَرَاكِبٍ اسْتَظَلَّ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ ثُمَّ رَاحَ وَتَرَكَهَا
translit: mā anā wa-ad-dunyā innamā anā wa-ad-dunyā karākibin āstaẓalla taḥta shajaratin thumma rāḥa watarakahā
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah said:“The Prophet (ﷺ) lay down on a reed mat, and it left marks on his skin. I said: ‘May my father and mother be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah! If you had told us we would have provided you with something that would save you this trouble.’ The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘What is there between myself and the world? This world and I are just like a rider who stops to rest beneath the shade of a tree then goes and leaves it.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4111
lede: Zuhd
arabic: فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَلدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا
translit: fawālladhī nafsī biyadihi lalddunyā ahwanu ʿalā-Llāh min hadhihi ʿalā ahlihā
english_full: Mustawrid bin Shaddad said:“I was riding with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he came across a dead lamb that had been thrown out.’ He said: ‘Don’t you think that this is worthless to its owners?’ It was said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, it is because it is worthless that they have thrown it out, - or words to that effect. He said: ‘By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, this world is more worthless to Allah than this is to its owners.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4112
lede: Zuhd
arabic: الدُّنْيَا مَلْعُونَةٌ مَلْعُونٌ مَا فِيهَا إِلاَّ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ وَمَا وَالاَهُ أَوْ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا
translit: ad-dunyā malʿūnatun malʿūnun mā fīhā illā dhikra-Llāh wamā wa-l-āhu aw ʿāliman aw mutaʿalliman
english_full: Abu Hurairah said:“I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: ‘This world is cursed and what is in it is cursed, except the remembrance of Allah (dhikr) and what is conducive to that, or one who has knowledge or who acquires knowledge.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4114
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ كَأَنَّكَ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ وَعُدَّ نَفْسَكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُبُورِ
translit: yā ʿabda-Llāh kun fī ad-dunyā kaʾannaka gharībun aw kaʾannaka ʿābiru sabīlin waʿudda nafsaka min ahli al-qubūri
english_full: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took hold of some part of my body and said: ‘O ‘Abdullah, be in this world like a stranger, or one who is passing through, and consider yourself as one of the people of the graves.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4116
lede: Zuhd
arabic: أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ كُلُّ ضَعِيفٍ مُتَضَعِّفٍ أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ النَّارِ كُلُّ عُتُلٍّ جَوَّاظٍ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ
translit: alā unabbiʾukum biʾahli al-jannah kullu ḍaʿīfin mutaḍaʿʿifin alā unabbiʾukum biʾahli an-nāri kullu ʿutullin jawwāẓin mustakbirin
english_full: Harithah bin Wahb narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Shall I not tell you about the people of Paradise? Every weak and oppressed one. Shall I not tell you about the people of Hell? Every harsh, haughty and arrogant one.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4120
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي هَذَا الرَّجُلِ قَالُوا رَأْيَكَ فِي . هَذَا نَقُولُ هَذَا مِنْ أَشْرَافِ النَّاسِ هَذَا حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ يُخَطَّبَ وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ يُشَفَّعَ وَإِنْ قَالَ أَنْ يُسْمَعَ لِقَوْلِهِ . فَسَكَتَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَمَرَّ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ
translit: mā taqūlūna fī hadhā ar-rajuli qālūā raʾyaka fī . hadhā naqūlu hadhā min ashrāfi an-nāsi hadhā ḥariyyun in khaṭaba an yukhaṭṭaba wa-in shafaʿa an yushaffaʿa wa-in qāla an yusmaʿa liqawlihi . fasakata an-nabiyyu ṣlā-Llāh ʿlyh wslm wamarra rajulun ākharu faqāla an-nabiyyu ṣlā-Llāh ʿlyh wslm
english_full: It was narrated that Sahl bin Sa’d As-Sa’idi said:“A man passed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said: ‘What do you say about this man?’ They said: ‘We agree with your opinion concerning him. We say: He is one of the noblest of people. If he proposes marriage, his proposal deserves to be accepted; and if he intercedes, his intercession deserves to be accepted; and if he speaks, he deserves to be listened to.’ The Prophet (ﷺ) remained silent, and another man passed by. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: ‘What do you think about this man?’ We said: ‘By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, this is one of the poor Muslims. If he proposes marriage, he does not deserve to get married; and if he intercedes, his intercession does not deserve to be accepted; and if he speaks, he does not deserve to be listened to.’ The Prophet (ﷺ) said: ‘This one is better than an earthful of (men like) the other man.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4122
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَدْخُلُ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْجَنَّةَ قَبْلَ الأَغْنِيَاءِ بِنِصْفِ يَوْمٍ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ
translit: yadkhulu fuqarāʾu al-muʾminīna al-jannaha qabla al-aghniyāʾi biniṣfi yawmin khamsimāʾah ʿāmin
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The poor believers will enter Paradise half a day – five hundred years – before the rich.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4123
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ فُقَرَاءَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ قَبْلَ أَغْنِيَائِهِمْ بِمِقْدَارِ خَمْسِمِائَةِ سَنَةٍ
translit: inna fuqarāʾa al-muhājirīna yadkhulūna al-jannaha qabla aghniyāʾihim bimiqdāri khamsimāʾah sanatin
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The poor Muhajirun will enter Paradise before the rich, the equivalent of five hundred years.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4130
lede: Zuhd
arabic: الأَكْثَرُونَ هُمُ الأَسْفَلُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلاَّ مَنْ قَالَ بِالْمَالِ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَكَسَبَهُ مِنْ طَيِّبٍ
translit: al-aktharūna humu al-asfalūna yawma al-qiyāmah illā man qāla bi-l-māli hakadhā wahakadhā wakasabah min ṭayyibin
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The wealthiest will be the lowest on the Day of Resurrection, except those who do such and such with their money, and earn it from good sources.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4132
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ أُحُدًا عِنْدِي ذَهَبًا فَتَأْتِي عَلَىَّ ثَالِثَةٌ وَعِنْدِي مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ أُرْصِدُهُ فِي قَضَاءِ دَيْنٍ
translit: mā uḥibbu anna uḥudan ʿindī dhahaban fataʾtī ʿalāa thālithatun waʿindī minhu shayʾun illā shayʾun urṣiduhu fī qaḍāʾi daynin
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“I would not like to have (the equivalent of) Uhud in gold, then a third night comes to me and I have anything of it left, except something that I set aside to pay off a debt.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4141
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ مُعَافًى فِي جَسَدِهِ آمِنًا فِي سِرْبِهِ عِنْدَهُ قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا حِيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا
translit: man aṣbaḥa minkum muʿāfan fī jasadihi āminan fī sirbihi ʿindah qūtu yawmihi fakaʾannamā ḥīzat lah ad-dunyā
english_full: It was narrated from Salamah bin ‘Ubaidullah bin Mihsan Al-Ansari that his father said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘Whoever among you wakes up physically healthy, feeling safe and secure within himself, with food for the day, it is as if he acquired the whole world.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4164
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلْتُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ تَغْدُو خِمَاصًا وَتَرُوحُ بِطَانًا
translit: law annakum tawakkaltum ʿalā-Llāh ḥaqqa tawakkulihi larazaqakum kamā yarzuqu aṭ-ṭayra taghdū khimāṣan watarūḥu biṭānan
english_full: ‘Umar said:“I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: ‘If you were to rely upon Allah with the reliance He is due, you would be given provision like the birds: They go out hungry in the morning and come back with full bellies in the evening.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4168
lede: Zuhd
arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ فَإِنْ غَلَبَكَ أَمْرٌ فَقُلْ قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ وَإِيَّاكَ وَاللَّوْ فَإِنَّ اللَّوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ
translit: al-muʾminu al-qawiyyu khayrun wa-aḥabbu ilā-Llāh mina al-muʾmini aḍ-ḍaʿīfi wafī kullin khayrun āḥriṣ ʿalā mā yanfaʿuka walā taʿjiz fa-in ghalabaka amrun faqul qaddara-Llāh wamā shāʾa faʿala wa-iyyāka wa-l-law fa-inna al-law taftaḥu ʿamala ash-shayṭāni
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said, attributing it to the Prophet (ﷺ):“The stronger believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, although both are good. Strive to seek that which will benefit you and do not feel helpless. If something overwhelms you, then say: Qaddarallah, wa ma sha'a fa’al (It is the decree of Allah and what He wills He does). And beware of (saying) ‘If only,’ for ‘If only’ opens the door to Satan.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4171
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي صَلاَتِكَ فَصَلِّ صَلاَةَ مُوَدِّعٍ وَلاَ تَكَلَّمْ بِكَلاَمٍ تَعْتَذِرُ مِنْهُ وَأَجْمِعِ الْيَأْسَ عَمَّا فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ
translit: idhā qumta fī ṣalātika faṣalli ṣalāha muwaddiʿin walā takallam bikalāmin taʿtadhiru minhu wa-ajmiʿi al-yaʾsa ʿammā fī aydī an-nāsi
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Ayyub said:“A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, teach me but make it concise.’ He said: ‘When you stand to pray, pray like a man bidding farewell. Do not say anything for which you will have to apologize. And give up hope for what other people have.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4175
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ رِدَائِي وَالْعَظَمَةُ إِزَارِي فَمَنْ نَازَعَنِي وَاحِدًا مِنْهُمَا أَلْقَيْتُهُ فِي النَّارِ
translit: yaqūlu-Llāh subḥānah al-kibriyāʾu ridāʾī wa-l-ʿaẓamah izārī faman nāzaʿanī wāḥidan minhumā alqaytuhu fī an-nāri
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Allah the Glorified, says: ‘Pride is My cloak and greatness My robe, and whoever competes with Me with regard to either of them, I shall throw him into Hell.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4179
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَوْحَى إِلَىَّ أَنْ تَوَاضَعُوا حَتَّى لاَ يَفْخَرَ أَحَدٌ عَلَى أَحَدٍ
translit: inna-Llāh ʿazza wajalla awḥā ilāa an tawāḍaʿūā ḥattā lā yafkhara aḥadun ʿalā aḥadin
english_full: It was narrated from ‘Iyad bin Himar that the Prophet (ﷺ) addressed them and said:“Allah has revealed to me that you should be humble towards one another so that none of you boasts to another.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4189
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَا مِنْ جُرْعَةٍ أَعْظَمُ أَجْرًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ جُرْعَةِ غَيْظٍ كَظَمَهَا عَبْدٌ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ
translit: mā min jurʿatin aʿẓamu ajran ʿinda-Llāh min jurʿah ghayẓin kaẓamahā ʿabdun ābtighāʾa wajhi-Llāh
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“There is no gulp that brings greater reward with Allah than a gulp of anger that a man swallows (suppresses), seeking thereby the Face of Allah.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4198
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لاَ يَا بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - أَوْ يَا بِنْتَ الصِّدِّيقِ - وَلَكِنَّهُ الرَّجُلُ يَصُومُ وَيَتَصَدَّقُ وَيُصَلِّي وَهُوَ يَخَافُ أَنْ لاَ يُتَقَبَّلَ مِنْهُ
translit: lā yā binta abī bakrin-aw yā binta aṣ-ṣiddīqi-walakinnah ar-rajulu yaṣūmu wayataṣaddaqu wayuṣallī wahuwa yakhāfu an lā yutaqabbala minhu
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:“I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, ‘And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear.” [23:60] Is this the one who commits adultery, steals and drinks alcohol?’ He said: ‘No, O daughter of Abu Bakr’ – O daughter of Siddiq – rather it is a man who fasts and gives charity and prays, but he fears that those will not be accepted from him.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4199
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ كَالْوِعَاءِ إِذَا طَابَ أَسْفَلُهُ طَابَ أَعْلاَهُ وَإِذَا فَسَدَ أَسْفَلُهُ فَسَدَ أَعْلاَهُ
translit: innamā al-aʿmālu ka-l-wiʿāʾi idhā ṭāba asfaluhu ṭāba aʿlāhu wa-idhā fasada asfaluhu fasada aʿlāhu
english_full: Mu’awiyah bin Abu Sufyan said:“I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: ‘Deeds are like vessels. If the lower part is good then the upper part will be good, and if the lower part is bad then the upper part will be bad.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4203
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِذَا جَمَعَ اللَّهُ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لِيَوْمٍ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهِ نَادَى مُنَادٍ مَنْ كَانَ أَشْرَكَ فِي عَمَلٍ عَمَلَهُ لِلَّهِ فَلْيَطْلُبْ ثَوَابَهُ مِنْ عِنْدِ غَيْرِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَغْنَى الشُّرَكَاءِ عَنِ الشِّرْكِ
translit: idhā jamaʿa-Llāh al-awwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna liyawmi al-qiyāmah liyawmin lā rayba fīhi nādā munādin man kāna ashraka fī ʿamalin ʿamalah lillāh falyaṭlub thawābah min ʿindi ghayri-Llāh fa-inna-Llāh aghnā ash-shurakāʾi ʿani ash-shirki
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Sa’d bin Abu Fadalah Al-Ansari, who was one of the Companions, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“When Allah assembles the first and the last on the Day of Resurrection, a day concerning which there is no doubt, a caller will cry out: ‘Whoever used to associate anyone else in an action that he did for Allah, let him seek his reward from someone other than Allah, for Allah is so self-sufficient that He has no need of any associate.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4204
lede: Zuhd
arabic: أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَا هُوَ أَخْوَفُ عَلَيْكُمْ عِنْدِي مِنَ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
translit: alā ukhbirukum bimā huwa akhwafu ʿalaykum ʿindī mina al-masīḥi ad-dajjāli
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out to us when we were discussing Dajjal (False Christ) and said: ‘Shall I not tell you of that which I fear more for you than Dajjal?’ We said: ‘Yes.’ He said: ‘Hidden polytheism, when a man stands to pray and makes it look good because he sees a man looking at him.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4217
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ كُنْ وَرِعًا تَكُنْ أَعْبَدَ النَّاسِ وَكُنْ قَنِعًا تَكُنْ أَشْكَرَ النَّاسِ وَأَحِبَّ لِلنَّاسِ مَا تُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِكَ تَكُنْ مُؤْمِنًا وَأَحَسِنْ جِوَارَ مَنْ جَاوَرَكَ تَكُنْ مُسْلِمًا وَأَقِلَّ الضَّحِكَ فَإِنَّ كَثْرَةَ الضَّحِكِ تُمِيتُ الْقَلْبَ
translit: yā abā hurayraha kun wariʿan takun aʿbada an-nāsi wakun qaniʿan takun ashkara an-nāsi wa-aḥibba lilnnāsi mā tuḥibbu linafsika takun muʾminan wa-aḥasin jiwāra man jāwaraka takun musliman wa-aqilla aḍ-ḍaḥika fa-inna kathraha aḍ-ḍaḥiki tumītu al-qalba
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“O Abu Hurairah, be cautious, and you will be the most devoted of people to Allah. Be content, and you will be the most grateful of people to Allah. Love for people what you love for yourself, and you will be a (true) believer. Be a good neighbor to your neighbors, and you will be a (true) Muslim. And laugh little, for laughing a lot deadens the heart.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4221
lede: Zuhd
arabic: بِالثَّنَاءِ الْحَسَنِ وَالثَّنَاءِ السَّيِّئِ أَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ
translit: bi-ath-thanāʾi al-ḥasani wa-ath-thanāʾi as-sayyiʾi antum shuhadāʾu-Llāh baʿḍukum ʿalā baʿḍin
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Bakr bin Abu Zuhair Ath-Thaqafi, that his father said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) addressed us in Nabawah” or Banawah – he (one of the narrators) said: “Nabawah is near Ta’if” – “And said: ‘Soon you will be able to tell the people of Paradise from the people of Hell.’ They said: ‘How O Messenger of Allah?’ He said: ‘By praise and condemnation. You are Allah’s witnesses over one another.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4222
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِذَا قَالَ جِيرَانُكَ إِنَّكَ قَدْ أَحْسَنْتَ فَقَدْ أَحْسَنْتَ وَإِذَا قَالُوا إِنَّكَ قَدْ أَسَأْتَ فَقَدْ أَسَأْتَ
translit: idhā qāla jīrānuka innaka qad aḥsanta faqad aḥsanta wa-idhā qālūā innaka qad asaʾta faqad asaʾta
english_full: It was narrated that Kulthum Al-Khuza’i said:“A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, how can I know, when I have done something good, that I have done well, and if I have done something bad, that I have done a bad deed?’ The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘If your neighbors say that you have done something good, then you have done well, and if they say that you have done something bad, then you have done something bad.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4223
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتَ جِيرَانَكَ يَقُولُونَ قَدْ أَحْسَنْتَ فَقَدْ أَحْسَنْتَ وَإِذَا سَمِعْتَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ : قَدْ أَسَأْتَ فَقَدْ أَسَأْتَ
translit: idhā samiʿta jīrānaka yaqūlūna qad aḥsanta faqad aḥsanta wa-idhā samiʿtahum yaqūlūna : qad asaʾta faqad asaʾta
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah said:“A man said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): ‘How can I know when I have done well and when I have done something bad?’ The Prophet (ﷺ) said: ‘If you hear your neighbors saying that you have done well, then you have done well, and if you hear them saying that you have done something bad, then you have done something bad.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4224
lede: Zuhd
arabic: أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْ مَلأَ اللَّهُ أُذُنَيْهِ مِنْ ثَنَاءِ النَّاسِ خَيْرًا وَهُوَ يَسْمَعُ، وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ مَنْ مَلأَ أُذُنَيْهِ مِنْ ثَنَاءِ النَّاسِ شَرًّا وَهُوَ يَسْمَعُ
translit: ahlu al-jannah man malʾa-Llāh udhunayhi min thanāʾi an-nāsi khayran wahuwa yasmaʿu, wa-ahlu an-nāri man malʾa udhunayhi min thanāʾi an-nāsi sharran wahuwa yasmaʿu
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The people of Paradise are those whose ears Allah fills with the praise of people when they are listening, and the people of Hell- fire are those whom He fills their ears with condemnation when they are listening.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4228
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَثَلُ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ كَمَثَلِ أَرْبَعَةِ نَفَرٍ : رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَعِلْمًا فَهُوَ يَعْمَلُ بِعِلْمِهِ فِي مَالِهِ يُنْفِقُهُ فِي حَقِّهِ وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ عِلْمًا وَلَمْ يُؤْتِهِ مَالاً فَهُوَ يَقُولُ : لَوْ كَانَ لِي مِثْلُ هَذَا عَمِلْتُ فِيهِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي يَعْمَلُ
translit: mathalu hadhihi al-ummah kamathali arbaʿah nafarin : rajulun ātāhu-Llāh mālan waʿilman fahuwa yaʿmalu biʿilmihi fī mālihi yunfiquhu fī ḥaqqihi warajulun ātāhu-Llāh ʿilman walam yuʾtihi mālan fahuwa yaqūlu : law kāna lī mithlu hadhā ʿamiltu fīhi mithla adh-dhī yaʿmalu
english_full: It was narrated that Abu Kabshah Al-Anmari said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘The likeness of this nation is that of four people: A man to whom Allah gives wealth and knowledge, so he acts according to his knowledge with regard to his wealth, spending it as it should be spent; a man to whom Allah gives knowledge, but he does not give him wealth, so he says: “If I had been given (wealth) like this one, I would have done what (the first man) did.” The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘They will be equal in reward. And a man to whom Allah gives wealth but does not give knowledge, so he squanders his wealth and spends it in inappropriate ways; and a man to whom Allah gives neither knowledge nor wealth, and he says: “If I had (wealth) like this one, I would do what (the third man) did.” The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘They are equal in their burden (of sin).’” A similar report (as above) was narrated from Ibn Abu Kabshah, from his father, from the Prophet (ﷺ)

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4231
lede: Zuhd
arabic: هَذَا الإِنْسَانُ الْخَطُّ الأَوْسَطُ وَهَذِهِ الْخُطُوطُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ الأَعْرَاضُ تَنْهَشُهُ أَوْ تَنْهَسُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَإِنْ أَخْطَأَهُ هَذَا أَصَابَهُ هَذَا وَالْخَطُّ الْمُرَبَّعُ الأَجَلُ الْمُحِيطُ وَالْخَطُّ الْخَارِجُ الأَمَلُ
translit: hadhā al-insānu al-khaṭṭu al-awsaṭu wahadhihi al-khuṭūṭu ilā janbihi al-aʿrāḍu tanhashuhu aw tanhasuhu min kulli makānin fa-in akhṭaʾah hadhā aṣābah hadhā wa-l-khaṭṭu al-murabbaʿu al-ajalu al-muḥīṭu wa-l-khaṭṭu al-khāriju al-amalu
english_full: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Mas’ud that the Prophet (ﷺ) drew a square, and a line in the middle of the square, and lines to the side of the line in the middle of the square, and a line outside the square, and he said:“Do you know what this is?” They said: “Allah and His Messenger know best.” He said: “Man is the line in the middle, and these lines to his side are the sicknesses and problems that assail him from all places. If one misses him, another will befall him. The square is his life span, at his neck; and the line outside it is (his) hope.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4236
lede: Zuhd
arabic: أَعْمَارُ أُمَّتِي مَا بَيْنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى السَّبْعِينَ وَأَقَلُّهُمْ مَنْ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ
translit: aʿmāru ummatī mā bayna as-sittīna ilā as-sabʿīna wa-aqalluhum man yajūzu dhalika
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The ages of (the people in) my nation will be between sixty and seventy, and few of them will exceed that.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4239
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَا حَنْظَلَةُ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ كَمَا تَكُونُونَ عِنْدِي لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عَلَى فُرُشِكُمْ - أَوْ عَلَى طُرُقِكُمْ - يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةٌ وَسَاعَةٌ
translit: yā ḥanẓalah law kuntum kamā takūnūna ʿindī laṣāfaḥatkumu al-malāʾikah ʿalā furushikum-aw ʿalā ṭuruqikum-yā ḥanẓalah sāʿatun wasāʿatun
english_full: It was narrated that Hanzalah Tamimi Al-Usaiyidi, the scribe, said:“We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we spoke of Paradise and Hell until it was as if we could see them. Then I got up and went to my family and children, and I laughed and played (with them). Then I remembered how we had been, and I went out and met Abu Bakr, and said: ‘I have become a hypocrite!’ Abu Bakr said: ‘We all do that.’” So Hanzalah went and mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ), who said: “O Hanzalah, if you were (always) as you are with me, the angels would shake hands with you in your beds and in your streets. O Hanzalah, there is a time for this and a time for that.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4242
lede: Zuhd
arabic: مَنْ أَحْسَنَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ لَمْ يُؤَاخَذْ بِمَا كَانَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ أُخِذَ بِالأَوَّلِ وَالآخِرِ
translit: man aḥsana fī al-islāmi lam yuākhadh bimā kāna fī al-jāhiliyyah waman asāʾa ukhidha bi-l-awwali wa-l-ākhiri
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah said:“We said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, will we be taken to task for what we did in the Ignorance period?’ The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘Whoever does good in Islam (i.e., after becoming a Muslim) he will not be taken to task for what he did in the Ignorance period, but whoever does evil (i.e., after entering Islam) he will be taken to task for both the former and the latter.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4243
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَا عَائِشَةُ إِيَّاكِ وَمُحَقَّرَاتِ الأَعْمَالِ فَإِنَّ لَهَا مِنَ اللَّهِ طَالِبًا
translit: yā ʿāʾishah iyyāki wamuḥaqqarāti al-aʿmāli fa-inna lahā mina-Llāh ṭāliban
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: ‘O ‘Aishah, beware of (evil) deeds that are regarded as insignificant, for they have a pursuer from Allah. (i.e. accountability).”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4244
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا أَذْنَبَ كَانَتْ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ فِي قَلْبِهِ فَإِنْ تَابَ وَنَزَعَ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ صُقِلَ قَلْبُهُ فَإِنْ زَادَ زَادَتْ فَذَلِكَ الرَّانُ الَّذِي ذَكَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ {كَلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ}
translit: inna al-muʾmina idhā adhnaba kānat nuktatun sawdāʾu fī qalbihi fa-in tāba wanazaʿa wāstaghfara ṣuqila qalbuhu fa-in zāda zādat fadhalika ar-rānu adh-dhī dhakarah Allāh fī kitābihi kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānūā yaksibūna
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“When the believer commits sin, a black spot appears on his heart. If he repents and gives up that sin and seeks forgiveness, his heart will be polished. But if (the sin) increases, (the black spot) increases. That is the Ran that Allah mentions in His Book: “Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.” [83:]

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4245
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لأَعْلَمَنَّ أَقْوَامًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَأْتُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِحَسَنَاتٍ أَمْثَالِ جِبَالِ تِهَامَةَ بِيضًا فَيَجْعَلُهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا
translit: lʾaʿlamanna aqwāman min ummatī yaʾtūna yawma al-qiyāmah biḥasanātin amthāli jibāli tihāmaha bīḍan fayajʿaluhā-Llāh ʿazza wajalla habāʾan manthūran
english_full: It was narrated from Thawban that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“I certainly know people of my nation who will come on the Day of Resurrection with good deeds like the mountains of Tihamah, but Allah will make them like scattered dust.” Thawban said: “O Messenger of Allah, describe them to us and tell us more, so that we will not become of them unknowingly.” He said: “They are your brothers and from your race, worshipping at night as you do, but they will be people who, when they are alone, transgress the sacred limits of Allah.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4247
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَفْرَحُ بِتَوْبَةِ أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْهُ بِضَالَّتِهِ إِذَا وَجَدَهَا
translit: inna-Llāh ʿazza wajalla afraḥu bitawbah aḥadikum minhu biḍāllatihi idhā wajadahā
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“Allah rejoiced more over the repentance of anyone of you, then you rejoice over your lost animal when you find it.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4248
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لَوْ أَخْطَأْتُمْ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَطَايَاكُمُ السَّمَاءَ ثُمَّ تُبْتُمْ لَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ
translit: law akhṭaʾtum ḥattā tablugha khaṭāyākumu as-samāʾa thumma tubtum latāba ʿalaykum
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“If you were to commit sin until your sins reach the heaven, then you were to repent, your repentance would be accepted.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4259
lede: Zuhd
arabic: أَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْمَوْتِ ذِكْرًا وَأَحْسَنُهُمْ لِمَا بَعْدَهُ اسْتِعْدَادًا أُولَئِكَ الأَكْيَاسُ
translit: aktharuhum lilmawti dhikran wa-aḥsanuhum limā baʿdah āstiʿdādan ūlaʾika al-akyāsu
english_full: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:“I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and a man from among the Ansar came to him and greeted the Prophet (ﷺ) with Salam. Then he said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, which of the believers is best?’ He said: ‘He who has the best manners among them.’ He said: ‘Which of them is wisest?’ He said: ‘The one who remembers death the most and is best in preparing for it. Those are the wisest.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4261
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لاَ يَجْتَمِعَانِ فِي قَلْبِ عَبْدٍ فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا الْمَوْطِنِ إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ مَا يَرْجُو وَآمَنَهُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ
translit: lā yajtamiʿāni fī qalbi ʿabdin fī mithli hadhā al-mawṭini illā aʿṭāhu-Llāh mā yarjū wamanah mimmā yakhāfu
english_full: It was narrated from Anas that the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon a young man who was dying and said:“How do you feel?” He said: “I have hope in Allah, O Messenger of Allah, but I fear my sins.” The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “These two things (hope and fear) do not coexist in the heart of a person in a situation like this, but Allah will give him that which he hopes for and keep him safe from that which he fears.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4264
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لاَ إِنَّمَا ذَاكَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ إِذَا بُشِّرَ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ وَمَغْفِرَتِهِ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَأَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ وَكَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ
translit: lā innamā dhāka ʿinda mawtihi idhā bushira biraḥmah Allāh wamaghfiratihi aḥabba liqāʾa-Llāh fa-aḥabba-Llāh liqāʾah wa-idhā bushira biʿadhābi-Llāh kariha liqāʾa-Llāh wakariha-Llāh liqāʾah
english_full: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him, and whoever hates to meet Allah, Allah hates to meet him.” It was said to him: “O Messenger of Allah, does hating to meet Allah mean hating to meet death? For all of us hate death.” He said: “No. Rather that is only at the moment of death. But if he is given the glad tidings of the mercy and forgiveness of Allah, he loves to meet Allah and Allah loves to meet him; and if he is given the tidings of the punishment of Allah, he hates to meet Allah and Allah hates to meet him.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4266
lede: Zuhd
arabic: لَيْسَ شَىْءٌ مِنَ الإِنْسَانِ إِلاَّ يَبْلَى إِلاَّ عَظْمًا وَاحِدًا وَهُوَ عَجْبُ الذَّنَبِ وَمِنْهُ يُرَكَّبُ الْخَلْقُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
translit: laysa shayʾun mina al-insāni illā yablā illā ʿaẓman wāḥidan wahuwa ʿajbu adh-dhanabi waminhu yurakkabu al-khalqu yawma al-qiyāmah
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“There is no part of man that will not disintegrate, apart from a single bone at the base of the coccyx, from which he will be recreated on the Day of Resurrection.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4269
lede: Zuhd
arabic: {يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ } قَالَ : نَزَلَتْ فِي عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ يُقَالُ لَهُ : مَنْ رَبُّكَ فَيَقُولُ : رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَنَبِيِّي مُحَمَّدٌ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ {يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الآخِرَةِ}
translit: yuthabbitu-Llāh adh-dhīna āmanūā bi-l-qawli ath-thābiti } qāla : nazalat fī ʿadhābi al-qabri yuqālu lah : man rabbuka fayaqūlu : rabbiya-Llāh wanabiyyī muḥammadun fadhalika qawluhu yuthabbitu-Llāh adh-dhīna āmanūā bi-l-qawli ath-thābiti fī al-ḥayāhi ad-dunyā wafī al-ākhirah
english_full: It was narrated from Bara’ bin ‘Azib that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“Allah will keep firm those who believe, with the word that stands firm.” [14:27] This has been revealed concerning the torment of the grave. It will be said to him: ‘Who is your Lord?’ He will say: ‘My Lord is Allah, and my Prophet is Muhammad.’ This is what Allah says: Allah will keep firm those who believe, with the word that stands firm in this world (i.e. they will keep on worshipping Allah Alone and none else), and in the Hereafter (i.e., at the time of questioning in the grave).’” [14:]

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4270
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِذَا مَاتَ أَحَدُكُمْ عُرِضَ عَلَى مَقْعَدِهِ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ يُقَالُ هَذَا مَقْعَدُكَ حَتَّى تُبْعَثَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
translit: idhā māta aḥadukum ʿuriḍa ʿalā maqʿadihi bi-l-ghadāhi wa-l-ʿashiyyi in kāna min ahli al-jannah famin ahli al-jannah, wa-in kāna min ahli an-nāri famin ahli an-nāri yuqālu hadhā maqʿaduka ḥattā tubʿatha yawma al-qiyāmah
english_full: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“When anyone of you dies, he is shown his place morning and evening. If he is one of the people of Paradise, then he will be shown his seat in Paradise, and if he is one of the people of Hell, then he will be shown his seat in Hell. And it is said: ‘This is your place until you are raised on the Day of Resurrection.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4271
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّمَا نَسَمَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ طَائِرٌ يَعْلُقُ فِي شَجَرِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى جَسَدِهِ يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ
translit: innamā nasamah al-muʾmini ṭāʾirun yaʿluqu fī shajari al-jannah ḥattā yarjiʿa ilā jasadihi yawma yubʿathu
english_full: It was narrated from ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Ka’b Al-Ansari that his father used to narrate that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The believer’s soul is a bird that eats from the trees of Paradise, until it will be returned to his body on the Day when he is resurrected.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4272
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِذَا أُدْخِلَ الْمَيِّتُ الْقَبْرَ مُثِّلَتِ الشَّمْسُ لَهُ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا فَيَجْلِسُ يَمْسَحُ عَيْنَيْهِ وَيَقُولُ : دَعُونِي أُصَلِّي
translit: idhā udkhila al-mayyitu al-qabra muthilati ash-shamsu lah ʿinda ghurūbihā fayajlisu yamsaḥu ʿaynayhi wayaqūlu : daʿūnī uṣallī
english_full: It was narrated from Jabir that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“When the deceased enters the grave, the sun is made to appear as if it is setting. He sits up, wipes his eyes and says: ‘Let me pray.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4275
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَأْخُذُ الْجَبَّارُ سَمَوَاتِهِ وَأَرَضِيهِ بِيَدِهِ - وَقَبَضَ يَدَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَقْبِضُهَا وَيَبْسُطُهَا - ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْجَبَّارُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ الْجَبَّارُونَ أَيْنَ الْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ
translit: yaʾkhudhu al-jabbāru samawātihi wa-araḍīhi biyadihi-waqabaḍa yadah fajaʿala yaqbiḍuhā wayabsuṭuhā-thumma yaqūlu anā al-jabbāru anā al-maliku ayna al-jabbārūna ayna al-mutakabbirūna
english_full: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:“I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say on the pulpit: ‘The Compeller (Al-Jabbar) will seize His heavens and His earths in His Hand’ – and he clenched his hand and started to open and close it – ‘Then He will say: “I am the Compeller, I am the King. Where are the tyrants? Where are the arrogant?” And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leaning to his right and his left, until I could see the pulpit shaking at the bottom, and I thought that it would fall along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4280
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يُوضَعُ الصِّرَاطُ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَىْ جَهَنَّمَ عَلَى حَسَكٍ كَحَسَكِ السَّعْدَانِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَجِيزُ النَّاسُ فَنَاجٍ مُسَلَّمٌ وَمَخْدُوجٌ بِهِ ثُمَّ نَاجٍ وَمُحْتَبَسٌ بِهِ وَمَنْكُوسٌ فِيهَا
translit: yūḍaʿu aṣ-ṣirāṭu bayna ẓahrānay jahannama ʿalā ḥasakin kaḥasaki as-saʿdāni thumma yastajīzu an-nāsu fanājin musallamun wamakhdūjun bihi thumma nājin wamuḥtabasun bihi wamankūsun fīhā
english_full: Abu Sa’eed narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The Sirat will be placed across Hell, on thorns like the thorns of Sa’dan plant.* Then the people will cross it. Some will pass over safe and sound, some will be detained, and some will fall in headfirst.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4281
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَلاَّ يَدْخُلَ النَّارَ أَحَدٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا وَالْحُدَيْبِيَةَ
translit: innī lʾarjū allā yadkhula an-nāra aḥadun in shāʾa-Llāh taʿālā mimman shahida badran wa-l-ḥudaybiyaha
english_full: It was narrated from Hafsah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“I hope that no one of those who witnessed (the battle of) Badr and (Treaty) Hudaybiyah will enter Hell, if Allah wills.” I said: “O Messenger of Allah, doesn’t Allah say “There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell); this is with your Lord, a decree which must be accomplished?” [19:71] He said: “Have you not heard that He says: ‘Then We shall save those who use to fear Allah and were dutiful to Him. And We shall leave the wrongdoers therein (humbled) to their knees (in Hell)?’” [19:]

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4292
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّةٌ مَرْحُومَةٌ عَذَابُهَا بِأَيْدِيهَا فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ دُفِعَ إِلَى كُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَيُقَالُ هَذَا فِدَاؤُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
translit: inna hadhihi ummatun marḥūmatun ʿadhābuhā biʾaydīhā fa-idhā kāna yawmu al-qiyāmah dufiʿa ilā kulli rajulin mina al-muslimīna rajulun mina al-mushrikīna fayuqālu hadhā fidāʾuka mina an-nāri
english_full: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“This nation has been granted mercy (in the Hereafter) and its torment (in this world) is at the hands of one another. When the Day of Resurrection comes, each Muslim man will be given a man from among the idolaters and it will be said: ‘This is your ransom from the Fire.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4293
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ قَسَمَ مِنْهَا رَحْمَةً بَيْنَ جَمِيعِ الْخَلاَئِقِ فَبِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُونَ وَبِهَا يَتَعَاطَفُونَ وَبِهَا تَعْطِفُ الْوَحْشُ عَلَى أَوْلاَدِهَا وَأَخَّرَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً يَرْحَمُ بِهَا عِبَادَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
translit: inna lillāh māʾaha raḥmatin qasama minhā raḥmatan bayna jamīʿi al-khalāʾiqi fabihā yatarāḥamūna wabihā yataʿāṭafūna wabihā taʿṭifu al-waḥshu ʿalā awlādihā wa-akhara tisʿatan watisʿīna raḥmatan yarḥamu bihā ʿibādah yawma al-qiyāmah
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“Allah has one hundred (degrees of) mercy, of which He has shared one between all of creation, by virtue of which you show mercy and compassion towards one another and the wild animals show compassion towards their young. And He has kept back ninety-nine (degrees of) mercy by virtue of which He will show mercy to His slaves on the Day of Resurrection.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4294
lede: Zuhd
arabic: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَجَعَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ مِنْهَا رَحْمَةً فَبِهَا تَعْطِفُ الْوَالِدَةُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَالْبَهَائِمُ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَالطَّيْرُ وَأَخَّرَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أَكْمَلَهَا اللَّهُ بِهَذِهِ الرَّحْمَةِ
translit: khalaqa-Llāh ʿazza wajalla yawma khalaqa as-samawāti wa-l-arḍa māʾaha raḥmatin fajaʿala fī al-arḍi minhā raḥmatan fabihā taʿṭifu al-wālidah ʿalā waladihā wa-l-bahāʾimu baʿḍuhā ʿalā baʿḍin wa-aṭ-ṭayru wa-akhara tisʿatan watisʿīna ilā yawmi al-qiyāmatin fa-idhā kāna yawmu al-qiyāmah akmalahā-Llāh bihadhihi ar-raḥmah
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“On the day when He created the heavens and the earth, Allah created one hundred (degrees of) mercy, of which He placed one on earth, by virtue of which mothers show compassion to their children and animals as well as the birds show compassion to one another. And He kept back ninety-nine (degrees of) mercy. When the Day of Resurrection comes, Allah will complete this mercy.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4295
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَمَّا خَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي
translit: inna-Llāh ʿazza wajalla lammā khalaqa al-khalqa kataba biyadihi ʿalā nafsihi inna raḥmatī taghlibu ghaḍabī
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“When Allah created the universe, He decreed for Himself: ‘My mercy prevails over My wrath.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4296
lede: Zuhd
arabic: يَا مُعَاذُ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ وَمَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ
translit: yā muʿādhu hal tadrī mā ḥaqqu-Llāh ʿalā al-ʿibādi wamā ḥaqqu al-ʿibādi ʿalā-Llāh
english_full: It was narrated that Mu’adh bin Jabal said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed by me when I was riding a donkey, and said: ‘O Mu’adh, do you know what Allah’s right over His slaves is and what His slaves’ right over Allah is?’ I said: ‘Allah and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘The right of Allah over His slaves is that they should worship Him and not associate anything with Him. And the right of the slaves over Allah, if they do that, is that He should not punish them.’”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4301
lede: Zuhd
arabic: إِنَّ لِي حَوْضًا مَا بَيْنَ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ أَبْيَضَ مِثْلَ اللَّبَنِ آنِيَتُهُ عَدَدُ النُّجُومِ وَإِنِّي لأَكْثَرُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ تَبَعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
translit: inna lī ḥawḍan mā bayna al-kaʿbah wabayti al-maqdisi abyaḍa mithla al-labani āniyatuhu ʿadadu an-nujūmi wa-innī lʾaktharu al-anbiyāʾi tabaʿan yawma al-qiyāmah
english_full: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“I have a Cistern, (as large as the distance) between the Ka’bah and Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem). (It is) whiter than milk, and its vessels are the number of the stars. I will be the Prophet with the most followers on the Day of Resurrection.”

title: Sunan Ibn Mājah 4302
lede: Zuhd
